Sanggahan

Selamat datang di Laporan Tahunan PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk dengan tema "Strengthening Foundation for Competitive Sustainable Growth". Laporan Tahunan ini diterbitkan sesuai dengan Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 29/POJK.04/2016 tentang Laporan Tahunan Emiten atau Perusahaan Publik. Penyusunan Laporan Tahunan ini menggunakan ketentuan yang terdapat pada Surat Edaran Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 9/SEOJK.03/2020 tentang Transparansi dan Publikasi Laporan Bank Umum Konvensional dan Surat Edaran Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 16/SEOJK.04/2021 Tentang Bentuk dan Isi Laporan Tahunan Emiten Atau Perusahaan Publik.

Laporan Tahunan ini dapat berisi beberapa pernyataan yang merupakan proyeksi dan pandangan masa depan yang menggambarkan cara pandang Bank terhadap kejadian-kejadian dan kinerja keuangan di masa depan, serta kondisi keuangan, hasil operasi dan hasil usaha, kondisi ekonomi, kondisi sektor, kondisi lalu lintas, serta rencana dan tujuan terkait.

Pandangan-pandangan ini didasarkan pada beberapa estimasi dan asumsi saat ini yang dapat berubah seiring dengan ketidakpastian, kontingensi dan berbagai risiko bisnis, ekonomi, dan kompetisi yang dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu; dapat menyebabkan hasil kinerja, dan kejadian sebenarnya berbeda secara material dari yang telah diprediksi atau diproyeksi, dan hal ini berada di luar kendali Bank dan Direksi Bank. Pernyataan-pernyataan tersebut tidak terkait baik secara langsung maupun secara eksklusif dengan faktafakta historis dan tidak mencerminkan niat, rencana, ekspektasi, asumsi, dan keyakinan Bank mengenai kejadian-kejadian di masa mendatang. Tidak ada jaminan bahwa kejadian di masa mendatang akan muncul, proyeksi akan tercapai, atau asumsi Bank benar. Pernyataan-pernyataan tersebut bukan dan tidak dapat dianggap sebagai representasi atas kinerja Bank di masa datang.

Laporan Tahunan ini memuat kata "Allo Bank" dan "Bank" yang didefinisikan sebagai PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk yang menjalankan kegiatan usaha di bidang jasa perbankan. Penyebutan satuan mata uang "rupiah", "Rp", atau "IDR" merujuk pada mata uang resmi Republik Indonesia, sedangkan "dolar AS" atau "USD" merujuk pada mata uang resmi Amerika Serikat. Semua informasi keuangan disajikan dalam mata uang "rupiah".

Laporan dibuat dalam dua bahasa, yakni bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris. Selain dalam edisi cetak, laporan serupa dapat diakses melalui situs resmi Bank https://www.allobank.com.

Welcome to the Annual Report of PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk. with theme "Strengthening Foundation for Competitive Sustainable Growth". This Annual Report is issued in accordance with OJK Regulation Number 29/POJK.04/2016 concerning Annual Report of Issuers or Public Companies and Circular Letter of The Financial Services Authority Number 16/SEOJK.04/2021 concerning the Form and Content of The Annual Report of Issuers or Public Companies.

This Annual Report may contain several statements that consist of future projections and views describing the Company's perspective on future financial events and performance, as well as financial conditions, operating and business results, economic conditions, sector conditions and related plans and objectives.

These perspectives are based on various current estimations and assumptions that may change in line with uncertainties, contingencies, and various business, economic, and competition risks that may change from at anytime; they could cause actual results, performance and events to differ materially from those predicted or projected; and it is beyond the control of the Company and the Company's Director Board. Such statements are not directly or exclusively related to historical facts and do not reflect the Company's intentions, plans, expectations, assumptions and beliefs regarding future events. There is no guarantee that future events will occur, projections will be achieved, or the Company's assumptions are correct. These statements are not and should not be considered as a representation of the Company's future performance.

This Annual Report contains words such as "Allo Bank" and "Bank", which are defined as PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk that runs business activity in Banking sector. Terms for the currency unit "Rupiah", "Rp" or "IDR" refers to the official currency of the Republic of Indonesia, whereas "US Dollar" or "USD" refers to the official currency of the United States of America. The entire financial information is presented in Rupiah.

This Report made in two languages, namely in Bahasa and English languages. In addition to print edition, this Report can also be accessed in the Bank's official website, https://www.allobank.com.

# Sekapur Sirih

![img-1.jpeg](img-1.jpeg)

# Strengthening Foundation for Competitive Sustainable Growth

Iklim usaha di sepanjang tahun 2024 masih masih dihadapkan dengan situasi yang penuh dengan ketidakpastian. Namun demikian, Allo Bank sebagai bank umum berbasis digital senantiasa fokus untuk memperkuat pondasi bisnis yang dimiliki agar mampu mencapai pertumbuhan secara berkelanjutan di masa depan ("Strengthening Foundation for Competitive Sustainable Growth"). Dalam upaya untuk menghadirkan Allo Bank sebagai everyday bank yang dapat menjawab segala kebutuhan nasabah, Bank terus mengembangkan berbagai inisiatif strategis termasuk kolaborasi dengan berbagai ekosistem, mengembangkan produk dan layanan inovatif dan tanpa melupakan Good Corporate Governance dan manajemen risiko yang menjadi disiplin prudential yang menjadi ciri khas Allo Bank. Allo Bank berkomitmen untuk terus mengembangkan produk dan layanan perbankan digital secara optimal. Layanan tersebut dilakukan melalui kolaborasi dengan ekosistem baik di dalam maupun diluar Group CT Corpora, dengan cara memperkuat cakupan infrastruktur physical & digital (phygital) dan mengembangkan kapabilitas teknologi dan data terbaik agar Bank dapat terus meningkatkan akuisisi dan engagement serta kualitas layanan nasabah.

The business climate throughout 2024 remained one that was filled with uncertainty. Nevertheless, Allo Bank (as a digital-based commercial bank) is always staying focused on strengthening its business foundations so that it can to achieve sustainable growth in the future (as part of its "Strengthening Foundation for Competitive Sustainable Growth" slogan). The Bank has continued to develop various strategic initiatives in an effort to present Allo Bank as an everyday bank that can answer all of its customer needs. This includes the Bank's collaborations with various ecosystems and its efforts at developing innovative products and services, all while ensuring that Good Corporate Governance and risk management remained prudential disciplines that served as Allo Bank hallmark qualities. Allo Bank is committed to continuing with its efforts to optimally develop its digital banking products and services through collaborations with ecosystems both within and outside CT Corpora Group. They have also been carried out by the Bank's efforts at strengthening its coverage of "physical and digital" (or "phygital") infrastructure and by its efforts at developing the best in technology and data capabilities so that it can continue to improve its acquisitions and engagement, as well as improve its customer service quality.

GCG SELF ASSESSMENT

Bank telah melakukan penilaian sendiri (self assessment) terhadap penerapan tata kelola (Good Corporate Governance) yang dilakukan oleh pihak internal dengan mempertimbangkan berbagai faktor penilaian secara komprehensif dan terstruktur, yang mencakup governance structure, governance process, dan governance outcome. Pada tahun 2024, self assessment penerapan GCG Bank meraih nilai komposit sebesar 2 atau memperoleh predikat "BAIK".

The Bank has conducted its self-assessment for its Good Corporate Governance implementation. It has done this by taking various assessment factors into consideration in a comprehensive and structured manner. These factors include the Bank's governance structure, governance process, and governance outcome. In 2024, the Bank's GCG implementation self-assessment process saw it achieving a composite value of 2, or a predicate score of "GOOD".

# Views of the Board of Commissioners on the Performance of the Board of Directors

The year 2024 has been highly challenging for Allo Bank. However, the Company has consistently strived to achieve its set targets. Throughout 2024, the Board of Commissioners has continuously provided guidance to the Board of Directors, emphasizing the importance of prudent business management. Regarding the strategic initiatives undertaken by the Board of Directors in 2024, the Board of Commissioners considers them to be aligned with the plans outlined in the Bank's Business Plan.

The Board of Commissioners remains supportive of the Bank's strategy to develop digital banking products and services. These initiatives aim to improve customer acquisition and engagement while ensuring high-quality service delivery.

Given the Bank's position as a digital-based conventional bank, the Board of Commissioners consistently reminds the Board of Directors to remain vigilant and strengthen risk management practices. This includes addressing credit risk, operational risk related to IT system failures or errors, cybersecurity threats, compliance risks, and reputational risks. Additionally, we urge the Board of Directors to take a proactive approach in handling inquiries and complaints, identifying root causes, and formulating effective solutions to enhance customer satisfaction.

As a digital-based conventional bank, Allo Bank must continuously enhance its information technology infrastructure and refine digital business processes to keep pace with evolving customer behavior, expectations, and industry demands. To support this, the Board of Commissioners advises the Board of Directors to ensure the development of robust backup infrastructure, thereby enhancing the sustainability and reliability of the Bank's services. In this regard, the Board of Commissioners extends its appreciation to the Board of Directors for successfully completing the construction of the new Data Center in 2024. This facility will serve as the backbone of the Bank's IT infrastructure, strengthening its business operations and aligning with stakeholder expectations to support future growth.

# Pandangan atas Prospek Usaha yang Disusun oleh Direksi

Sebagaimana dikutip dari Buku Pertemuan tahun Bank Indonesia 2024 yang dirilis pada 29 November 2024, menjelaskan bahwa perubahan lanskap geopolitik dunia berdampak pada semakin tingginya ketidakpastian global, keluarnya aliran portofolio asing dari pasar negara berkembang (Emerging Market/EMEs) ke Amerika Serikat, dan meningkatnya tekanan pelemahan nilai tukar berbagai mata uang dunia, termasuk Rupiah. Karena itu, kebijakan moneter Bank Indonesia masih difokuskan pada stabilisasi nilai tukar Rupiah untuk memitigasi dampak global terhadap kenaikan inflasi, stabilitas makroekonomi dan sistem keuangan, serta proses pemulihan ekonomi nasional.

Kebijakan moneter dimaksud akan dilakukan secara konsisten dan terukur dengan tetap mempertimbangkan tercapainya sasarann inflasi dan perlunya mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi dalam tahun 2025 dan 2026 mendatang. Keseimbangan antara stabilitas dan pertumbuhan ("pro-stability and growth") ini yang menjadi arah kebijakan moneter tahun 2025 mendatang. Bank Indonesia memperkirakan kredit perbankan tumbuh dalam rentang 11-13 persen pada 2025 dengan didukung oleh pertumbuhan kredit investasi, kredit modal kerja, dan kredit konsumsi. Bank Indonesia melihat bahwa prospek perekonomian Indonesia pada 2025 akan makin baik dengan pertumbuhan yang lebih tinggi, inflasi yang rendah dan nilai tukar yang menguat.

Dalam rangka menjawab tantangan usaha ke depan, Dewan Komisaris meyakini bahwa kerangka kerja strategi tiga pilar yang diformulasikan Direksi terkait pengembangan produk dan aktivitas baru sudah tepat: Acquisition sebagai upaya Bank untuk mendapatkan nasabah baru yang berkualitas melalui kolaborasi strategis; Engagement sebagai upaya untuk menjaga nasabah yang sudah ada agar semakin aktif menggunakan produk dan layanan Bank; dan Monetization sebagai upaya untuk menghasilkan pendapatan dari pengguna produk dan layanan Bank.

Dewan Komisaris juga menilai bahwa Integrasi layanan finansial dengan ekosistem mitra baik di lingkup CT Corpora maupun mitra strategis lainnya untuk meraih potensi pasar yang luas secara online maupun offline (ecosystem first) merupakan langkah strategis yang baik dalam rangka memperluas peluang usaha di masa depan.

Dewan Komisaris berpendapat bahwa target-target dan langkah strategis yang ditetapkan Direksi pada Rencana Bisnis Bank merupakan target yang realistis dan sangat mungkin untuk direalisasikan. Demikian juga dengan strategi yang akan dijalankan, telah sejalan dengan rencana jangka menengah dan panjang Bank. Untuk itu, Dewan Komisaris sepenuhnya mendukung dan senantiasa akan memberikan dukungan agar target-target tersebut dapat tercapai dengan baik.

# Views on Business Prospects Prepared by Board of Directors

As stated in the Bank Indonesia Annual Meeting Book 2024, released on November 29, 2024, changes in the global geopolitical landscape have heightened uncertainty, leading to capital outflows from emerging markets (EMEs) to the United States and increased pressure on the exchange rates of various world currencies, including the Rupiah. As a result, Bank Indonesia's monetary policy remains focused on stabilizing the Rupiah exchange rate to mitigate the global impact of rising inflation while maintaining macroeconomic and financial system stability and supporting the national economic recovery process.

The planned monetary policy will be implemented consistently and prudently, taking into account the achievement of inflation targets and the need to sustain economic growth in 2025 and 2026. This balanced approach—combining stability and growth ("pro-stability and growth")—will guide monetary policy in 2025. Bank Indonesia projects that bank credit will grow between 11-13 percent in 2025, driven by growth in investment loan, working capital loan, and consumer loan. Additionally, Bank Indonesia foresees an improving economic outlook for Indonesia in 2025, with higher growth, low inflation, and a stronger exchange rate.

In order to address future business challenges, the Board of Commissioners believes that the three-pillar strategic framework formulated by the Board of Directors for the development of new products and activities is the right approach. These three pillars are: Acquisition, as the Bank's effort to attract new high-quality customers through strategic collaboration; Engagement, as an initiative to retain existing customers by encouraging more active use of the Bank's products and services; and Monetization, as a strategy to generate revenue from users of the Bank's products and services.

The Board of Commissioners also supports the integration of financial services with partner ecosystems, both within CT Corpora and with other strategic partners. This "ecosystem-first" approach, which combines online and offline market potential, is considered a strong strategic step for expanding future business opportunities.

The Board of Commissioners believes that the targets and strategic steps set by the Board of Directors in the Bank's Business Plan are realistic and achievable. Furthermore, the strategies being implemented align with the Bank's medium- and long-term plans. According to the December 2024 Monetary Policy Review released by Bank Indonesia, global financial market uncertainty increased alongside the risk of a slowdown in global economic growth. The United States (US) trade policy, which includes raising import tariffs on various commodities and expanding country coverage, has heightened the risk of global trade fragmentation.

Global inflation rose beyond previous estimates due to ongoing supply chain disruptions. In the US, the anticipated cut in the Fed Funds Rate (FFR) is expected to be delayed due to persistently high inflation. Meanwhile, a more expansionary US fiscal policy has driven US Treasury yields to remain high across both short-term and long-term tenors. The continued strengthening of the US dollar has led to a shift in global investor preferences, with portfolios being reallocated back to the US. This shift has increased pressure on various world currencies and limited foreign capital

pelemahan berbagai mata uang dunia dan menahan aliran masuk modal asing ke negara berkembang. Konsumsi rumah tangga diperkirakan tetap tumbuh didorong oleh keyakinan konsumen yang terjaga serta dampak positif pelaksanaan Pilkada di berbagai daerah. inflows into developing countries. Given these global economic developments and persistent uncertainty in financial markets, strong policy responses are required to mitigate negative impacts on the economies of developing countries, including Indonesia.

Despite these challenges, Indonesia's economic growth remained stable, supported by strong domestic demand. Investment was expected to grow positively in the fourth quarter of 2024, driven by the completion of various National Strategic Projects (PSN) and private sector investments, which were further encouraged by government incentives. Household consumption continued to rise, fueled by sustained consumer confidence and the positive impact of regional elections held in various parts of the country.

### Tinjauan Segmen Industri

Bank Indonesia juga menyatakan bahwa ketahanan sistem keuangan terjaga baik, termasuk pada industri perbankan. Likuiditas perbankan tetap memadai, tercermin dari rasio Alat Likuid terhadap Dana Pihak Ketiga (AL/DPK) pada November 2024 yang tinggi sebesar 25,57%. Rasio kecukupan modal (Capital Adequacy Ratio/CAR) perbankan pada Oktober 2024 tercatat sebesar 27,02%, tergolong kuat dalam menyerap risiko dan mendukung pertumbuhan kredit. Sementara itu, rasio kredit bermasalah (Non-Performing Loan/NPL) perbankan pada Oktober 2024 terjaga rendah, sebesar 2,20% (bruto) dan 0,77% (neto).

Ketahanan permodalan dan likuiditas perbankan juga didukung oleh pencapaian profitabilitas dan pengelolaan risiko bank yang baik, serta ditopang oleh kemampuan membayar dan profitabilitas korporasi yang terjaga, sebagaimana hasil stress test perbankan terkini. Ke depan, Bank Indonesia terus memperkuat sinergi kebijakan bersama KSSK dalam menjaga stabilitas sistem keuangan, termasuk memitigasi berbagai risiko yang dapat mengganggu stabilitas sistem keuangan.

Kinerja transaksi ekonomi dan keuangan digital pada November 2024 tetap tumbuh didukung oleh sistem pembayaran yang aman, lancar, dan andal. Dari sisi nilai besar, transaksi BI-RTGS pada November 2024 meningkat 9,82% (yoy) dengan nominal transaksi sebesar Rp14.969,37 trilion. Dari sisi ritel, volume transaksi BI-FAST pada November 2024 tumbuh 69,90% (yoy) mencapai 338,61 juta transaksi. Akselerasi pembayaran digital berlanjut. Volume transaksi digital banking pada bulan yang sama tercatat 2,04 miliar transaksi atau tumbuh sebesar 40,1% (yoy), sementara volume transaksi Uang Elektronik (UE) tumbuh 33,4% (yoy) mencapai 1,44 miliar transaksi.

Volume transaksi QRIS terus tumbuh pesat sebesar 186% (yoy) mencapai 689,07 juta transaksi, dengan jumlah pengguna dan merchant masing-masing mencapai 55,02 juta dan 35,1 juta pada November 2024. Sementara itu, volume transaksi pembayaran menggunakan kartu ATM/D pada November 2024 turun 10,9% menjadi 562,75 juta transaksi. Volume transaksi kartu kredit pada bulan yang sama tumbuh 21,1% (yoy) mencapai 41,15 juta transaksi. Dari sisi pengelolaan uang Rupiah, Uang Kartal Yang Diedarkan (UYD) tumbuh 11,9% (yoy) menjadi Rp1.105,8 trilion secara nominal pada akhir November 2024.

Government spending also increased toward the end of the year, further driving economic activity. However, non-oil and gas exports were projected to slow down due to weak global demand. # Peran Direksi dan Implementasi Kebijakan Strategis

Semakin tingginya tingkat literasi digital seiring meningkatnya penetrasi internet dan penggunaan perangkat digital serta kesadaran masyarakat untuk meningkatkan gaya hidup dan mencapai kesejahteraan finansial jangka panjang menjadi katalis positif bagi perkembangan bisnis perbankan. Tingginya generasi muda yang berada di usia produktif juga menjadi salah satu faktor yang mendorong pertumbuhan nasabah.

Melihat kondisi ini, Allo Bank selaku bank umum berbasis digital memfokuskan upaya selama tahun 2024 untuk memperkuat pondasi bisnis yang dimiliki agar mampu mencapai pertumbuhan secara berkelanjutan di masa depan ("Strengthening Foundation for Competitive Sustainable Growth"). Dalam upaya untuk menghadirkan Allo Bank sebagai everyday bank yang dapat menjawab segala kebutuhan nasabah, Bank terus mengembangkan berbagai inisiatif strategis termasuk kolaborasi dengan berbagai ekosistem, mengembangkan produk dan layanan inovatif dan tanpa melupakan Good Corporate Governance dan manajemen risiko yang menjadi disiplin prudential yang menjadi ciri khas Allo Bank.

Kebijakan strategis yang diambil manajemen telah membuahkan sejumlah capaian optimal baik dari sisi pengembangan produk dan layanan serta kinerja operasional dan keuangan. Terkait Teknologi Informasi, Bank telah selesai membangun dan melakukan peresmian Data Center Allo Bank yang baru pada 17 Mei 2024. Bagi Bank dengan layanan berbasis aplikasi digital, Data Center merupakan jantung utama dari operasional layanan Bank. Dalam mengantisipasi tuntutan pengembangan inovasi dan layanan ke depan, sesuai dengan harapan dari para stakeholders maka dibutuhkan Data Center dengan kesiapan Skalabilitas, Ketersediaan, Keandalan, Keamanan, serta sumber daya yang ramah lingkungan. Hal tersebut menuntut Allo Bank untuk dapat mengelola Data Center secara independen dalam mencapai kapabilitas operasional yang unggul dimaksud.

Infrastruktur Data Center dengan Sertifikasi TIA Rated-3 yang baru ini dirancang dengan arsitektur yang memenuhi standar internasional tertinggi. Selain arsitektur, keamanan juga menjadi prioritas Bank, dengan pemisahan antara lingkungan core system dengan surrounding system dan development system untuk meningkatkan keamanan dan keandalan layanan. Perangkat-perangkat yang ada saat ini disiapkan untuk mendukung perkembangan bisnis hingga 15 juta pelanggan di masa depan.

Di samping itu, Bank melakukan Assessment Control Objectives for Information and Related Technology ("COBIT") 2019 dengan Tingkat Maturitas TI di level 4,21 yang merupakan bukti nyata atas komitmen dan dedikasi Bank dalam menerapkan standar terbaik dalam tata kelola teknologi informasi. Assessment ini juga merupakan langkah penting dalam memperkuat kapabilitas TI dan meningkatkan efisiensi serta keamanan layanan yang diberikan kepada nasabah serta mencerminkan bentuk keseriusan Allo Bank dalam terus berinovasi dan memastikan bahwa setiap proses bisnis yang menggunakan TI berjalan dengan baik, terkontrol dan berkelanjutan.

# The Role of the Board of Directors and Implementation of Strategic Policy

The increasing level of digital literacy, coupled with growing internet penetration, the widespread use of digital devices, and heightened public awareness of financial well-being, serves as a positive catalyst for the banking industry's development. Additionally, the high number of young people in the productive age group continues to drive customer growth.

Recognizing this trend, Allo Bank, as a digital-based conventional bank, focused its efforts in 2024 on strengthening the foundation of its business to ensure sustainable growth in the future ("Strengthening Foundation for Competitive Sustainable Growth"). In its pursuit to become an everyday bank that meets all customer needs, the Bank continued to implement various strategic initiatives, including collaborations with diverse ecosystems, the development of innovative products and services, and a firm commitment to Good Corporate Governance (GCG) and prudent risk management, which is the core principles that define Allo Bank's operations.

The strategic policies implemented by management have led to several significant achievements, both in product and service development as well as operational and financial performance. In terms of Information Technology, the Bank successfully completed the construction and inauguration of the Allo Bank Data Center on May 17, 2024. As a bank that operates digital application-based services, the Data Center is the core of its service operations. To anticipate future demands for innovation and service expansion, and to align with stakeholder expectations, the Bank has developed a scalable, highly available, reliable, secure, and environmentally friendly Data Center. This enables Allo Bank to manage its Data Center independently and enhance its operational excellence.

The newly developed TIA Rated-3 Certified Data Center Infrastructure is designed to meet the highest international standards. Beyond its architectural advancements, security remains a top priority. The separation between the core system environment, surrounding systems, and development environments enhances security and ensures service reliability. The infrastructure is also equipped to support business growth, with the capacity to serve up to 15 million customers in the future.

Additionally, the Bank conducted a 2019 Control Objectives for Information and Related Technology (COBIT) Assessment, achieving an IT Maturity Level of 4.21. This achievement reflects the Bank's commitment to implementing best practices in IT governance. The assessment also marks a significant step in enhancing IT capabilities, improving efficiency, strengthening security, and ensuring that all IT-driven business processes are well-regulated, controlled, and sustainable.

Karenanya, kondisi likuiditas perekonomian akan mencerminkan tingkat pertumbuhan ekonomi secara nominal.

# View on Business Outlook

According to the Bank Indonesia 2024 Annual Meeting Book, released on November 29, 2024, Indonesia's economic recovery is expected to continue throughout 2024, with stable growth projected to improve further in 2025 and 2026.

Overall, the Indonesian Government noted economic growth of  $5.03\%$  in 2024, and estimated to increase to  $4.8\% - 5.6\%$  in 2025 and  $4.9\% - 5.7\%$  in 2026. Moving forward, continuous efforts will be necessary to drive economic growth, both from the demand side and the supply side. Meanwhile, banking liquidity remains ample in line with Bank Indonesia's policies, while economic liquidity aligns with real-sector activity. Liquidity is typically assessed through two main indicators: the amount of liquidity available within the banking sector and the money circulating in the economy. Economic liquidity is measured by the money supply, both in a narrow sense—used for consumption and transactions (Base Money, MO)—and in a broader sense, which includes savings (Money Supply M1 and M2). Consequently, the condition of economic liquidity serves as an indicator of nominal economic growth.

# Interest Rates for Collection and Provision of Funds

In accordance with applicable regulations, the Bank publishes the Basic Credit Interest Rate (SBDK), which serves as an indicator of the credit interest rate charged to customers. Allo Bank considers several factors when determining the SBDK, including the BI-Rate set by Bank Indonesia, the Cost of Funds for Credit (HPDK), operational costs associated with fundraising and credit distribution activities, profit margin components determined by the Bank for credit distribution, and considering market competition within the banking industry. The calculation of the SBDK does not include the risk premium component, as this varies based on each debtor's risk assessment. As a result, the credit interest rate imposed on debtors may differ from the SBDK.

# Hal-Hal Penting yang Diperkirakan Terjadi Pada Masa Mendatang

Perkembangan usaha Bank terkait dengan dinamika perekonomian yang di masa mendatang tergantung pada dinamika yang terjadi di tahun berjalan. The Bank has established Guidelines and Work Rules for the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners, regulating share ownership within the Bank's business group. ## Sekilas tentang Perusahaan

PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk (selanjutnya disebut Allo Bank atau Bank) didirikan pada tahun 1992 dengan nama PT Bank Arta Griya berdasarkan Akta Pendirian No. 242 tanggal 21 Oktober 1992 yang dibuat di hadapan Poerbaningsih Adi Warsito, S.H., Notaris di Jakarta.

Di tahun 1993, PT Bank Arta Griya mengalami perubahan nama menjadi PT Bank Harda Griya berdasarkan Akta Perubahan No. 181 Tanggal 16 Januari 1993 yang dibuat di hadapan Poerbaningsih Adi Warsito S.H., Notaris di Jakarta. Akta tersebut telah memperoleh pengesahan dari Menteri Kehakiman Republik Indonesia berdasarkan Surat Keputusan No. C2-895. HT.01.01. TH.93 tanggal 10 Februari 1993, dan telah didaftarkan pada Kepaniteraan Pengadilan Negeri Jakarta Selatan No. 127/A/ PT/HKM/1993/PN.JAK.SEL tanggal 12 Februari 1993, serta telah diumumkan dalam Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 25 Tanggal 27 Maret 1993, Tambahan Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 1316. Selanjutnya di tahun 1996, Bank kembali mengalami perubahan nama dari PT Bank Harda Griya menjadi menjadi PT Bank Harda Internasional berdasarkan Akta No. 23 tanggal 10 Desember 1996 yang dibuat di hadapan Triphosa Lily Ekadewi, S.H., Notaris di Ciputat dan telah mendapatkan persetujuan dari Menteri Kehakiman Republik Indonesia berdasarkan Keputusan No. C2-1473.HT.01.04. TH.97 tanggal 25 September 1997.

## Company at a Glance

PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk (hereinafter referred to as Allo Bank or Bank) was founded in 1992 under the name PT Bank Arta Griya based on Deed of Establishment No. 242 dated October 21, 1992 made before Poerbaningsih Adi Warsito, S.H., Notary in Jakarta.

In 1993, PT Bank Arta Griya changed its name to PT Bank Harda Griya based on Deed of Amendment No. 181 Dated January 16, 1993 made before Poerbaningsih Adi Warsito S.H., Notary in Jakarta. This deed has obtained approval from the Minister of Justice of the Republic of Indonesia based on Decree No. C2-895. HT.01.01. TH.93 dated February 10, 1993, and was registered at the Registrar's Office of the South Jakarta District Court No. 127/A/ PT/HKM/1993/PN.JAK.SEL dated February 12, 1993, and has been published in the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 25 Dated March 27, 1993, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 1316. Furthermore, in 1996, the Bank had another name changed from PT Bank Harda Griya to PT Bank Harda Internasional based on Deed No. 23 dated December 10, 1996 which was made before Triphosa Lily Ekadewi, S.H., Notary in Ciputat and obtained approval from the Minister of Justice of the Republic of Indonesia based on Decree No. C2-1473.HT.01.04.TH.97 dated September 25, 1997.

Pada tahun 2021, PT Bank Harda Internasional Tbk resmi diakuisisi oleh PT Mega Corpora. Setelah mendapat persetujuan dari Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, pada Juni 2021, PT Bank Harda Internasional Tbk resmi berganti nama menjadi PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk. Perubahan nama tersebut dinyatakan dalam Akta Perubahan Anggaran Dasar No. 1 tanggal 2 Juni 2021 yang dibuat di hadapan Dharma Akhyuzi, S.H., Notaris di Jakarta, dan akta tersebut telah memperoleh persetujuan dari Menkumham No. AHU-0031692. AH.01.02 tahun 2021 tanggal 2 Juni 2021. Perubahan nama menjadi PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk telah mendapat persetujuan dari Otoritas Jasa Keuangan berdasarkan Keputusan Deputi Dewan Komisioner Pengawas Perbankan I Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. KEP-48/PB-1/2021 tanggal 30 Juni 2021 tentang Penetapan Penggunaan Izin Usaha Atas Nama PT Bank Harda Internasional Tbk Menjadi Izin Usaha Atas Nama PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk.

After more than 2 (two) decades, the Bank took strategic steps by conducting an Initial Share Offering on the Indonesia Stock Exchange in 2015. Through these offering, the Bank changed its status to a public company under the name PT Bank Harda Internasional Tbk. These changes were stated in the Deed of Minutes of the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders No. 31 dated March 18, 2015 which was made before Edward Suharjo Wiryomartani., S.H., M.Kn., Notary in West Jakarta and received the Notification of Amendments to the Articles of Association from the Minister of Law and Human Rights through Letter No. AHU-AH.01.03-0017606 dated March 19 2015. The aim of listing shares on the IDX is to strengthen the financial structure and increase business competitiveness in the banking world.

In 2021, PT Bank Harda Internasional Tbk was officially acquired by PT Mega Corpora. After obtaining approval from the Financial Services Authority, in June 2021, PT Bank Harda Internasional Tbk officially changed its name to PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk. The name change is stated in the Deed of Amendment to the Articles of Association No. 1 dated June 2, 2021 which was made before Dharma Akhyuzi, S.H., Notary in Jakarta, and the deed was approved by the Minister of Law and Human Rights No. AHU-0031692.AH.01.02 of 2021 dated June 2, 2021. The name change to PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk has received approval from the Financial Services Authority based on Decree of the Deputy Board of Commissioners for Banking Supervision I of the Financial Services Authority No. KEP-48/PB-1/2021 dated June 30, 2021 concerning Stipulation of Using of a Business License on behalf of PT Bank Harda Internasional Tbk to Become a Business License on behalf of PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk.

Selanjutnya, Bank kembali melakukan perubahan Anggaran Dasar pada tahun 2023 yang telah disahkan melalui Akta No. 01 tanggal 14 Juni 2023 yang dibuat di hadapan Dharma Akhyuzi, S.H., Notaris di Jakarta yang telah memperoleh persetujuan dari Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia dengan Surat Keputusan No. AHU-0039698.AH.01.02.Tahun 2023 tanggal 12 Juli 2023 dan telah didaftarkan dalam Daftar Perseroan No. AHU-0131254. AH.01.11 tanggal 12 Juli 2023. Perubahan tersebut disesuaikan dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan di sektor Perbankan dan Pasar Modal yang berlaku, yaitu Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia No. 4 Tahun 2023 tentang Pengembangan dan Penguatan Sektor Keuangan untuk penyesuaian kegiatan usaha Bank serta Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 17 tahun 2023 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum untuk penyesuaian jumlah komposisi anggota Direksi dan anggota Dewan Komisaris Bank.

Since its grand launch on May 20, 2022, PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk has developed into a leading digital service-based conventional bank serving more than 11 million customers by the end of 2024. Allo Bank offers a variety of innovative digital banking products and services including Allo Pay, Allo Pay+, Allo Prime, Allo Grow, PayLater and Instant Cash. The name "Allo" is an abbreviation of All in One, which reflecting the Bank's aspirations for its customers to Experience a Simple Life. In addition, Allo Bank is a subsidiary of CT Corpora, a leading consumer-focused integrated business group in Indonesia with various businesses in financial services, media, retail, lifestyle and entertainment.

The Bank's Articles of Association have undergone several changes. In 2022, the Articles of Association were amended, as outlined in the Deed of Amendment to the Articles of Association No. 05, dated October 15, 2021, executed before Dharma Akhyuzi, S.H., Notary in Jakarta. Subsequently, further amendments were made in 2023, as ratified through Deed No. 01, dated June 14, 2023, executed before Dharma Akhyuzi, S.H., Notary in Jakarta. These amendments received approval from the Minister of Law and Human Rights of the Republic of Indonesia through Decree No. AHU-0039698. AH.01.02.Year 2023, dated July 12, 2023, and were registered in the Company Register No. AHU-0131254.AH.01.11 dated July 12, 2023. The changes were made to align with prevailing laws and regulations in the Banking and Capital Market sectors, including Law No. 4 of 2023 on the Development and Strengthening of the Financial Sector to adjust the Bank's business activities and Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 17 of 2023 on the Implementation of Governance for conventional bank to accommodate changes in the number of members of the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners.

# Corporate Culture

Dalam rangka memastikan pengelolaan dan pelaksanaan bisnis Bank dapat berjalan secara optimal di seluruh aktivitas operasional yang dilakukan, Bank menetapkan budaya perusahaan dengan memegang teguh Nilai Inti Bank. Nilai-nilai ini berperan sebagai sebuah norma atau pedoman perilaku umum bagi seluruh Insan Bank dalam menjalankan aktivitasnya sehari-hari. Nilai Inti Bank memegang peranan penting dalam menopang dan mewujudkan visi dan misi melalui 7 (tujuh) nilai inti (core values) dengan akronim "DIGITAL" yang diluncurkan pada awal Desember 2022 melalui program Allo Temu. Nilai Inti Bank adalah sebagai berikut:

To ensure the effective management and implementation of the Bank's business across all operational activities, the Bank has established a corporate culture centered on its Core Values. These values serve as norms and general behavioral guidelines for all Bank personnel in their daily activities. The Bank's Core Values play a pivotal role in supporting and realizing its vision and mission. They are encapsulated in seven key principles, represented by the acronym "DIGITAL", which were introduced in early December 2022 through the Allo Temu program. Details of the Bank's Core Values are as follows:

|  Data-driven | Kami mengambil keputusan dan memecahkan masalah berdasarkan data dan informasi yang kredibel
We make decisions and solve problems based on credible data and information  |
| --- | --- |
|  Impact | Kami memberikan solusi dan dampak positif kepada semua stakeholders
We provide solutions and positive impacts to all stakeholders  |
|  Growth | Kami terus menerus tumbuh dan berkembang secara berkesinambungan untuk masa depan yang lebih baik
We are continuously growing and developing on an ongoing basis for a better future  |
|  In harmony | Kami bekerjasama dengan semua pihak secara harmonis yang berorientasi pada hasil
We work harmoniously with all parties in a result-oriented manner  |
|  Transparency | Kami berperilaku jujur dan transparan dalam segala aspek pekerjaan
We behave honestly and transparently in all aspects of our work  |
|  Agility | Kami tangkas beradaptasi terhadap semua perubahan yang terjadi
We are quick to adapt to all the changes that occur  |
|  Learning | Kami terus belajar, berbagi dan menerapkan pengetahuan dan keterampilan baru untuk mengembangkan kompetensi diri
We are constantly learning, sharing and applying knowledge and skills to develop self-competence  |

# Sumber Daya Manusia
Human Resources

![img-89.jpeg](img-89.jpeg)

Sumber Daya Manusia (SDM) merupakan salah satu faktor penting bagi Bank dalam mencapai Visi, Misi, dan tujuan organisasi. Oleh sebab itu, Bank menempatkan SDM sebagai elemen penting dan mitra strategis dalam menjalankan kegiatan usaha. Selain menjalankan praktik terbaik, pengelolaan dan pengembangan kompetensi SDM Bank juga ditujukan gunna merespon tantangan bisnis, serta memenuhi tuntutan industri perbankan yang dinamis agar dapat menjadi Bank yang kuat dan kompetitif. Salah satu komitmen yang telah dilakukan oleh Bank adalah memastikan terpenuhinya seluruh posisi strategis di organisasi.

## Demografi Karyawan

Berdasarkan data periode 31 Desember 2024, jumlah karyawan Bank adalah sebanyak 484 orang dengan komposisi sebanyak 77,69% karyawan permanen. Jika dibandingkan dengan data karyawan tahun sebelumnya, terdapat peningkatan sekitar 21% secara bankwide. Peningkatan jumlah karyawan Bank bertujuan untuk mendukung pencapaian target bisnis Bank baik Wholesale maupun Digital yang didominasi dengan peningkatan jumlah karyawan yang berfokus pada pencapaian target produk digital.

Human Resources (HR) is a critical factor in enabling the Bank to achieve its vision, mission, and organizational goals. As such, the Bank regards HR as a vital element and strategic partner in executing its business activities. In addition to adopting best practices, the management and development of HR competencies are focused on addressing business challenges and meeting the demands of the dynamic banking industry, ensuring the Bank remains strong and competitive. One of the Bank's key commitments is to ensure that all strategic positions within the organization are effectively filled.

## Employee Demographics

As of December 31, 2024, the Bank employed 484 individuals, with 77.69% of them being permanent employees. Compared to the previous year, this represents an approximately 21% increase across the organization. This growth in employee numbers supports the Bank's business objectives in both Wholesale and Digital segments, particularly by expanding the workforce focused on achieving digital product targets.

# Pengelolaan dan Pengembangan Kompetensi Karyawan
Employee Competency Management and Development

## Pengembangan Kompetensi Karyawan Tahun 2024

Allo Bank memiliki komitmen untuk senantiasa mengembangkan kemampuan dan kompetensi masing-masing karyawan agar dapat menghadapi tantangan bisnis yang semakin kompetitif. Bank telah merancang berbagai program pelatihan dan sertifikasi secara komprehensif sepanjang tahun 2024.

Dalam rangka membangun tim dan karyawan yang berkualitas dan profesional dalam menghadapi kondisi bisnis yang dinamis, Bank secara konsisten melaksanakan program pendidikan dan pengembangan karyawan. Hal tersebut bertujuan untuk meningkatkan daya saing dalam menghadapi perkembangan industri serta untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan produktivitas kerja Bank.

Pengembangan kompetensi yang dilakukan oleh Bank ditujukan untuk meningkatkan hard skills dan soft skills dengan memperhatikan strategi dalam mengembangkan bisnis agar seluruh karyawan dapat siap menghadapi persaingan di industri perbankan yang semakin ketat.

Allo Bank memberikan kesempatan yang sama kepada seluruh pekerja untuk bisa mewujudkan organisasi yang inovatif dan adaptif terhadap perubahan dengan memberikan seluruh karyawan kesempatan dalam meningkatkan kualitas dan kapasitasnya. Pengembangan kompetensi ini diharapkan dapat berdampak pada kualitas talenta-talenta digital yang memiliki kemampuan untuk menciptakan inovasi produk digital. Hal tersebut dilakukan dengan menjalankan program pendidikan dan pengembangan kompetensi karyawan secara berkesinambungan.

## Competency Development in 2024

Allo Bank is committed to continuously developing the capabilities and competencies of each employee in order to face increasingly competitive business challenges. The Bank has designed various comprehensive training and certification programs throughout 2024.

To build a high-quality and professional team capable of navigating dynamic business conditions, the Bank consistently implements employee education and development programs. These initiatives aim to enhance competitiveness, improve efficiency, and boost productivity as the Bank adapts to industry advancements.

The Bank's competency development efforts focus on strengthening both hard and soft skills, ensuring alignment with business development strategies. This prepares employees to thrive amid the increasingly competitive banking industry.

Allo Bank provides equal opportunities for all employees to contribute to the creation of an innovative and adaptive organization. By offering all employees opportunities to improve their quality and capacity, this competency development is expected to enhance the quality of digital talents with the ability to create innovative digital products. These goals are achieved through ongoing employee education and competency development programs.

Allo Bank menyelenggarakan program pelatihan yang berkaitan langsung dengan fungsi kerja di unit bisnis dan unit pendukung, termasuk pelatihan dalam memahami berbagai modul yang terkait prosedur dan kebijakan dari Regulator. Bank juga secara rutin telah menyelenggarakan pelatihan APU-PPT & PPPSPM, strategi anti-fraud serta penanganan dan penyelesaian pengaduan nasabah agar dapat memberikan wawasan terkini terkait dengan kasus perbankan, prosedur dan kebijakan baru. Bank juga melakukan pemantauan secara berkala terhadap pemenuhan sertifikasi kompetensi yang dipersyaratkan dan pemeliharaan sertifikasi kompetensi sesuai dengan bidangnya, seperti Sertifikasi Manajemen Risiko (SMR), Sistem Pembayaran dan Pengelolaan Uang Rupiah (SPPUR), Sertifikasi Tresuri, serta sertifikasi lain sesuai dengan kebutuhan diantaranya sertifikasi di bidang IT, Kepatuhan, Siber dan Audit.

Seluruh karyawan Allo Bank didorong untuk memiliki integritas yang tinggi, agility dalam bekerja dengan berpegang kepada nilai-nilai Inti Bank sebagai pedoman perilaku sehari-hari. Selain itu, seluruh proses pengelolaan SDM di Allo Bank dilandasi pada peraturan perundang-undangan dan best practices pada pengelolaan SDM. Komitmen-komitmen tersebut dibuktikan dengan penyelenggaraan pelatihan dan pengembangan SDM yang dilakukan dengan mengacu pada kerangka pelatihan dan pengembangan Standar Kompetensi Kerja Nasional Indonesia (SKKNI) dan Kerangka Kerja Nasional Indonesia (KKNI) yang berlaku untuk Perbankan dan Jasa Keuangan.

Berdasarkan kebijakan pengembangan kompetensi karyawan yang dimiliki, Bank telah menyelenggarakan berbagai program pendidikan dan pelatihan kepada 439 karyawan atau 93% dari jumlah karyawan Bank di sepanjang tahun 2024.

Allo Bank organizes training programs directly related to work functions in business and support units, including training on various modules regarding procedures and policies from regulators. The Bank has also routinely conducted APU-PPT and PPPSPM training, anti-fraud strategies, and customer complaint handling to provide the latest insights into banking cases, new procedures, and policies. Additionally, the Bank periodically monitors the fulfillment and maintenance of required competency certifications, such as Risk Management Certification (SMR), Payment System and Rupiah Money Management (SPPUR), Treasury Certification, and other certifications tailored to the Bank's needs, including certifications in IT, Compliance, Cyber and audit-related fields.

All Allo Bank employees are encouraged to demonstrate high integrity and agility in their work, adhering to the Bank's Core Values as guidelines for daily behavior. Furthermore, the entire HR management process at Allo Bank is conducted in compliance with laws, regulations, and HR management best practices. These commitments are reflected in the implementation of HR training and development, which adheres to the training and development frameworks of the Indonesian National Work Competency Standards (SKKNI) and the Indonesian National Qualification Framework (KKNI) applicable to the Banking and Financial Services sectors.

Based on the employee competency development policy, the Bank has organized various education and training programs for 439 employees, accounting for 93% of the Bank's total workforce in 2024.

## Kebijakan dan Pelaksanaan Rekrutmen Karyawan

Selaras dengan perkembangan industri perbankan dan kebutuhan, Bank senantiasa merekrut SDM yang profesional, berdedikasi tinggi, disiplin, tangguh terhadap tantangan, mudah beradaptasi dan memiliki kompetensi unggul. Dengan proses penerimaan atau rekrutmen karyawan baik yang sudah berpengalaman maupun yang fresh graduate, secara profesional sesuai dengan bidang-bidang yang ada dalam perusahaan. Bank melakukan proses rekrutmen mulai dari tahap perencanaan SDM yang merupakan proses identifikasi dan evaluasi untuk menghitung kebutuhan beserta profil SDM untuk mendukung pencapaian tujuan Bank. Proses perencanaan SDM ini dilakukan dengan mempertimbangkan berbagai aspek, seperti pertumbuhan bisnis, persiapan karyawan yang pensiun, karyawan yang promosi/mutasi/rotasi dan turnover karyawan.

Faktor integritas dan rekam jejak juga menjadi perhatian penting selain keterampilan dan kompetensi yang dimiliki calon karyawan. Bank secara konsisten menerapkan kebijakan Know Your Employee (KYE) pada tahap seleksi dan proses rekrutmen seluruh karyawan.

## Employee Recruitment Policy and Implementation

In line with the development of the banking industry and its needs, the Bank consistently recruits professional, highly dedicated, disciplined, resilient, adaptable, and competent human resources. The recruitment process is conducted professionally for both experienced candidates and fresh graduates, ensuring alignment with the company's specific requirements. The Bank's recruitment process begins with the HR planning stage, which involves identifying and evaluating the needs and profiles of human resources to support the Bank's objectives. This HR planning process considers various factors, including business growth, preparation for retiring employees, promotions, transfers/rotations, and employee turnover.

In addition to assessing skills and competencies, the Bank places strong emphasis on integrity and track record of prospective employees. The Know Your Employee (KYE) policy is consistently applied at the selection stage and recruitment process of all employees.

Penilaian Kinerja dan Potensi Karyawan

Bank secara rutin melakukan penilaian (assessment) kepada seluruh karyawan dalam rangka menggali potensi dan talenta karyawan yang dapat mendukung pencapaian tujuan yang telah ditetapkan. Assessment ini juga berperan sebagai dasar dalam menentukan pengembangan dan pengisian kebutuhan organisasi perusahaan. Dalam melakukan assessment tersebut, Bank telah merancang Objective & Key Result (OKR), penetapan target, pengukuran realisasi, serta monitoring realisasinya. Penilaian kinerja dan kompetensi karyawan kemudian digunakan sebagai pertimbangan atas remunerasi dan pengembangan karyawan yang dilakukan secara adil dan transparan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.

Kesejahteraan Karyawan

Menyadari pentingnya talenta yang andal, loyal, dan kompeten di tengah kondisi bisnis yang dinamis dan persaingan ketat, Bank senantiasa memastikan pengelolaan SDM dapat dilakukan secara tepat. Upaya ini bertujuan untuk memastikan seluruh talenta Bank memiliki kualitas yang baik dan adaptif di segala kondisi sehingga dapat mengakselerasi pencapaian visi dan misi Bank.

Agar dapat mencapai tujuan tersebut, Bank berupaya untuk memastikan terwujudnya kesejahteraan karyawan sebagai bentuk apresiasi terhadap kontribusi karyawan atas pencapaian kinerja Bank. Bank percaya bahwa kesejahteraan karyawan yang memadai mampu mendorong karyawan untuk mengoptimalkan kemampuannya sesuai dengan tugas dan tanggung jawab yang diemban.

Pada pelaksanaannya, program peningkatan kesejahteraan karyawan yang diterapkan oleh Bank, meliputi remunerasi yang kompetitif dan penghargaan sesuai dengan kontribusi yang diberikan kepada Bank. Remunerasi yang diterima oleh karyawan dapat berupa gaji yang telah memenuhi standar upah minimum regional, kesempatan mengikuti pendidikan dan pelatihan, serta berbagai fasilitas penunjang kesejahteraan karyawan lain, seperti jaminan kesehatan, jaminan hari tua dan lain-lain.

Performance and Potential Assessment of Employee

The Bank routinely assesses all employees to explore their potential and talents, which can support the achievement of its established goals. These assessments also serve as a basis for determining employee development and meeting the organization's needs. To conduct these evaluations, the Bank has established Objectives & Key Results (OKRs), target setting, realization measurement, and monitoring mechanisms. Employee performance and competency assessments are then used as key considerations for determining remuneration and development, which are implemented fairly and transparently in accordance with applicable regulations.

Employee Welfare

Recognizing the importance of reliable, loyal, and competent talents amidst dynamic business conditions and intense competition, the Bank ensures that HR management is carried out effectively. This effort aims to ensure that all Bank employees maintain high quality and adaptability in all conditions, enabling them to accelerate the achievement of the Bank's vision and mission.

To achieve these objectives, the Bank is committed to realizing employee welfare as a form of appreciation for their contributions to the Bank's performance. The Bank believes that adequate employee welfare can motivate employees to optimize their abilities in accordance with their assigned tasks and responsibilities.

In practice, the Bank's employee welfare improvement program includes competitive remuneration and awards aligned with employees' contributions to the Bank. Remuneration provided to employees includes salaries that meet regional minimum wage standards, opportunities to participate in education and training, and various other welfare benefits such as health insurance, retirement benefits, and more.

PT Mega Corpora merupakan pemegang saham pengendali Bank setelah melakukan pengambilalihan saham sebesar 73.71% (tujuh puluh tiga koma tujuh puluh satu persen) dari modal ditempatkan dan disetor Bank pada 15 Maret 2021. Kemudian, Bank melakukan perubahan model bisnis dari bank konvensional menjadi bank umum berbasis digital dengan dukungan dari unit-unit usaha dalam ekosistem CT Corpora. Pada tanggal 31 Mei 2021 setelah PT Mega Corpora melakukan Penawaran Tender Wajib, maka kepemilikan saham dalam Bank menjadi sebesar 90,00% (sembilan puluh persen).

Perseroan melakukan Penawaran Umum Terbatas (PUT) II dalam rangka penambahan modal dengan menerbitkan Hak Memesan Efek Terlebih Dahulu (HMETD) kepada para pemegang saham Perseroan sebanyak 7.498.501.776 saham biasa atas nama atau sebesar 64,18% dari modal ditempatkan dan disetor penuh Perseroan setelah PUT II dengan nilai nominal Rp100,- setiap saham dengan harga pelaksanaan Rp100,-, sehingga jumlah dana yang diterima Perseroan dalam PUT II ini sebesar Rp749.850.177.600.

Perseroan melakukan PUT III dalam rangka penambahan modal dengan menerbitkan Hak Memesan Efek Terlebih Dahulu (HMETD) kepada para pemegang saham Perseroan sebanyak 10.047.322.871 saham biasa atas nama atau sebesar 46,24% dari modal ditempatkan dan disetor penuh Perseroan setelah PUT III dengan nilai nominal Rp100,- setiap saham dengan Harga Pelaksanaan Rp478,- per saham, sehingga jumlah dana yang diterima Perseroan dalam PUT III ini sebesar Rp4.802.620.332.338.

# Information on Major/Controlling Shareholders Up to Last Owner

PT Mega Corpora became the controlling shareholder of the Bank after acquiring 73.71% (seventy-three point seventy-one percent) of the Bank's issued and paid-up capital on March 15, 2021. Subsequently, the Bank changed its business model from a conventional bank to a digitally-based commercial bank, with support from business units within and outside the CT Corpora ecosystem. On May 31, 2021, after PT Mega Corpora conducted a Mandatory Tender Offer, share ownership in the Bank increased 90.00% (ninety percent).

To increase its capital, the Company initiated a Limited Public Offering (PUT) II, issuing Pre-emptive Rights (HMETD) to its shareholders totalling 7,498,501,776 ordinary shares, constituting 64.18% of the issued and fully paid-up capital of the Company after PUT II, with a nominal value of IDR 100,- per share with an exercise price of Rp 100,-. As a result, the Company received a total of Rp 749,850,177,600 in funds from this PUT II.

The Company conducted PUT III to increase its capital by issuing Pre-emptive Rights (HMETD) to the Company's shareholders totaling 10,047,322,871 ordinary shares in their names or 46.24% of the issued and fully paid-up capital of the Company after PUT III with nominal value IDR 100 per share with an Exercise Price of IDR 478 per share. Consequently, the Company received a total of IDR 4,802,620,332,338 in funds from this LPO III.

# Kronologis Penerbitan dan/atau Pencatatan Saham
## Chronology of Issuance and/or Share Listing

1. Rencana Go Public Perseroan bermula dari tahun 2014 dan sejak saat itu, Perseroan mulai melakukan seleksi untuk pemilihan lembaga dan profesi penunjang, termasuk melakukan perubahan Anggaran Dasar.
2. Due Diligence Meeting & Public Expose berlangsung pada tanggal 13 Juli 2015 di Ballroom ASEAN Tower Lantai 9, Pasar Baru - Jakarta Pusat.
3. Pernyataan efektif oleh Pengawas Pasar Modal Otoritas Jasa Keuangan diperoleh tanggal 31 Juli 2015. Sedangkan masa penawaran umum berlangsung pada tanggal 4-6 Agustus 2015.
4. Dalam penawaran penjatahan pasti (fixed allotment) dibatasi sampai dengan jumlah sebesar 98% dari jumlah saham yang ditawarkan dan sisanya sebanyak-banyaknya 2% akan dilakukan penjatahan terpusat (pooling).
5. Pencatatan efektif saham Allo Bank dengan kode saham BBHI di BEI dilaksanakan pada tanggal 12 Agustus 2015, dengan melakukan penawaran saham kepada masyarakat sebanyak 800.000.000 saham dengan harga Rp125 per lembar saham.

1. The Company's plan to go public commenced in 2014 and has since started the selection of supporting institutions and professions, including the amendment of the Articles of Association.
2. Due Diligence Meeting & Public Expose took place on July 13, 2015 at the Ballroom of ASEAN Tower 9th Floor, Pasar Baru - Central Jakarta.
3. An effective statement by the Capital Market Supervisor of the Financial Services Authority was obtained on July 31, 2015. Meanwhile, the public offering period lasted from August 4-6, 2015.
4. Fixed allotment bidding was limited to 98% of the total shares offered and the remaining 2% will be done by pooling.
5. The effective listing of Allo Bank's shares with BBHI's ticker code on the IDX was carried out on August 12, 2015, by offering the public 800,000,000 shares with a price of Rp125 per share.

# Tinjauan Perekonomian dan Industri

Economic and Industrial Overview

## Tinjauan Perekonomian

Sebagaimana dikutip dari Tinjauan Kebijakan Moneter Desember 2024 yang dirilis Bank Indonesia, mengungkapkan bahwa Ketidakpastian pasar keuangan global semakin meningkat disertai dengan risiko perlambatan pertumbuhan ekonomi dunia. Rencana kebijakan perdagangan di Amerika Serikat (AS) melalui kenaikan tarif impor, komoditas, dan cakupan negara yang lebih luas telah menyebabkan risiko peningkatan fragmentasi perdagangan dunia.

Inflasi dunia meningkat dibandingkan prakiraan sebelumnya dipengaruhi oleh gangguan rantai suplai. Di AS, penurunan Fed Funds Rate (FFR) diprakirakan lebih lambat akibat inflasi yang lebih tinggi tersebut. Sementara itu, kebijakan fiskal AS yang lebih ekspansif mendorong yield US Treasury tetap tinggi, baik pada tenor jangka pendek maupun jangka panjang. Penguatan mata uang dolar AS secara luas terus berlanjut disertai berbaliknya preferensi investor global dengan memindahkan alokasi portfolionya kembali ke AS. Hal ini meningkatkan tekanan pelemahan berbagai mata uang dunia dan menahan aliran masuk modal asing ke negara berkembang. Perkembangan ekonomi global yang diikuti dengan tetap tingginya ketidakpastian pasar keuangan global tersebut memerlukan respons kebijakan yang kuat untuk memitigasi dampak negatifnya terhadap perekonomian di negara-negara berkembang, termasuk Indonesia.

Namun demikian, Pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia tetap terjaga didukung oleh permintaan domestik. Investasi diprakirakan tumbuh positif pada triwulan IV 2024 ditopang oleh penyelesaian berbagai Proyek Strategis Nasional (PSN) dan investasi swasta didukung insentif dari Pemerintah. Konsumsi rumah tangga diprakirakan tetap tumbuh didorong oleh keyakinan konsumen yang terjaga serta dampak positif pelaksanaan Pilkada di berbagai daerah. Konsumsi Pemerintah lebih tinggi seiring dengan kenaikan aktivitas belanja Pemerintah pada akhir tahun. Sementara itu,

## Economic Overview

Uncertainty within global financial markets has been on an uptick, as is evidenced by data from Bank Indonesia's December 2024 Monetary Policy Review. Accompanying this was the risk of slowing global economic growth. The United States' trade policy plan of increasing import tariffs, commodities, and wider country coverage has led to the risk of increased fragmentation of world trade.

Global inflation has meanwhile gone up compared to previous estimates due to supply chain disruptions. In the United States (US), the Fed Funds Rate (FFR) reduction was predicted to be slower due to higher inflation. A more expansive US fiscal policy has pushed US Treasury yields to remain high for both short-term and long-term tenors. The strengthening of the US dollar currency has broadly continued while accompanied by a reversal in global investor preferences that saw them moving their portfolio allocations back to the US. This has increased pressure on the weakening of various world currencies and restrained foreign capital inflows to developing countries. Global economic developments, followed by continued high uncertainty in global financial markets, require a strong policy response to mitigate their negative impact on the economies of developing countries, including Indonesia.

Nevertheless, Indonesia's economic growth has continued to remain stable thanks to the support of domestic demand. Investment grew positively in the fourth quarter of 2024 thanks to the completion of various National Strategic Projects and private investment supported by incentives from the Government. Household consumption continued to grow thanks to maintained consumer confidence and the positive impact of regional elections in various regions. Government consumption is higher in line with an increase in government spending activities at the end of the year. Meanwhile,

# Tinjauan Industri

Bank Indonesia menyatakan bahwa ketahanan system keuangan terjaga baik, termasuk pada industri perbankan. Likuiditas perbankan tetap memadai, tecermin dari rasio Alat Likuid terhadap Dana Pihak Ketiga (AL/DPK) pada November 2024 yang tinggi sebesar  $25.57\%$ . Rasio kecukupan modal (Capital Adequacy Ratio/CAR) perbankan pada Oktober 2024 tercatat sebesar  $27.02\%$ , tergolong kuat dalam menyerap risiko dan mendukung pertumbuhan kredit. Sementara itu, rasio kredit bermasalah (Non-Performing Loan/NPL) perbankan pada Oktober 2024 terjaga rendah, sebesar  $2.20\%$  (bruto) dan  $0.77\%$  (neto).

Ketahanan permodalan dan likuiditas perbankan juga didukung oleh pencapaian profitabilitas dan pengelolaan risiko bank yang baik, serta ditopang oleh kemampuan membayar dan profitabilitas korporasi yang terjaga, sebagaimana hasil stress test perbankan terkini. Ke depan, Bank Indonesia terus memperkuat sinergi kebijakan bersama KSSK dalam menjaga stabilitas system keuangan, termasuk memitigasi berbagai risiko yang dapat mengganggu stabilitas system keuangan.

# Industry Overview

Bank Indonesia has stated that the financial system's resilience has been well maintained, including in the banking industry. Banking liquidity remained adequate, reflected in the high ratio of Liquid Assets to Third Party Funds of  $25.57\%$  in November 2024. The capital adequacy ratio (CAR) for banking in October 2024 was recorded at  $27.02\%$ . This percentage was considered strong in absorbing risks and supporting credit growth. Meanwhile, the banking non-performing loan (NPL) ratio in October 2024 was maintained at low levels, at  $2.20\%$  (gross) and  $0.77\%$  (net).

The resilience of banking capital and liquidity was also supported by good bank profitability and risk management. It was also supported by the ability to pay and maintain corporate profitability, as shown in the results of the latest banking stress tests. Going forward, Bank Indonesia will continue to strengthen policy synergy with the Financial System Stability Committee in maintaining financial system stability, including by mitigating various risks that could disrupt financial system stability.

The performance of digital economic and financial transactions in November 2024 continued to grow thanks to the support of a safe, smooth, and reliable payment system. # Rencana dan Kebijakan Strategis Perusahaan

Company Strategic Plan and Policy

Semakin tingginya tingkat kesadaran masyarakat untuk menyeimbangkan gaya hidup dan kesejahteraan finansial jangka panjang menjadi katalis positif bagi perkembangan bisnis perbankan. Tingginya generasi muda yang berada di usia produktif dan memiliki kesadaran finansial menjadi salah satu faktor yang mendorong pertumbuhan nasabah.

Melihat kondisi ini, Allo Bank selaku bank umum berbasis digital senantiasa memperkuat fondasi bisnis yang dimiliki dan terus berinovasi agar dapat mengoptimalkan momentum pertumbuhan. Dengan didukung kolaborasi ekosistem bisnis yang kuat, pengembangan produk-produk inovatif, serta keamanan yang kuat, Bank berupaya untuk dapat terus hadir menjadi everyday bank yang dapat menjawab segala kebutuhan nasabah.

Di samping itu, Bank telah menetapkan kebijakan strategis dalam mengoptimalkan pertumbuhan bisnis, diantaranya dengan menetapkan langkah-langkah strategis sebagai berikut:

1. Penetrasi pasar berdasarkan model bisnis Hibrida (Hybrid Business Model) dalam menawarkan produk dan layanan segmen Retail dan Wholesale secara terintegrasi untuk menumbuhkan bisnis Bank melalui aktivitas Acquisition, Engagement dan Monetization.
2. Pengembangan layanan digital untuk mencapai portofolio aset dan liabilitas yang berimbang dan berkualitas antara segmen Retail dan Wholesale.
3. Penguatan kapabilitas Ecosystem Banking dalam rangka kolaborasi yang intensif dengan mitra strategis untuk meningkatkan nilai layanan finansial dan daya saing Bank.
4. Optimalisasi kapabilitas data analytics dan Artificial Intelligence (AI) untuk menghasilkan Customer Insight yang efektif dan manajemen risiko yang efisien dalam memberikan layanan finansial yang kontekstual kepada nasabah.
5. Penguatan sistem manajemen layanan yang didukung oleh teknologi sesuai standar best practice IT Service Management (ITSM).
6. Pengembangan talenta DIGITAL untuk mendukung model bisnis Hibrida.
7. Penguatan Good Corporate Governance yang terintegrasi dan berkelanjutan pada proses bisnis dan operasional sebagai komitmen Bank untuk mendukung prinsip-prinsip Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG).

Increased levels of public awareness for balancing lifestyles and long-term financial well-being serves as a positive catalyst for the development of banking as a business. The high number of young people who are of productive age and have financial awareness is one of the factors that has driven customer growth.

Allo Bank, as a digital-based conventional bank, sees these conditions and has always strengthened the foundation of its business and continues to innovate in order to optimize growth momentum. With the support of its strong business ecosystem collaboration, its development of innovative products, and its strong security, the Bank is working to continue to be present as an everyday bank that can answer all customer needs.

In addition, the Bank has also established a strategic policy for optimizing business growth, including by establishing the following strategic steps:

1. Market penetration based on a Hybrid Business Model in offering integrated Retail and Wholesale segment products and services to grow the Bank's business through Acquisition, Engagement and Monetization activities.
2. Development of digital services to achieve a balanced and quality assets and liabilities portfolio between the Retail and Wholesale segments.
3. Strengthening Ecosystem Banking capabilities in the context of intensive collaboration with strategic partners to increase the value of financial services and the Bank's competitiveness.
4. Optimizing data analytics and Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities to produce effective Customer Insight and efficient risk management in providing contextual financial services to customers.
5. Strengthening the service management system supported by technology according to IT Service Management (ITSM) best practice standards.
6. Developing DIGITAL talent to support a Hybrid business model.
7. Strengthening integrated and sustainable Good Corporate Governance in business and operational processes as part of the Bank's commitment to supporting the principles of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG).

# Tinjauan Operasi Per Kegiatan Usaha

## Tinjauan Operasi Per Kegiatan Usaha Operational Review Per Business Activities

Berdasarkan Anggaran Dasar terakhir, Allo Bank menjalankan kegiatan usaha sebagai bank umum dengan pendekatan produk dan layanan perbankan berbasis digital. Sesuai dengan pasal 3 Anggaran Dasar mengenai Maksud dan Tujuan serta Kegiatan Usaha, Bank mengelompokkan kinerja operasionalnya ke dalam 2 (dua) jenis kegiatan berdasarkan produk dan layanan yang dimiliki, yakni kegiatan menghimpun dana dari masyarakat dalam bentuk simpanan (Produk Simpanan) dan kegiatan menyalurkan dana dalam bentuk kredit (Produk Kredit). Adapun kinerja dan profitabilitas masing-masing jenis kegiatan usaha Bank diuraikan sebagai berikut.

## Produk Kredit

Bank memiliki dua mesin pertumbuhan bisnis yaitu segmen Retail Banking dan Wholesale Banking. Dalam segmen Retail Banking, Bank berfokus dalam menyalurkan pinjaman secara digital kepada konsumen retail yang terdiri dari 2 (dua) produk, yaitu Paylater dan Pinjaman Dana Tunai (Instant Cash) dengan proses pengajuan yang dilakukan melalui mobile app Allo Bank. Keputusan kredit dapat dilakukan secara instan sehingga mempermudah nasabah untuk melakukan transaksi menggunakan paylater atau mendapatkan dana pinjaman untuk berbagai kebutuhan. Dalam segmen Wholesale Banking, Bank menyalurkan kredit wholesale kepada nasabah korporasi yang memiliki reputasi dan kualitas baik yang bertujuan untuk pembiayaan modal kerja, investasi dan penjaminan.

## Suku Bunga Dasar Kredit

Suku Bunga Dasar Kredit (SBDK) merupakan dasar penetapan suku bunga kredit yang akan dikenakan kepada nasabah. Allo Bank telah mempublikasikan SBDK dalam mata uang Rupiah sesuai dengan Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) No. 37/POJK.03/2019 tentang Transparansi dan Publikasi Laporan Bank serta Surat Edaran OJK No. 9/SEOJK.03/2020 tentang Transparansi dan Publikasi Laporan Bank Umum Konvensional yang mengatur mengenai transparansi informasi produk bank dan penggunaan data pribadi nasabah.

Based on the latest Articles of Association, Allo Bank carries out business activities as a conventional bank with a digital-based banking product and service approach. In accordance with Article 3 of the Articles of Association concerning the Purpose and Objectives and Business Activities, the Bank groups its operational performance into 2 (two) types of activities based on the products and services it has, namely activities to collect funds from the public in the form of savings (Savings Products) and activities to distribute funds in the form of credit (Credit Products). The performance and profitability of each type of Bank business activity are described as follows.

## Lending Products

The Bank has two business engines, namely the Retail Banking and Wholesale Banking segments. In the Retail Banking segment, the Bank focuses on distributing digital loans to retail consumers consisting of 2 (two) products, namely Paylater and Cash Loans (Instant Cash) with the application process carried out through the Allo Bank mobile app. Credit decisions can be made instantly, making it easier for customers to make transactions using paylater or get loan funds for various needs. In the Wholesale Banking segment, the Bank distributes wholesale credit to corporate customers with a good reputation and quality for the purpose of financing working capital, investment and guarantees.

## Basic Lending Rate

The Basic Lending Rate (SBDK) is the basis for determining the credit interest rate that will be charged to customers. Allo Bank has published its SBDK in Rupiah currency in accordance with Financial Services Authority (OJK) Regulation No. 37/POJK.03/2019 concerning Transparency and Publication of Bank Reports, as well as in accordance with OJK Circular Letter No. 9/SEOJK.03/2020 concerning Transparency and Publication of Conventional Commercial Bank Reports, which regulates the transparency of bank product information and the use of customer personal data.

SBDK yang dipublikasikan oleh Bank belum memperhitungkan komponen estimasi premi risiko mengingat besarannya akan disesuaikan dari penilaian Bank atas risiko masing-masing debitur atau kelompok debitur sehingga besaran suku bunga kredit yang dikenakan belum tentu sama dengan SBDK. Bank senantiasa meninjau dan memperbaharui SBDK sesuai dengan pergerakan suku bunga acuan BI 7-day Reverse Repo Rate (BI7DRR).

Bank mengelompokkan SBDK menjadi 4 (empat) kelompok berdasarkan segmentasi kredit, yaitu Kredit Korporasi, Kredit Ritel, Kredit Mikro, dan Kredit Konsumsi. Seluruh informasi yang lebih rinci mengenai SBDK yang berlaku dapat dilihat pada publikasi di setiap kantor Bank dan/atau situs web resmi Allo Bank di www.allobank.com.

The SBDK published by the Bank has not taken into account the estimated risk premium component. This is due to the fact that the amount will be adjusted from the Bank's assessment of the risk of each debtor or group of debtors so that the amount of credit interest charged is not necessarily the same as the SBDK. The Bank continuously reviews and updates its SBDK in accordance with the movement of the BI 7-day Reverse Repo Rate (BI7DRR) benchmark interest rate.

The Bank groups its SBDK into 4 (four) groups based on credit segmentation, specifically, Corporate Credit, Retail Credit, Micro Credit, and Consumer Credit. More detailed information regarding applicable SBDK can be seen in the publications at each Bank office and/or the official Allo Bank website at www.allobank.com.

## Produk Simpanan

Allo Bank menyediakan produk simpanan berupa penghimpunan dana baik dari nasabah Retail Banking maupun nasabah Wholesale Banking. Dalam hal penghimpunan dana nasabah Retail, Bank menawarkan berbagai produk-produk simpanan berbasis digital, seperti uang elektronik (AlloPay dan AlloPay+), tabungan (Allo Prime dan Allo Grow), dan deposito yang dilakukan melalui mobile app Allo Bank. ## Deposit Products

Allo Bank provides savings products in the form of fund collection from both Retail Banking customers and Wholesale Banking customers. In terms of fund collection from Retail customers, the Bank offers various digital-based savings products, such as electronic money (AlloPay and AlloPay+), savings (Allo Prime and Allo Grow), and deposits made through the Allo Bank mobile app. The Bank also provides current account and deposit products for existing Wholesale Banking customers to conduct operational transactions or related to credit payments.

Pendapatan Bunga Bersih

Pada tahun 2024, Bank membukukan pendapatan bunga bersih sebesar Rp1,118 triliun, meningkat Rp80,7 miliar atau setara dengan 7,79.% dibanding tahun 2023 yang sebesar Rp1,04 triliun. Pendapatan bunga bersih utamanya dikontribusi oleh peningkatan pendapatan bunga dari kredit retail selain dari kredit wholesale.

### Laba Sebelum Pajak

Bank membukukan laba sebelum pajak sebesar Rp599 miliar di tahun 2024, meningkat Rp 23,3 miliar atau 4,04% dibanding tahun sebelumnya sebesar Rp575 miliar. Peningkatan tersebut terutama disebabkan adanya peningkatan kredit dari segmen Retail.

### Laba Setelah Pajak

Per 31 Desember 2024, Bank membukukan laba setelah pajak sebesar Rp467 miliar, meningkat Rp22,5 miliar atau 5,07% jika dibandingkan dengan tahun 2023 yang sebesar Rp445 miliar. Peningkatan tersebut terutama disebabkan adanya peningkatan kredit dari segmen Retail.

### Penghasilan Komprehensif Tahun Berjalan

Penghasilan komprehensif dihitung dengan menambah keuntungan dari perubahan nilai atas instrumen utang yang diukur pada nilai wajar melalui penghasilan komprehensif lain-neto dikurangi pengukuran kembali liabilitas imbalan pasca kerja-neto. Di tahun 2024, jumlah penghasilan komprehensif tahun berjalan adalah sebesar Rp381 miliar, mengalami penurunan Rp103,2 miliar atau 21,3% dibanding tahun sebelumnya sebesar Rp484 miliar. Hal ini disebabkan adanya Perubahan keuntungan yang belum direalisasi atas efek-efek yang diklasifikasikan sebagai nilai wajar melalui pendapatan komprehensif lain

### Laba Per Saham Dasar

Laba per saham dasar dihitung dengan membagi laba tahun berjalan yang tersedia bagi pemegang saham dengan rata-rata tertimbang jumlah saham biasa yang beredar pada tahun bersangkutan. Di tahun 2024, Bank membukukan laba per saham dasar sebesar Rp21,5. atau meningkat sebesar 5,07% dari tahun 2023 Rp20,46. Hal ini sejalan dengan peningkatan Laba Setelah Pajak didorong peningkatan kredit, terutama dari segmen Retail.

### Net Interest Income

In 2024, the Bank recorded net interest income of Rp1.118 trillion, an increase of Rp80.7 billion or equivalent to 7.79% compared to 2023 which was Rp1.04 trillion. Net interest income was mainly contributed by an increase in interest income from retail loans other than wholesale loans.

### Profit Before Tax

The bank posted a profit before tax of Rp599 billion in 2024, an increase of Rp23.3 billion or 4.04% compared to the previous year of Rp575 billion. The increase was mainly due to an increase in credit from the Retail segment.

### Profit After Tax

As of December 31, 2024, the Bank posted a profit after tax of Rp467 billion, an increase of Rp22.5 billion or 5.07% compared to 2023 which was Rp445 billion. The increase/decrease was mainly due to an increase in credit from the Retail segment.

### Comprehensive Income for the Year

Comprehensive income is calculated by adding the gain from changes in the value of debt instruments measured at fair value through other comprehensive income (net) minus the remeasurement of post-employment benefit liabilities (net). In 2024, the amount of comprehensive income for the year was IDR381 billion. This marked an increase/decrease of IDR103.2 billion or 21.3% compared to the previous year's IDR484 billion. This was the result of unrealized gain from changes in fair values through other comprehensive income in securities.

### Basic Earnings Per Share

Basic earnings per share is calculated by dividing current year profit available to shareholders by the weighted average number of ordinary shares outstanding during the year. In 2024, the Bank recorded basic earnings per share of Rp21.5. or an increase of 5.07% from Rp20.46 in 2023. This is in line with the increase in Profit After Tax driven by increased credit, especially from the Retail segment.
