# Kemampuan Membayar Utang dan Tingkat Kolektibilitas Piutang
# Solvency and Receivables Collectability Rate

## Kemampuan Membayar Utang
Bank menggunakan rasio likuiditas, rasio solvabilitas, dan rasio rentabilitas untuk mengukur kemampuannya dalam memenuhi seluruh kewajibannya, baik jangka pendek maupun jangka panjang. Rasio-rasio tersebut menggambarkan kemampuan Bank dalam memenuhi seluruh kewajiban yang akan jatuh tempo secara tepat waktu, baik terhadap pembayaran pokok utang maupun beban bunga.

## Rasio Likuiditas
Bank menggunakan rasio likuiditas untuk mengukur kemampuannya dalam memenuhi kewajiban jangka pendek. Rasio likuiditas sendiri terdiri dari rasio kas dan setara kas terhadap liabilitas, di mana rasio tersebut tercatat sebesar 43,80% di tahun 2024 atau mengalami peningkatan jika dibandingkan dengan tahun 2023 yang sebesar 31,60% yang menggambarkan kondisi likuiditas Bank yang terjaga dengan baik.

## Rasio Solvabilitas
Bank menggunakan rasio solvabilitas untuk mengukur kemampuannya dalam memenuhi seluruh kewajiban, baik jangka pendek maupun jangka panjang. Rasio solvabilitas ini tercermin dari Rasio Permodalan atau Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) yang tercatat berada di posisi 82,58% pada tahun 2024. Capaian ini juga menunjukkan bahwa rasio permodalan Bank telah melebihi ketentuan batas minimal yang diterapkan oleh regulator. Rasio ini masih sangat memadai dan dinilai mampu menyerap potensi kerugian yang dihadapi.

## Solvency
The Bank uses liquidity ratios, solvency ratios, and profitability ratios to measure its ability to meet all of its short-term and long-term obligations. These ratios describe the Bank's ability to meet all maturing obligations on time, both for principal payments and interest expenses.

## Liquidity Ratios
The Bank uses liquidity ratios to measure its ability to meet short-term obligations. The liquidity ratio itself consists of the ratio of cash and cash equivalents to liabilities. The ratio was recorded at 43.80% in 2024 or increased compared to 2023 which was 31.60% which illustrates the Bank's well-maintained liquidity conditions.

## Solvency Ratio
Banks use solvency ratios to measure their ability to meet all obligations, both short-term and long-term. This solvency ratio is reflected in the Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) which was recorded at 82.58% in 2024. This achievement also shows that the Bank's capital ratio has exceeded the minimum limit set by the regulator. This ratio is still very adequate and is considered capable of absorbing potential losses faced.

# Rasio Rentabilitas

Bank mengukur kemampuannya dalam menghasilkan laba pada periode tertentu dengan menggunakan rasio rentabilitas. Rentabilitas tercermin dari Rasio Imbal Hasil atas Aset (ROA) dan Rasio Imbal Hasil atas Ekuitas (ROE). Di tahun 2024, ROA dan ROE Bank masing-masing tercatat sebesar 4,48% dan 6,78%, di mana capaian tersebut mengalami peningkatan jika dibanding tahun 2023 yang sebesar 4,76% dan 6,70% selaras dengan peningkatan kinerja keseluruhan dan laba bersih setelah pajak.

# Tingkat Kolektibilitas Piutang

Bank mengukur kemampuannya dalam menagih piutang yang dimiliki melalui rasio kualitas aset Bank yang terdiri dari Rasio NPL Gross dan NPL Net. Dalam mengukur rasio tersebut, semakin kecil nilai rasionya, maka menunjukkan semakin baik pula kemampuan Bank dalam mengumpulkan piutangnya.

Di tahun 2024, NPL Gross Bank tercatat sebesar 0,81% atau mengalami peningkatan dari tahun 2023 yang sebesar 0,08%. Sementara, NPL Net Bank di tahun 2024 adalah sebesar 0,40%, meningkat dari tahun sebelumnya yang sebesar 0,05%. Kenaikan ini mencerminkan peningkatan kredit segmen Retail melalui aplikasi digital, namun secara keseluruhan kualitas kredit tetap terjaga dengan baik.

# Dampak Adanya Perubahan Kinerja Bank

Secara keseluruhan, bisnis inti Allo Bank tetap kuat seperti tercermin pada perolehan Total Pendapatan Bank sebesar Rp1,440 triliun selama tahun 2024, dimana pencapaian tersebut mengalami peningkatan sebesar 25% dibanding tahun 2023 yang tercatat sebesar Rp1,153 triliun, didorong oleh peningkatan yang sehat pada pendapatan bunga bersih dan pendapatan operasional lainnya.

Dari sisi Biaya Operasional, sebagai Bank umum berbasis digital Allo Bank banyak melakukan pengembangan Teknologi Informasi untuk mendukung strategi pengembangan produk, layanan dan customer engagement/experience (Good Costs). Di samping itu, Bank juga terus mengoptimalkan program marketing dan promosi untuk akuisisi dan engagement untuk meningkatkan top of mind Bank di mata nasabah. Dengan demikian, biaya operasional mengalami kenaikan 36% dari Rp548 miliar pada tahun 2023 menjadi Rp743 miliar pada tahun 2024.

Didorong faktor-faktor di atas, laba tahun berjalan tercatat sebesar Rp467 miliar per tahun 2024, meningkat sedikit sebesar 5% dibanding tahun 2023 yang tercatat sebesar Rp445 miliar.

Bank senantiasa berinisiatif untuk menyusun strategi, target jangka pendek dan jangka panjang dalam rangka mengembangkan skala bisnis Bank sebagai tolak ukur keberhasilan performa dengan menciptakan keunggulan-keunggulan kompetitif untuk menjadi bank umum berbasis digital terdepan

# Profitability Ratio

The Bank measures its ability to generate profits in a certain period using the profitability ratio. Profitability is reflected in the Return on Assets (ROA) Ratio and Return on Equity (ROE) Ratio. In 2024, the Bank's ROA and ROE were recorded at 4.48% and 6.78% respectively, where this achievement increased compared to 2023 which was 4.76% and 6.70% in line with the increase in overall performance and net profit after tax.

# Receivables Collectibility Ratio

The Bank measures its ability to collect receivables through the Bank's asset quality ratio consisting of its Gross NPL Ratio and Net NPL. In measuring this ratio, the smaller the ratio value, the better the Bank's ability to collect its receivables.

In 2024, the Bank's Gross NPL was recorded at 0.81% or an increase from 2023 which was 0.08%. Meanwhile, the Bank's Net NPL in 2024 was 0.40%, an increase from the previous year which was 0.05%. This increase reflects an increase in Retail segment credit through digital applications, but overall credit quality remains well maintained.

# Impact of Changes in Bank Performance

Overall, Allo Bank's core business remains strong as reflected in the Bank's Total Income of IDR1,440 trillion during 2024, where this achievement has increased by 25% compared to 2023 which was recorded at IDR1,153 trillion, driven by a healthy increase in net interest income and other operating income.

In terms of Operating Costs, as a digital-based general bank, Allo Bank has carried out a lot of Information Technology development to support product development strategies, services and customer engagement/experience (Good Costs). In addition, the Bank also continues to optimize marketing and promotion programs for acquisition and engagement to increase the Bank's top of mind in the eyes of customers. Thus, operating costs increased by 36% from IDR548 billion in 2023 to IDR743 billion in 2024.

Driven by the above factors, profit for the year was recorded at IDR467 billion per year in 2024, increasing slightly by 5% compared to 2023 which was recorded at IDR445 billion.

The Bank always takes the initiative to develop strategies, short-term and long-term targets in order to develop the Bank's business scale as a benchmark for performance success by creating competitive advantages to become a leading digital-based conventional bank.

# Struktur Modal dan Kebijakan Manajemen atas Struktur Modal

# Capital Structure and Management Policy on Capital Structure

## Kebijakan Struktur Modal

Allo Bank senantiasa mengelola struktur permodalan dengan tujuan untuk memastikan bahwa Bank memiliki modal kuat untuk mendukung strategi yang diterapkan saat ini dan mempertahankan kelangsungan pengembangan di masa mendatang. Kebijakan ini juga bertujuan untuk memenuhi ketentuan kecukupan permodalan yang ditetapkan oleh regulator serta memastikan efisiensi struktur permodalan Bank. Untuk itu, Bank senantiasa melakukan perencanaan struktur modal berdasarkan penilaian dan penelaahan atas kebutuhan permodalan yang dipersyaratkan dan mengkombinasikannya dengan kondisi ekonomi yang terjadi.

Rencana permodalan yang disusun oleh Direksi menjadi bagian dari Rencana Bisnis Bank (RBB) yang selanjutnya disetujui oleh Dewan Komisaris. Rencana permodalan Bank disusun berdasarkan penilaian atas kecukupan kebutuhan permodalan yang dipersyaratkan, rencana pengembangan usaha, serta kebutuhan likuiditas Bank.

## Dasar Pemilihan Struktur Modal

Pengelolaan struktur modal Bank senantiasa mengacu pada Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (POJK) No. 11/POJK.03/2016 tentang Kewajiban Penyediaan Modal Minimum Bank Umum yang menetapkan struktur modal paling rendah sebesar 9%-14% dari ATMR sesuai dengan Tingkat Profil Risiko. Berdasarkan penilaian internal, Direksi menetapkan Rasio Penyediaan Modal Minimum (KPMM) Bank adalah sebesar 9,90% atau memenuhi ketentuan yang berlaku.

## Capital Structure Policy

Allo Bank always manages its capital structure with the aim of ensuring that the Bank has strong capital to support its current strategy and maintain the continuity of future development. This policy also aims to meet capital adequacy requirements set by regulators and to ensure the efficiency of the Bank's capital structure. For this reason, the Bank always plans its capital structure based on an assessment and review of the required capital requirements and combines them with the current economic conditions.

The capital plan prepared by the Board of Directors has become part of the Bank's Business Plan (RBB), which is then approved by the Board of Commissioners. The Bank's capital plan is prepared based on an assessment of the adequacy of required capital requirements, business development plans, and the Bank's liquidity needs.

## Basis for Selecting Capital Structure

The management of the Bank's capital structure uses Financial Services Authority Regulation (POJK) No. 11/POJK.03/2016 concerning the Minimum Capital Provision Obligation for Commercial Banks as a reference. It stipulates a minimum capital structure of 9%-14% of Risk Weighted Assets in accordance with the Bank's Risk Profile Level. Based on internal assessments, the Board of Directors has set the Bank's Minimum Capital Provision Ratio (KPMM) at 9,90%, which meets applicable provisions.

# Prospek Usaha
Business Prospects

Sebagaimana dikutip dari Buku Pertemuan tahunan Bank Indonesia 2024 yang dirilis pada 29 November 2024, menjelaskan bahwa proses pemulihan ekonomi Indonesia terus berlanjut pada 2024 dengan pertumbuhan yang tetap baik dan diperkirakan akan lebih tinggi pada 2025 dan 2026. Pertumbuhan ekonomi hingga triwulan 2024 cukup baik didukung oleh permintaan domestik. Investasi tetap membaik, khususnya investasi bangunan sejalan dengan penyelesaian berbagai Proyek Strategis Nasional (PSN). Konsumsi rumah tangga, khususnya kelas menengah ke atas, tetap terjaga. Ekspor nonmigas tumbuh relatif tinggi di tengah perlambatan ekonomi global dan penurunan harga komoditas.

Indonesia's economic recovery process continued in 2024 with good growth that is expected to reach greater heights in 2025 and 2026, as quoted from the Bank Indonesia 2024 Annual Meeting Book released on November 29, 2024. Economic growth until the fourth quarter of 2024 was quite good thanks to domestic demand. Investment continued to improve, especially building investment in line with the completion of various National Strategic Projects. Household consumption, especially within the upper middle class, remained well-maintained. Non-oil and gas exports grew relatively high amid global economic slowdown and falling commodity prices.

2024 Annual Report & Sustainability Report

Sementara itu, impor meningkat baik untuk kebutuhan ekspor maupun permintaan domestik, dan karenanya menyebabkan penurunan pertumbuhan ekonomi. Pada triwulan IV 2024, pertumbuhan ekonomi diperkirakan tetap baik ditopang terutama oleh kenaikan investasi dan terjaganya konsumsi rumah tangga, serta peningkatan belanja Pemerintah pada akhir tahun.

Secara keseluruhan tahun, pertumbuhan ekonomi 2024 berada pada 5,03% dan diperkirakan akan meningkat lebih tinggi pada 2025 dan 2026 masing-masing dalam kisaran 4,8-5,6% dan 4,9-5,7%. Ke depan, berbagai upaya perlu terus ditempuh untuk mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi, baik dari sisi permintaan maupun dari sisi penawaran. Untuk itu, Bank Indonesia memperkuat bauran kebijakan untuk mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi agar lebih tinggi, dan bersinergi erat dengan kebijakan stimulus fiskal Pemerintah. Dari sisi penawaran, kebijakan reformasi struktural perlu terus diperkuat untuk mendorong sektor ekonomi yang dapat menyerap tenaga kerja. Upaya tersebut didukung dengan optimalisasi stimulus kebijakan makroprudensial dan akselerasi digitalisasi transaksi pembayaran yang ditempuh Bank Indonesia.

Di sisi lain, likuiditas perbankan tetap longgar sejalan dengan kebijakan Bank Indonesia, sementara likuiditas perekonomian sesuai dengan aktivitas di sektor riil. Likuiditas dapat diukur jumlahnya di sektor perbankan dan yang beredar di perekonomian. Likuiditas perekonomian biasa diukur dengan jumlah uang beredar, baik dalam arti sempit untuk kebutuhan transaksi konsumsi (Uang Primer, M0) maupun dalam arti luas yang juga termasuk simpanan (Uang Beredar, M1, dan M2). Karenanya, kondisi likuiditas perekonomian akan mencerminkan tingkat pertumbuhan ekonomi secara nominal.

Kondisi likuiditas perekonomian tentunya akan naik apabila pertumbuhan ekonomi riil meningkat. Sementara itu, likuiditas perbankan merupakan aktivitas likuid yang belum dipergunakan dalam penyaluran kredit, yang disimpan dalam bentuk kas, dan diinvestasikan dalam surat-surat berharga sebagai bagian dari strategi portofolio aset bank. Ini biasa diukur dengan rasio Alat Likuid/Dana Pihak Ketiga (AL/DPK), Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), dan Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR). Alat likuid dimaksud berasal dari akumulasi pengumpulan dana baik dari DPK, penerbitan surat berharga, dan pinjaman luar negeri. Sebagai akumulasi dana yang belum disalurkan ke kredit, maka ukurannya dapat pula dengan rasio Loan-to-Deposit (LDR) dan tidak tepat dengan pertumbuhan DPK. Kondisi likuiditas bank per bank tentunya ditentukan oleh seberapa bank yang bersangkutan prudent dalam pengelolaan likuiditas dan penyaluran kreditnya.

Faktor-faktor eksternal yang menjadi evaluasi manajemen Allo Bank meliputi kondisi politik, ekonomi, sosial, teknologi, hukum, ekologi dan etika. Selain itu, Bank juga melakukan evaluasi terhadap ketentuan baik yang telah berlaku maupun akan berlaku dari pemerintah dan regulator. Faktor dinamika pasar berupa perubahan kebutuhan nasabah serta perkembangan industri perbankan tentunya menjadi salah satu fokus Bank untuk dapat menyampaikan produk dan layanan secara tepat kepada target pasar yang ditentukan.

Meanwhile, imports increased both for export needs and domestic demand. This caused a decline in economic growth. In the fourth quarter of 2024, economic growth remained good thanks to the support of increased investment and maintained household consumption, as well as increased government spending at the end of the year.

Overall, economic growth in 2024 is at 5.03% and is expected to increase higher in 2025 and 2026 in the range of 4.8-5.6% and 4.9-5.7% respectively. Going forward, various efforts need to be continuously taken to encourage economic growth, both from the demand side and from the supply side. To that end, Bank Indonesia is strengthening its policy mix to encourage higher economic growth, and in close synergy with the Government's fiscal stimulus policy. From the supply side, structural reform policies need to be continuously strengthened to encourage economic sectors that can absorb labor. These efforts are supported by the optimization of macroprudential policy stimulus and the acceleration of digitalization of payment transactions taken by Bank Indonesia.

On the other hand, banking liquidity remained loose in line with Bank Indonesia's policy, while economic liquidity was in accordance with activities in the real sector. Liquidity can be measured in terms of the amount in the banking sector and that circulating in the economy. Economic liquidity is usually measured by the amount of money in circulation, both in the narrow sense for consumption transaction needs (Primary Money, M0) and in the broad sense which also includes savings (Money in Circulation, M1, and M2). As a result, the condition of economic liquidity will reflect the level of economic growth in nominal terms.

The condition of economic liquidity will certainly increase if real economic growth increases. Meanwhile, banking liquidity is a liquid activity that has not been used in credit distribution, which is stored in cash, and invested in securities as part of a bank's asset portfolio strategy. This is usually measured by the Liquid Assets/Third Party Funds (AL/DPK) ratio, Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), and Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR). The liquid assets in question come from the accumulation of funds collected from Third Party Funds, the issuance of securities, and foreign loans. As an accumulation of funds that have not been channeled to credit, its measurement can also be done by the Loan-to-Deposit (LDR) ratio and is not exactly the same as Third Party Fund growth. The liquidity conditions of each bank are of course determined by how prudent the bank in question is in managing its liquidity and distributing credit.

External factors that are evaluated by Allo Bank management include political, economic, social, technological, legal, ecological and ethical conditions. In addition, the Bank also evaluates the provisions that have been in effect or will be in effect from the government and regulators. Market dynamics factors in the form of changes in customer needs and the development of the banking industry are certainly one of the Bank's focuses that need to be taken into consideration to be able to deliver products and services appropriately to the specified target market.

# Kebijakan Dividen dan Pembagiannya

## Kebijakan Pembagian Dividen

Pembayaran dividen yang dilakukan oleh Bank dilakukan sesuai dengan Undang-Undang No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas dan kebijakan internal mengenai pembagian dividen. Mengacu pada Pasal 71 ayat 3 Undang-Undang No. 40 Tahun 2007, Anggaran Dasar Bank dan kebijakan internal, Bank dapat membagikan dividen kepada pemegang saham apabila Bank memiliki saldo laba yang positif dan sesuai dengan kemampuan keuangan perusahaan, berdasarkan ketentuan yang berlaku. Rencana pembagian dividen didasarkan atas pemenuhan hak pemegang saham dengan mengutamakan kepentingan Bank tanpa mengabaikan sejumlah faktor, seperti tingkat kesehatan keuangan, tingkat kecukupan modal, serta kebutuhan dana untuk ekspansi usaha tanpa mengurangi hak dari RUPS untuk menentukan lain sesuai dengan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar.

## Dividend Policy and Distribution

## Dividend Distribution Policy

The Bank's dividend payments are made in accordance with Law No. 40 of 2007 concerning Limited Liability Companies and internal policies regarding dividend distribution. With reference to Article 71 Paragraph 3 of Law No. 40 of 2007, and with reference to the Bank's Articles of Association and internal policies, the Bank may distribute dividends to shareholders if the Bank has a positive profit balance and is in accordance with the company's financial capabilities on the basis of applicable provisions. The dividend distribution plan is based on the fulfillment of shareholder rights by prioritizing the interests of the Bank without ignoring a number of factors, such as the Bank's level of financial health, the level of capital adequacy, and the need for funds for business expansion without reducing the rights of the GMS to determine otherwise in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association.

# Informasi Transaksi Material yang Mengandung Benturan Kepentingan dan/atau Transaksi dengan Pihak Afiliasi/Pihak Berelasi

## Kebijakan Mekanisme Review atas Transaksi dan Pemenuhan Peraturan dan Ketentuan Terkait

Bank telah memiliki kebijakan terkait transaksi yang mengandung benturan kepentingan dan/atau transaksi dengan pihak berelasi. Bank melakukan seluruh transaksi dengan pihak afiliasi dengan memperhatikan prinsip kehati-hatian sesuai dengan praktik bisnis yang berlaku umum serta telah memenuhi Peraturan OJK No. 42/POJK.04/2020 tentang Transaksi Afiliasi dan Transaksi Benturan Kepentingan dan PSAK No. 7 tentang Pengungkapan Pihak-pihak Berelasi.

Direksi senantiasa memastikan seluruh kegiatan transaksi afiliasi yang dilakukan telah melalui proses yang memadai sesuai dengan prinsip transaksi yang wajar (arm's length principle). Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Audit juga telah melakukan review untuk memastikan bahwa transaksi afiliasi dilaksanakan sesuai dengan praktik bisnis yang berlaku umum dan telah memenuhi prinsip transaksi yang wajar (arm's length principle). Mekanisme review atas transaksi dengan pihak afiliasi dan/atau pihak berelasi dilakukan melalui proses audit oleh Satuan Kerja Audit Internal yang hasilnya kemudian dilaporkan kepada Dewan Komisaris.

Hingga 31 Desember 2024, Bank tidak memiliki transaksi yang mengandung benturan kepentingan yang bersifat material dan berdampak terhadap kinerja keuangan dan kinerja operasional.

## Information on Material Transactions Containing Conflicts of Interest and/or Transactions with Affiliated Parties/Related Parties

## Policy on Review Mechanisms for Transactions and Compliance with Related Regulations and Provisions

The Bank has a policy related to transactions containing conflicts of interest and/or transactions with related parties. The Bank carries out all transactions with affiliated parties by observing the principle of prudence in accordance with generally accepted business practices. It has also complied with OJK Regulation No. 42/POJK.04/2020 concerning Affiliated Transactions and Conflict of Interest Transactions and PSAK No. 7 concerning Disclosure of Related Parties.

The Board of Directors always ensures that all affiliated transaction activities carried out have gone through an adequate process in accordance with the Arm's Length Principle. The Board of Commissioners and the Audit Committee have also conducted a review to ensure that affiliated transactions are carried out in accordance with generally accepted business practices and have complied with the arm's length principle. The review mechanism for transactions with affiliated parties and/or related parties is carried out through an audit process by the Internal Audit Work Unit, the results of which are then reported to the Board of Commissioners.

As of December 31, 2024, the Bank has had no transactions containing material conflicts of interest that have had any impact on financial performance and operational performance.

Perhryataan Direksi terkait Prinsip Transaksi yang Wajar (Arm's Length Principle)

Direksi berkomitmen memegang prinsip arm's length principle (ALP) selaku prinsip yang mengatur bahwa apabila kondisi dalam transaksi yang dilakukan antara pihak yang mempunyai Hubungan Istimewa sama atau sebanding dengan kondisi dalam transaksi yang dilakukan antara pihak yang tidak mempunyai hubungan Istimewa yang menjadi pembanding, maka harga atau laba dalam transaksi yang dilakukan antara pihak-pihak yang mempunyai Hubungan Istimewa harus sama dengan atau berada dalam rentang harga atau laba dalam transaksi yang dilakukan antara pihak yang tidak mempunyai Hubungan Istimewa yang menjadi pembanding. Pada prinsipnya, berdasarkan pada norma bahwa harga atau laba atas transaksi yang dilakukan dengan pihak afiliasi ditentukan oleh kekuatan pasar, sehingga transaksi tersebut dapat mencerminkan harga pasar yang wajar (Fair Market Value/FMV).

Peran Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Audit dalam Memenuhi Prinsip Transaksi yang Wajar (Arm's Length Principle)

Dewan Komisaris bersama dengan Komite Audit berkomitmen memegang prinsip arm's length principle (ALP). Mekanisme review Bank atas transaksi dengan Pihak-pihak Berelasi dilakukan melalui proses audit, khususnya audit yang telah dilakukan oleh akuntan publik dan dipublikasikan, dimana mekanisme ini tertuang dalam PSAK 7 (revisi 2014) tentang “Pengungkapan Pihak-pihak Berelasi”. Pada prinsipnya, berdasarkan pada norma bahwa harga atau laba atas transaksi yang dilakukan dengan pihak afiliasi ditentukan oleh kekuatan pasar, sehingga transaksi tersebut dapat mencerminkan harga pasar yang wajar (Fair Market Value/FMV).

Board of Directors Statement on the Arm's Length Principle

The Board of Directors is committed to upholding the Arm's Length Principle (ALP). This principle specifically regulates situations involving transactions conducted between parties with special relationships. If requires that any price or profits made between these parties have to be either the same or within the price or profit range of transactions conducted between parties that don't have any kind of special relationship with one another. This principle is based on the idea that prices or profits generated within these transactions with special relationships have to reflect Fair Market Value (FMV).

Board of Commissioners and the Audit Committee's Role in Fulfilling the Arm's Length Principle

The Board of Commissioners works together with the Audit Committee to uphold the Arm's Length Principle (ALP). The Bank's review mechanism for any sort of transactions with Related Parties is carried out through an audit process. Specifically, this process involves a public accountant tasked with carrying out the audit. This mechanism is stated in Statement of Financial Accounting Standards (PSAK) 7 (which was revised in 2014) concerning “Related Party Disclosures”. This principle is based on the idea that prices or profits generated within these transactions with special relationships have to reflect Fair Market Value (FMV).

## Hal-Hal yang Berpotensi Berpengaruh Signifikan terhadap Kelangsungan Usaha

Kondisi ekonomi dan industri yang masih fluktuatif di tahun 2024 berpotensi mempengaruhi kinerja Bank. Berlanjutnya kebijakan tingkat suku bunga acuan yang tinggi dari Bank Indonesia (BI) untuk menjaga tingkat inflasi nasional menjadi salah satu faktor yang dapat menekan kinerja Bank. Persaingan industri yang ketat juga mengharuskan Bank untuk terus beradaptasi dan berinovasi secara cepat agar dapat menjaga kelangsungan usaha Bank.

Berbekal fondasi bisnis yang solid dan ekosistem CT Corpora yang kuat, Bank optimis bahwa seluruh keunggulan yang dimiliki dapat mengoptimalkan kinerjanya dalam mengatasi berbagai tantangan ke depan. Pengembangan produk dan layanan, serta perluasan jangkauan melalui digitalisasi yang dimiliki diyakini mampu mengakselerasi kinerja Bank agar dapat meningkatkan kinerja bisnis dan menghadirkan solusi perbankan bagi masyarakat.

## Assessment Manajemen atas Hal-hal yang Berpengaruh Signifikan terhadap Kelangsungan Usaha

Bank telah menyusun dan menerapkan manajemen risiko secara cermat, mulai dari penetapan sejumlah risiko utama hingga upaya mitigasinya. Selain itu, manajemen Bank juga melakukan evaluasi dan assessment terkait hal-hal yang berpengaruh signifikan terhadap kelangsungan usaha Bank. Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi turut berperan dalam berbagai upaya untuk mengelola potensi risiko yang berpengaruh signifikan terhadap kelangsungan usaha Bank. Assessment manajemen dilakukan dengan memperhatikan berbagai faktor, seperti analisis kekuatan kondisi keuangan Bank maupun operasional. Berdasarkan hasil assessment tersebut, manajemen tidak mendapati adanya hal-hal yang berpengaruh signifikan terhadap kelangsungan usaha Allo Bank.

## Matters That Have the Potential to Significantly Impact Business Continuity

Ongoing fluctuations in economic and industrial conditions that continued throughout 2024 had the potential to affect the Bank's performance. Bank Indonesia's (BI) High benchmark interest rate policy continued to maintain the nation's inflation rate and served as one of the factors that could have led to a suppression of the Bank's performance. Tight competition within the industry meant that the Bank had to continue to be quick in adapting and innovating in order to maintain its own business continuity.

Thanks to its solid business foundations and its robust CT Corpora ecosystem, the Bank is optimistic that it can optimize its performance in overcoming any challenges ahead. The Bank believes that its efforts toward product and service development, as well as its efforts to expand its reach through digitalization, can help to accelerate its business performance and provide the community with banking solutions.

## Management's Assessment of Matters that Significantly Influence Business Continuity

The Bank has made careful efforts to design and implement proper risk management. Its actions towards this end began with the Bank determining its primary risks to know what it needs to mitigate. The Bank's management has also conducted evaluations and assessments for all matters that could have significantly influenced its business continuity. The Board of Commissioners and Directors also play a role in various efforts designed to manage potential risks that could have significantly influenced the Bank's business continuity. The management's assessments were carried out by taking various factors into consideration. This was done through analysis of the Bank's financial strength and operational conditions. Based on the results of its assessment, the Bank's management did not find any matters that could have significantly influenced Allo Bank's business continuity.

# Risiko Kredit

Risiko Kredit adalah risiko yang timbul sebagai akibat kegagalan counterparty memenuhi liabilitasnya. Bank melakukan pengelolaan risiko kredit dengan menyusun strategi dan kerangka kerja serta menjalankan upaya mitigasi risiko atas aspek bisnis perkreditan mikro, retail, komersial, maupun konsumsi, penempatan antar-bank serta pembelian surat berharga.

# 1. Tata Kelola Risiko

Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi memiliki pemahaman yang baik untuk melakukan pengawasan secara aktif terhadap manajemen perkreditan. Tugas dan wewenang Direksi dioptimalkan melalui tanggung jawab atas penyusunan rencana dan kebijakan perkreditan, memastikan kepatuhan Bank terhadap ketentuan undang-undang dan peraturan yang berlaku, serta melakukan pelaporan secara berkala kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai pelaksanaan pemberian kredit, memitigasi setiap potensi risiko kredit, pengawasan terhadap penyimpangan dalam pemberian kredit, dan upaya terus meningkatkan kualitas kredit Bank.

Dalam melakukan proses pemberian kredit, Bank mengacu kepada aturan regulator dan prinsip kehatian dalam menilai kualitas debitur sebelum pemberian kredit dilakukan. Proses penilaian tersebut dilakukan dengan melihat faktor prospek usaha debitur, cashflow debitur, dan kemampuan membayar debitur.

In general, the composite rating of PT Allo Bank Indonesia, Tbk., hereinafter referred to as the "Bank," for its Risk Profile as of December 2024 remains at Rank 2. This assessment is consistent with the rating from September 2024, which was also Rank 2. As of December 2024, the Bank has made continuous efforts across various aspects to maintain its composite Risk Profile at Rank 2.

Using a self-assessment approach, the results of the calculation of Inherent Risk, Quality of Risk Management Implementation, and Inherent Risk Rating reflect the Bank's strong commitment to risk management. In December 2024, in terms of income, the Bank increased its organic income from the credit process, as well as its earnings from other productive assets, particularly in the retail business segment. The Bank's capital adequacy as of December 2024 complies with applicable regulations and aligns with its strategic objectives.

The Quality of Risk Management Implementation (KPMR) is entirely rated as "Satisfactory," with the Bank continuously addressing existing weaknesses and committing to further improvements to maintain this rating.

# Credit Risk

Credit Risk is any risk that arises as a result of a counterparty's failure to fulfill its obligations. The Bank manages credit risk by developing various strategies and frameworks and by implementing risk mitigation efforts for aspects of its micro, retail, commercial, and consumer credit business, as well as for its inter-bank placements and purchases of securities.

# 1. Risk Governance

The Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors both understand the importance of actively supervising credit management. The Board of Directors' duties and authorities towards this end are optimized through its efforts in preparing credit plans and policies, through ensuring the Bank's compliance with applicable laws and regulations, and through reporting periodically to the Board of Commissioners on any matter related to the implementation of credit provisions. The board also works to mitigate any potential credit risk, supervises deviations in credit provision, and makes efforts to continuously improve the Bank's credit quality.

In carrying out its credit granting process, the Bank uses various regulations and the principle of prudence as references in its efforts towards assessing the quality of debtors before granting them credit. Its assessment process is carried out by looking at the debtor's business prospects, debtor cash flow, and their ability to pay.

Risiko Pasar

Risiko pasar merupakan risiko yang timbul dari portofolio yang dimiliki oleh Bank karena adanya pergerakan adverse movement di pasar, termasuk risiko suku bunga dan risiko nilai tukar, yang berpotensi merugikan Bank. Market Risk

Market risk is defined as any risk that arises from the Bank's portfolio due to adverse movements in the market. These risks include interest rate risks and exchange rate risks that have the potential to harm the Bank. The Bank itself is a Non-Foreign Exchange Bank that does not conduct trading activities either in asset portfolios or liabilities for derivative products and Fair Value Options. It remains committed to always monitoring the potential for Market Risk and is always continuing to improve its Quality of Market Risk Management Implementation by periodically reviewing the quality of its documents.

1. Risk Governance

In addition, market risk management is supported by a framework of limits and policies to control any risks considered acceptable to the Bank. Market risk limits are allocated at various levels and are monitored by the Treasury Division on a daily basis. The Bank is not significantly exposed to exchange rate risk. The interest rate risk managed by the Bank is mostly derived from banking book positions. There are no trading book positions. As part of its market risk management, the Bank identifies, measures, monitors and controls market risk. This process is carried out by relevant business units.

# Liquidity Risk

Liquidity risk may arise as a result of a mismatch between the Bank's asset and liability structure. The Bank may be at risk of not being able to meet maturing obligations from cash flow funding sources and/or from high-quality liquid assets that can be liquidated immediately and/or collateralized without disrupting the Bank's financial activities. If this happens, the Bank maintains liquidity risk assessment ratios and its outstanding liquid asset value and supporting ratios such as Primary Liquid Assets and Secondary Liquid Assets to Total Assets. The LCR and NSFR ratios are maintained above regulatory minimum limits, while the use of funds is always carried out optimally while also still taking into consideration any provisions of the Financial Services Authority/ Bank Indonesia when it comes to the principle of prudence. The Bank also ensures that it has an adequate contingency funding plan as a way of mitigating any potential liquidity risks that may arise.

1. Risk Governance

In addition to its primary reserves, the Bank also maintains and preserves secondary reserves to ensure its liquidity is at a safe level. The availability of these reserves is monitored daily, weekly and monthly by the Treasury Division.

# 2. Kerangka Manajemen Risiko

Bank memiliki Kebijakan Manajemen Risiko Strategik dan proses manajemen Risiko Strategik berfungsi untuk mengidentifikasi, mengukur, memantau, dan mengendalikan Risiko Strategik. Bank telah menetapkan pencapaian target bank dalam Rencana Bisnis Bank dengan mempertimbangkan risk limit (risk appetite dan risk tolerance) yang telah disepakati.

# 4. Risk Control System

The Bank's internal control system runs quite effectively in supporting Operational risk management. The Bank continues to improve its processes and internal controls so that they are more efficient in accordance with best practices and in accordance with the Bank's business direction.

Independent reviews are carried out by the Internal Audit Work Unit based on a methodology that has results reported to the Board of Commissioners and Directors. Follow-up actions to independent reviews have been carried out through the creation of a completion target.

# Strategic Risk

Strategic risk is defined as any risk caused by things such as inappropriate Bank strategies, inconsistent business plan decision-making or the Bank's lack of responsiveness to external changes.

# 1. Risk Governance

The Board of Commissioners carries out active supervision by providing direction to the Board of Directors by way of recommendations submitted at Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors Meetings in accordance with applicable provisions. The Bank manages strategic risk through a process of careful consideration and decision-making of each strategic policy by the Board of Directors. The management of strategic risk is closely related to preparing a coordinated work plan, both for the long term and the short term. The Bank's strategy is formulated by taking into consideration Bank Indonesia/Financial Services Authority regulations/other related provisions and by taking into account the impact of strategic risk on the Bank's capital.

The Bank's Business Plan is prepared in accordance with conditions and optimal capabilities for the utilization of resources (in terms of financial resources, infrastructure and human resources owned). It is through this strategic planning that the Bank believes that it can maintain sustainable growth that can increase the company's value. To minimize deviations in the implementation of this plan, achievements are monitored through the Risk Management Committee, and communication has been carried out to every level of the organization, both during the preparation of this plan and during reviews carried out routinely every semester.

# 2. Risk Management Framework

The Bank has a Strategic Risk Management Policy and a Strategic Risk Management process that functions to identify, measure, monitor, and control Strategic Risk. The Bank has set the achievement of its targets in the Bank's Business Plan by taking into consideration the agreed risk limits (risk appetite and risk tolerance).

# Risiko Hukum

Risiko hukum adalah risiko yang disebabkan oleh adanya kelemahan aspek yuridis, yang antara lain berupa tuntutan hukum, ketiadaan peraturan perundang-undangan yang mendukung atau kelemahan perikatan seperti tidak terpenuhinya syarat sah kontrak dan pengikatan agunan yang tidak sempurna.

## 1. Tata Kelola Risiko

Pengelolaan risiko hukum dilaksanakan di bawah koordinasi unit kerja yang menjalankan Divisi Legal, yang bertindak sebagai "legal watch" dan bertanggung jawab memberikan legal advice sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan permintaan dari unit kerja, yang dinilai akan memiliki legal impact berdasarkan hasil analisa dari unit kerja yang mengajukan. Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi memiliki pemahaman dan kepedulian yang baik mengenai manajemen risiko hukum.

## 2. Kerangka Manajemen Risiko

Strategi pengelolaan risiko hukum yang dilakukan Bank ditujukan untuk mengantisipasi timbulnya risiko hukum dan meminimalkan dampaknya. Dalam struktur organisasi, Bank sudah memiliki Divisi Hukum secara khusus untuk menunjang pelaksanaan proses manajemen risiko hukum dan adanya Divisi Legal menjadi kunci dalam mengelola dan melakukan mitigasi risiko hukum sehingga dapat memberikan perlindungan hukum dalam melaksanakan kegiatan perbankan dengan tetap memperhatikan ketentuan hukum yang berlaku.

Bank telah memiliki kebijakan dan prosedur yang memadai dalam proses manajemen risiko hukum, dimana strategi penanganan masalah hukum ditangani oleh Divisi Legal pada masalah yang sifatnya umum dan untuk hal yang spesifik terkait perkreditan dibantu oleh unit kerja Admin Kredit, Bisnis, dan Analis Kredit.

## 3. Proses Manajemen Risiko

Proses manajemen risiko hukum memadai dalam mengidentifikasi, mengukur, memantau dan mengendalikan risiko dinilai telah berjalan sesuai SOP yang ada. Untuk mengukur kerugian akibat adanya tuntutan hukum yang memiliki potensi kerugian signifikan Bank telah mengantisipasi dengan menjalankan contingency plan sebagai tindakan untuk mengurangi risiko hukum, antara lain melalui penggunaan jasa pengacara dan melaporkan perkembangannya kepada Direksi.

Pengukuran Risiko Hukum dilaksanakan berdasarkan laporan hasil evaluasi atas analisis kasus-kasus hukum secara individual terhadap kewajiban kontinjensi yang timbul dari tuntutan hukum yang terjadi. Bank juga memiliki sistem informasi manajemen risiko dan sistem pengendalian internal dalam mendukung pelaksanaan manajemen risiko hukum.

# Legal Risk

Legal risk is defined as any risk caused by weaknesses in legal aspects, including lawsuits, the absence of supporting laws and regulations, or weaknesses in obligations such as non-fulfillment of valid contract requirements and imperfect collateral bindings.

## 1. Risk Governance

Legal risk management is carried out under the coordination of the work unit that runs the Legal Division, which acts as a "legal watch" and is responsible for providing legal advice according to the needs and requests of the work unit and is considered to have a legal impact based on analysis results of the work unit that submitted these results. The Board of Commissioners and Directors have a good sense of understanding and concern regarding legal risk management.

## 2. Risk Management Framework

The legal risk management strategy carried out by the Bank is intended to anticipate the emergence of legal risks and minimize their impact. In the organizational structure, the Bank already has a Legal Division specifically to support the implementation of the legal risk management process. The existence of the Legal Division is key in managing and mitigating legal risks. It can provide legal protection for the Bank in carrying out banking activities while still paying attention to applicable legal provisions.

The Bank has adequate policies and procedures in the legal risk management process. Its legal problem handling strategy is handled by the Legal Division for general issues and for specific matters related to credit with the assistance of the Credit Admin, Business, and Credit Analyst work units.

## 3. Risk Management Process

The Bank's legal risk management process for identifying, measuring, monitoring and controlling risks has been carried out in accordance with existing SOPs. To measure losses due to lawsuits that have the potential for significant losses, the Bank has implemented a contingency plan as an action to reduce legal risk. This plan includes the use of legal services and reporting any progress made to the Board of Directors.

Legal Risk Measurement is carried out based on evaluation reports from analyzing individual legal cases against contingent liabilities arising from lawsuits that occur. The Bank also has a risk management information system and internal control system to support the implementation of legal risk management.

# Risiko Kepatuhan

Risiko kepatuhan merupakan risiko yang disebabkan akibat Bank tidak mematuhi ketentuan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

# 1. Tata Kelola Risiko

Pengelolaan risiko kepatuhan dilaksanakan di bawah koordinasi Divisi Kepatuhan. Setiap pimpinan unit kerja di Bank bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan bahwa seluruh kegiatan di unit kerjanya telah dilaksanakan sesuai dengan peraturan dan perundangan serta ketentuan yang berlaku, sehingga tidak terjadi pengenaan dengan atas keterlambatan, koreksi laporan ataupun hal lainnya.

Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi berperan aktif dalam menumbuhkan dan mewujudkan budaya kepatuhan pada semua tingkatan organisasi dan kegiatan usaha Bank, dengan didukung oleh Divisi Kepatuhan yang melakukan evaluasi terhadap pelaksanaan kepatuhan Bank dan mengkaji hal-hal kepada aktivitas Bank yang berpotensi terhadap peningkatan risiko kepatuhan.

Manajemen Bank melakukan penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan dengan memenuhi prinsip-prinsip GCG, sehingga jika terdapat kelemahan dalam penerapan prinsip GCG, maka secara umum kelemahan tersebut kurang signifikan dan dapat diselesaikan oleh manajemen Bank.

# 2. Kerangka Manajemen Risiko

Strategi Bank dalam pengelolaan risiko kepatuhan ditujukan untuk memitigasi dampak dari pelanggaran terhadap ketentuan dan/atau peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Bank memiliki komitmen yang kuat untuk senantiasa mematuhi peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan mengambil langkah-langkah untuk memperbaiki kelemahan yang terjadi.

# 4. Risk Control System

The Bank made the following improvements and refinements to internal control:

a. Identifying weaknesses that could cause legal problems for the Bank through reviews and conducting studies of legal documents arising from contracts and agreements made or related to products and services.
b. Ensuring the suitability and legal certainty of agreements between the Bank and parties by referring to the principle of prudence in order to protect the Bank's own interests.

Independent reviews are carried out by the Internal Audit Work Unit. The Bank conducts studies of laws and regulations, both new and existing, and studies of actual legal events that occur in the field to ensure that the Bank's internal provisions do not deviate from the provisions of applicable laws and regulations.

# Compliance Risk

Compliance risk is defined as any risk caused by the Bank not complying with the provisions of applicable laws and regulations.

# 1. Risk Governance

Compliance risk management is carried out under the coordination of the Compliance Division. Each work unit leader at the Bank is responsible for ensuring that all activities in his/her work unit have been carried out in accordance with applicable laws, regulations and provisions. This is all to make sure that there are no fines imposed for delays, report corrections or other matters.

The Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors play an active role in fostering and realizing a culture of compliance at all levels of the Bank's organization and business activities. They are supported by the Compliance Division, which evaluates the Bank's compliance implementation and reviews matters or activities of the Bank that have the potential to increase compliance risk.

The Bank's management implements Corporate Governance by fulfilling the principles of GCG. This is so that if there are weaknesses in the implementation of GCG principles, then in general these weaknesses can be made to be less significant and can be resolved by the Bank's management.

# 2. Risk Management Framework

The Bank's strategy in managing compliance risk is aimed at mitigating the impact of violations of applicable laws and/or regulations. The Bank has a strong commitment to always comply with applicable laws and regulations and take steps to correct any weaknesses that may arise.

# Good Corporate Governance

Bank melakukan penilaian sendiri terhadap seluruh kriteria/indikator penerapan tata kelola, dengan mempertimbangkan faktor yang mencakup baik governance structure, governance process, dan governance outcome, dan pemenuhan atas prinsip GCG seperti keanggotaan Dewan Komisaris, Direksi dan Komite. 2. Memprioritaskan komitmen yang telah dibuat oleh Bank kepada Regulator atas perbaikan Penerapan Tata Kelola sebagai tindak lanjut atas hasil pemeriksaan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan di tahun 2024.
3. Bank telah menyediakan sumber daya manusia yang berkualitas. Pemenuhan jumlah SDM dan peningkatan kemampuan dan kualitas SDM pada unit kerja terus dilakukan guna terpenuhinya tata kelola Bank yang baik.
4. Kebijakan, ketentuan, serta sistem dan prosedur yang dimiliki oleh Bank telah diperbaharui sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Bank terus memantau implementasi kebijakan dan prosedur tersebut agar sesuai dengan ketentuan dan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

## Good Corporate Governance

The Bank conducts its own self-assessment of all criteria/indicators of governance implementation. It does this by considering factors that include governance structure, governance process, and governance outcome, and fulfillment of GCG principles such as membership of the Board of Commissioners, Board of Directors and Committees. The Bank realizes that improving and enhancing the quality of Governance implementation represents a continuous effort. Towards this end, the Bank has carried out the following efforts:

1. Conducted a self-assessment on the adequacy of Governance implementation and compiled periodic implementation reports so that the necessary corrective actions can be taken immediately if deficiencies were still found.
2. Prioritized commitments that have been made by the Bank to regulators as way for improving Governance Implementation and as follow-up actions to the results of the Financial Services Authority's inspections in 2024.
3. The Bank has provided quality human resources. Efforts towards having the right amount of HR and increasing the ability and quality the Bank's HR within work units continued to be carried out in order to fulfill good Bank governance.
4. The Bank's policies, provisions, and systems and procedures have been updated in accordance with applicable provisions. The Bank continued to monitor the implementation of these policies and procedures to ensure that they complied with applicable laws and regulations.

## Rentability

In general, Allo Bank has made optimal risk mitigation efforts. This was to ensure that the Bank's Rentability in 2024 generally improved compared to 2023. The results can be seen from the improvement in several rentability ratios such as ROA, ROE, and NIM.

## Capitalization

The s Minimum Capital Adequacy Ratio as of December 31, 2024 was 9.90%. This result means that the Bank's capital adequacy is considered still capable of absorbing potential losses faced and is still far above the minimum limit required by regulators.

# Indonesia

Bank harus menjelaskan asal perbedaan antara nilai tercatat sesuai standar akuntansi keuangan, sebagaimana dilaporkan pada laporan keuangan dan nilai eksposur sesuai ketentuan kehat-hatian, sebagaimana terdapat pada template LI1 dan LI2.

Banks must explain the origin of the difference between the carrying value according to financial accounting standards, as reported in the financial statements and the exposure value according to prudential provisions, as contained in templates LI1 and LI2.

(a) Bank harus menjelaskan sumber perbedaan signifikan antara nilai pada kolom (a) dan (b) di LI1.

The bank must explain the source of significant differences between the values in columns (a) and (b) in LI1.

(b) Bank harus menjelaskan sumber perbedaan antara nilai tercatat dan nilai yang digunakan untuk tujuan pengaturan yang tercantum pada LI2.

The bank must explain the source of the difference between the recorded value and the value used for regulatory purposes as stated in LI2.

(c) Sesuai dengan implementasi dari panduan pada valuasi prudensial, bank harus menjelaskan sistem dan kontrol untuk memastikan estimasi valuasi prudensial dan dapat diandalkan. Pengungkapan harus memasukkan:

In accordance with the implementation of the guidelines on prudential valuation, banks should describe systems and controls to ensure prudential and reliable valuation estimates. Disclosures must include:

(i) Metodologi valuasi, termasuk penjelasan sejauh mana penggunaan metodologi mark-to-market dan mark-to-model.

Valuation methodology, including an explanation of the extent of use of mark-to-market and mark-to-model methodologies.

(ii) Deskripsi proses verifikasi harga independen.

Description of the independent price verification process.

(iii) Prosedur untuk penyesuaian valuasi atau cadangan (termasuk deskripsi proses dan metodologi untuk menilai posisi trading dengan tipe instrumen).

Procedures for valuation adjustments or reserves (including a description of the process and methodology for valuing trading positions by instrument type).

Table 21: Qualitative Disclosures Regarding Counterparty Credit Risk

Eksposur Risiko Kredit akibat Kegagalan Pihak lawan (Counterparty Credit Risk) saat ini terdiri dari Reverse Repo Pemerintah dan Transaksi Derivatif yang berasal dari Kategori Portofolio Tagihan Kepada Bank dan Tagihan kepada Korporasi.

Bank melakukan pengelolaan risiko ini secara komprehensif salah satunya dengan melakukan pemantauan pada ekposur Counterparty Credit Risk setiap bulannya termasuk pengukuran nilai Potential Future Exposure (PFE) serta melakukan stress test terhadap Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) setidaknya satu kali dalam setahun yang dilaporkan ke Regulator.

Credit Risk Exposure due to Counterparty Failure (Counterparty Credit Risk) currently consists of Government Reverse Repo and Derivative Transactions originating from the Portfolio Category of Receivables to Banks and Receivables to Corporations.

The Bank manages this risk comprehensively by monitoring the Counterparty Credit Risk exposure on a monthly basis including the measurement of Potential Future Exposure (PFE) value and conducting stress tests on Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) at least once a year which is reported to the Regulator.

# Definisi

# Definition

(i) Ketika bank sebagai originator maka eksposur sekuritisasi berada pada posisi retained,meskipuntidak cocok untuk kerangka sekuritisasi yang dikarenakan tidak adanya transfer risiko yang signifikan dan efektif (yang dapat dipresentasikan secara terpisah).
(i) When the bank acts as an originator, the securitization exposure is in a retained position, although it is not suitable for a securitization framework due to the absence of significant and effective risk transfer (which can be presented separately).

(ii) Apabila bank sebagai sponsor eksposur sekuritisasi termasuk eksposur kepada commercial paper conduits dimana bank menyediakan programme-wide enhancements, likuiditas dan fasilitas lainnya. Ketika bank sebagai originator dan sponsor, harus menghindari pencatatan ganda. Terkait hal ini bank dapat menyatukan dua kolom "Bank sebagai originator" dan "Bank sebagai sponsor" dan menggunakan kolom "Bank sebagai originator sponsor".

If the bank acts as a sponsor, securitization exposure includes exposure to commercial paper conduits, for which the bank provides program-wide enhancements, liquidity and other facilities. When the bank is the originator and sponsor, the bank must avoid double listing. In this regard, the bank can combine the two columns "Bank as originator" and "Bank as sponsor" and use the column "Bank as originator sponsor".

(iii) Eksposur sekuritisasi ketika bank bertindak sebagai investor adalahinvestasi yang dibeli perjanjian dengan pihak ketiga. Securitization exposure when a bank acts as an investor is an investment purchased agreement with a third party.

Transaksi sintetis: jika bank telah membeli proteksi harus melaporkan jumlah eksposur bersih yang muncul pada kolom originator/sponsor (jika jumlahnya tidak diamankan). Jika bank telah menjual proteksi, nilai eksposur dari proteksi kredit harus dilaporkan pada kolom "investor". Synthetic transactions: if the bank has purchased protection, the bank must report the net exposure amount that appears in the originator/ sponsor column (if the amount is not secured). If the bank has sold protection, the exposure value of the credit protection must be reported in the "investor" column.

Re-sekuritisasi: semua eksposur sekuritisasi terkait re-securitisation harus dilengkapi pada baris "re-sekuritisasi", dan tidak pada baris sebelumnya (dengan tipe underlying asset) yang mengandung eksposur sekuritisasi selain re-sekuritisasi.

Re-securitization: all securitization exposures related to re-securitization must be completed on the "re-securitization" line, and not on the previous line (by underlying asset type) that contains securitization exposures other than re-securitization.

|  1. | Definisi IRRBB untuk Pengukuran dan Pengendalian Risiko Suku Bunga Definition of IRRBB for Measuring and Controlling Interest Rate Risk  |
|   | IRRBB merupakan risiko akibat pergerakan atau perubahan suku bunga di pasar yang menimbulkan eksposur risiko suku bunga yang mempengaruhi posisi banking book dan off balance sheet (aset, liabilitas, dan transaksi rekening administratif). Sensitivitas terhadap perubahan suku bunga tersebut berpotensi memberikan dampak pada permodalan dan rentabilitas (earning) Bank. Dalam melakukan pengukuran risiko IRRBB Bank menggunakan metode pengukuran berdasarkan perubahan pada nilai ekonomis dari ekuitas (Economic Value of Equity) dan pengukuran berdasarkan perubahan pada pendapatan bunga bersih (Net Interest Income).  |
|   | Pengendalian risiko suku bunga pada banking book adalah serangkaian tindakan yang dilakukan oleh bank untuk mengelola dan mengurangi dampak perubahan suku bunga terhadap aset, liabilitas, dan transaksi rekening administratif. Proses ini melibatkan identifikasi risiko, analisis sensitivitas, dan pengawasan secara berkala untuk memastikan stabilitas dan kesehatan keuangan bank.  |
|  2. | Strategi Manajemen Risiko dan Mitigasi Risiko untuk IRRBB Risk Management and Risk Mitigation Strategy for IRRBB  |
|   | Bank senantiasa melakukan pengawasan eksposur IRRBB secara berkala untuk memastikan bahwa risiko tetap dalam batas yang dapat diterima. Untuk itu, bank menyusun strategi manajemen risiko dan mitigasi yang mencakup penetapan tingkat risiko yang akan diambil (risk appetite) dan toleransi risiko (risk tolerance) untuk mencegah terjadinya pelampauan batasan limit yang ditetapkan oleh ketentuan yang berlaku, penetapan tingkat risiko tersebut sejalan dengan strategi bisnis bank. Selain itu, sebagai bagian dari upaya mitigasi risiko, bank menerapkan strategi diversifikasi portofolio dan menggunakan instrumen keuangan yang tepat untuk melindungi nilai aset dan kewajiban dari dampak fluktuasi suku bunga.  |
|  3. | Periodisasi Perhitungan IRRBB dan Pengukuran Spesifik yang Digunakan Bank untuk Mengukur Sensitivitas terhadap IRRBB Periodization of IRRBB Calculation and Specific Measures Used by Banks to Measure Sensitivity to IRRBB  |
|   | Berdasarkan aturan yang berlaku dari Regulator, Bank melakukan perhitungan IRRBB setiap Triwulanan untuk posisi akhir bulan Maret, Juni, September, dan Desember sebagai bagian dari laporan Profil Risiko untuk Risiko Pasar dan laporan Tingkat Kesehatan Bank. Namun untuk meningkatkan efektifitasnya, pemantauan atas IRRBB juga dilakukan secara bulanan dan dilaporkan kepada Komite Manajemen Risiko. Based on the applicable regulations set forth by the Regulator, the Bank calculates IRRBB on a quarterly basis for the end of March, June, September and December as part of the Risk Profile report for Market Risk and the Bank's Soundness report. Hedging against IRRBB (if any) and related Accounting Treatment

Saat ini Bank melakukan tindakan lindung nilai (hedging) terhadap IRRBB melalui natural hedging yaitu menggunakankarakteristik internal dari posisi aset dan kewajiban di dalam banking book untuk mengurangi dampak fluktuasi suku bunga tanpa harus menggunakan instrumen derivatif eksternal.

The Bank currently hedges IRRBB through natural hedging, which uses the internal characteristics of asset and liability positions in the banking book to reduce the impact of interest rate fluctuations without having to use external derivative instruments.

7. Penjelasan Komprehensif mengenai Asumsi Utama Pemodelan dan Parametric yang Digunakan untuk Menghitung ΔEVE dan ΔNII:

a. ΔEVE

Untuk posisi Desember 2024 pada Risiko Suku Bunga pada Banking Book (IRRBB) pada indikator delta Economic Value of Equity (EVE) dimana risiko maksimum terjadi pada skenario parallel up (suku bunga naik) yaitu sebesar Rp. 873,54 milliar, selanjutnya apabila dibandingkan dengan Modal Tier 1 Bank sebesar Rp 7,11 triliun maka delta EVE adalah sebesar 12.29%. For the position of December 2024, in the Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB) on the Economic Value of Equity (EVE) delta indicator, where the maximum risk occurs in the parallel up scenario (interest rates rise) amounting to Rp873.54 billion, then when compared to the Bank's Tier 1 Capital of Rp7.11 trillion, the EVE delta is 12.29%.

b. Δ NII

Untuk posisi Desember 2024, nilai delta Net Interest Income (NII) dimana risiko maksimum terjadi pada skenario parallel up sebesar Rp. 17,61 milliar. Apabila dibandingkan dengan projected income Desember 2024 Bank sebesar Rp 580,76 miliar, delta NII adalah sebesar 3.03%.

For the December 2024 position, the Net Interest Income (NII) delta value where the maximum risk occurs in the parallel up scenario, is Rp17.61 billion. When compared to the Bank's December 2024 projected income of Rp580.76 billion, the delta NII is 3.03%.

# Analysis

1. Perhitungan Liquidity Coverage Ratio posisi Triwulan IV tahun 2024 Bank Allo Indonesia periode Oktober 2024 - Desember 2024 sebesar 172.85% di atas ketentuan yang dipersyaratkan Regulator yaitu 100% (POJK Nomor 42/POJK.03/2015 tentang Kewajiban Pemenuhan Rasio Kecukupan Likuiditas (Liquidity Coverage Ratio) Bagi Bank Umum). Hal ini mengindikasikan kondisi Bank cukup baik dalam mengelola kebutuhan likuiditas untuk menopang aktivitas bisnis dalam periode 3 bulan terakhir.

2. Nilai LCR Triwulan IV tahun 2024 diperoleh dari rata-rata harian laporan selama bulan Oktober 2024 sampai dengan Desember 2024. Nilai rata-rata untuk Triwulan IV mengalami penurunan sebesar 2.84% dibandingkan periode Triwulan III tahun 2024 yang sebesar 175.69%. Penurunan rasio ini disebabkan oleh:

a. a. Total High Quality Liquid Asset (HQLA) pada Triwulan IV tahun 2024 mengalami peningkatan 21.64% dibandingkan Triwulan III tahun 2024. Faktor peningkatan HQLA ditimbulkan dari Total penempatan pada Bank Indonesia dan Surat berharga yang diterbitkan Pemerintah Pusat dan Bank Indonesia dalam rupiah jika dibandingkan dengan Triwulan sebelumnya.

b. b. Total rata-rata Arus Kas Keluar Bersih (Net Cash Outflow) pada periode Triwulan IV tahun 2024 sebesar Rp. 2,13 triliun, mengalami peningkatan sebesar 23.64% atau setara Rp. 406,88 miliar dibandingkan periode Triwulan III tahun 2024 yang sebesar Rp. 1,72 triliun. Hal ini disebabkan adanya peningkatan pendanaan yang berasal dari Nasabah Korporasi sebesar 224,36 miliar dan simpanan nasabah perorangan dan Pendanaan yang berasal dari Nasabah Usaha Mikro dan Usaha Kecil sebesar 1,90 miliar dibandingkan periode Triwulan III Tahun 2024.

3. Komposisi rata-rata HQLA Allo Bank selama Triwulan IV 2024 didominasi oleh surat berharga Pemerintah 93.45% (setelah pembobotan).

4. Konsentrasi rata-rata sumber pendanaan pada posisi Triwulan IV 2024 yang berasal dari nasabah perorangan sebesar 3.21% dan nasabah korporasi sebesar 96.55% (setelah pembobotan). Hal ini dipahami oleh Bank, dimana Bank terus berupaya meningkatkan sumber pendanaan perorangan dengan melakukan berbagai program untuk menarik nasabah ritel untuk menambah porsi dana stabil.

5. Allo Bank tidak memiliki eksposur derivatif pada Triwulan IV 2024.

6. Dalam pengelolaan likuiditas, Allo Bank telah mengidentifikasi, mengukur, memantau dan mengendalikan risiko likuiditas dengan komprehensif, antara lain dilakukan dengan pemantauan risiko limit likuiditas (appetite limit & tolerance limit), perhitungan proyeksi arus kas, Maturity Profile Behavioural, perhitungan Aset Likuid terhadap Non-Core Deposit, Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), stress testing likuiditas dan pengelolaan likuiditas yang ditetapkan dalam rapat komite ALCO dan dilaksanakan oleh unit kerja terkait baik Funding, Lending, dan Treasury. Bank juga telah melakukan Table Top Exercise dengan skenario likuiditas untuk memastikan kesiapan Bank pada saat terjadi krisis likuiditas yang dipengaruhi oleh berbagai faktor internal maupun eksternal.

# Analysis

1. Calculation of Liquidity Coverage Ratio position in the fourth quarter of 2024 Bank Allo Indonesia for the period October 2024 - December 2024 amounted to 172.85% above the provisions required by the Regulator which is 100% (POJK Number 42/POJK.03/2015 concerning Obligations to Fulfill the Liquidity Adequacy Ratio (Liquidity Coverage Ratio) for Commercial Banks). This indicates that the Bank's condition is quite good in managing liquidity needs to support business activities in the last 3 months period.

2. The LCR value for the fourth quarter of 2024 was obtained from the daily average of reports from October 2024 to December 2024. The average value for the fourth quarter decreased by 2.84% compared to the third quarter of 2024 which amounted to 175.69%. The decrease in this ratio was caused by:

a. Total High Quality Liquid Asset (HQLA) in the fourth quarter of 2024 increased by 21.64% compared to the third quarter of 2024. The increase in HQLA was caused by total placements with Bank Indonesia and securities issued by the Central Government and Bank Indonesia in rupiah when compared to the previous quarter.

b. Total average Net Cash Outflow in the fourth quarter of 2024 amounted to Rp2.13 trillion, an increase of 23.64% or equivalent to Rp406.88 billion compared to the third quarter of 2024 which amounted to Rp1.72 trillion. This was due to an increase in funding from corporate customers by 224.36 billion and individual customer deposits and funding from micro and small business customers by 1.90 billion compared to the third quarter of 2024.

3. The composition of Allo Bank's average HQLA during the fourth quarter of 2024 was dominated by Government securities 93.45% (after weighting).

4. The average concentration of funding sources in Q4 2024 position from individual customers amounted to 3.21% and corporate customers amounted to 96.55% (after weighting). This is acknowledged by the Bank, where the Bank continues to strive to increase individual funding sources by conducting various programs to attract retail customers to increase the portion of stable funds.

5. Allo Bank has no derivative exposure as of Q4 2024.

6. In managing liquidity, Allo Bank has identified, measured, monitored and controlled liquidity risk comprehensively, among others by monitoring liquidity risk limits (appetite limit & tolerance limit), calculating cash flow projections, Maturity Profile Behavioural, calculating Liquid Assets against Non-Core Deposits, Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), liquidity stress testing and liquidity management which are determined in the ALCO committee meeting and implemented by the relevant working units of Funding, Lending, and Treasury. The Bank has also conducted a Table Top Exercise with liquidity scenarios to ensure the Bank's readiness in the event of a liquidity crisis influenced by various internal and external factors.

# Analisis Kualitatif

# Qualitative Analysis

a. Aset Terikat (Encumbered Asset) merupakan aset yang dimiliki oleh Bank, namun terbatasuntuk kebutuhan likuiditas secara legal maupun kontraktual. Aset Terikat juga tidak termasuk aset yang disimpan atau diperjanjikan dengan Bank Indonesia yang belum digunakan untuk menghasilkan likuiditas. Saat ini, Bank memiliki aset terikat yang terdiri dari Repo sebesar Rp 300 Miliar, Reverse Repo sebesar Rp 289 Miliar (jangka waktu jatuh tempo rata-rata di bawah 1 bulan) dan Surat Berharga Pemerintah sebesar Rp2,55 trillion.

Encumbered Assets are assets owned by the Bank, but limited to legal or contractual liquidity needs. Encumbered Assets also do not include assets deposited or agreed with Bank Indonesia that have not been used to generate liquidity. Currently, the Bank has tied assets consisting of Repo of Rp300 billion, Reverse Repo of Rp289 billion (average maturity of less than 1 month) and Government Securities of Rp2.55 trillion.

b. Bank memiliki aset yang disimpan atau diperjanjikan dengan Bank Indonesia berupa GWM Primer sebesar Rp 405 miliar dan GWM PLM sebesar Rp263 miliar. Aset yang disimpan di Bank Indonesia tersebut belum digunakan untuk menghasilkan likuiditas namun tetap diperhitungkan sebagai HQLA sebagaimana diatur dalam POJK Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR)

The Bank has assets deposited or agreed with Bank Indonesia in the form of Primary GWM amounting to Rp405 billion and PLM GWM amounting to Rp263 billion. The assets deposited with Bank Indonesia have not been used to generate liquidity but are still calculated as HQLA as stipulated in POJK Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR).

c. Aset Tidak Terikat merupakan aset yang memenuhi syarat sebagai HQLA sebagaimana diatur dalam POJK Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR). Saat ini Bank memiliki aset tidak terikat berupa Kas dan Surat Berharga Pemerintah.

Unrestricted Assets are assets that qualify as HQLA as stipulated in POJK Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR). Currently the Bank has unrestricted assets in the form of Cash and Government Securities.

Untuk mendukung implementasi Kerangka Kerja Manajemen Risiko Operasional telah dibentuk 3 unsur penanggung jawab pengelola di masing-masing Unit Kerja yang terdiri dari Risk Owner, Operational Risk Manager (Risk Specialist) dan Responsible Person (RP). Risk Owner merupakan pemimpin tertinggi di Direktorat, Unit Kerja Bisnis dan unit kerja pendukung yang bertanggung jawab mengelola Risiko Operasional di unit kerja yang dipimpinnya, termasuk memastikan dipatuhinya peraturan dalam pelaksanaan kegiatan bisnis, operasional, dan transaksional. In order to improve the effectiveness of Operational Risk Management implementation, the Bank has an Enterprise, Operational, and Market Risk (EOMR) Work Unit, one of whose functions is related to Operational Risk Management and is under the coordination of the Risk Management Work Unit with clearly defined and accountable duties and responsibilities. This Working Unit has the task of assisting the Board of Directors in managing Operational Risk, monitoring the overall Operational Risk Management implementation process, ensuring Operational Risk Management policies are implemented at all levels of the Bank's Organization. In its implementation, the EOMR Work Unit coordinates with several Work Units on every occasion such as the Internal Audit Work Unit, Cyber Risk Work Unit, Legal Work Unit, Compliance Work Unit and Work Units to discuss critical Operational Risk issues so that these risks can be effectively mitigated and controlled early on.

To support the implementation of the Operational Risk Management Framework, 3 elements of responsible managers have been established in each Work Unit consisting of Risk Owner, Operational Risk Manager (Risk Specialist) and Responsible Person (RP). The Risk Owner is the highest leader in the Directorate, Business Unit and supporting work units who is responsible for managing Operational Risk in the work unit he leads, including ensuring compliance with regulations in the implementation of business, operational and transactional activities. Operational Risk Manager (ORM) is an Operational Risk management function that helps the Risk Owner implement the Operational Risk Management Framework. The Responsible Person (RP) is tasked with assisting the Head of the Division in managing Operational Risk, especially in terms of Incident Reporting, Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRI) and other operational risk issues that are not covered in their work area.

RCSA digunakan untuk membantu risk owner dalam melakukan proses manajemen risiko operasional yang mencakup identifikasi dan pengukuran risiko operasional secara mandiri yang bersifat prediktif dan antisipatif. Selanjutnya, KRI adalah alat bantu yang memberikan informasi sejak dini mengenai gejala maupun risiko yang trennya menunjukkan peningkatan. Sedangkan Incident Report merupakan tools yang berfungsi sebagai database peristiwa risiko, yang digunakan untuk data pembelajaran Bank.

Bank juga membangun database peristiwa risiko, termasuk di dalamnya data kerugian karena risiko operasional, melalui modul Incident Report. Hal ini merupakan bagian dari kegiatan Bank mendata Risk & Loss Event Data (RLED) yang akan digunakan di dalam perhitungan Modal Risiko Operasional dan ATMR Risiko Operasional. Peristiwa yang dicatat meliputi Loss Event dan/atau Near Miss Event. Kejadiannya dapat berasal dari kegiatan yang bersifat transaksional maupun non transaksional. Near Miss merupakan peristiwa risiko yang nyaris menimbulkan kerugian finansial atau yang telah menimbulkan kerugian finansial namun kerugian tersebut sudah recovery seluruhnya, dengan catatan pada saat pencatatan Incident Report peristiwa risiko sudah terselesaikan baik di hari yang sama dengan peristiwa ataupun tidak, sedangkan Loss Event merupakan peristiwa risiko yang berdampak finansial atau hilangnya dana Bank.

Insiden/peristiwa Risiko Operasional wajib dianalisis kronologi, penyebab, dan dampaknya untuk memperoleh informasi yang lengkap dan komprehensif. Seluruh peristiwa risiko yang memiliki dampak kerugian finansial harus dicatat di dalam modul Incident Report berapapun nilai kerugiannya. Terhadap Insiden Risiko yang telah dicatat Unit Kerja terkait memantau kerugian dari Loss Event mengenai update setiap recovery kerugian sampai dengan final serta pembukuan kerugian final dalam buku Bank. Unit Kerja EOMR akan merekonsiliasi Loss yang dicatat pada Incident Report Database dengan yang dicatat di GL Kerugian Bank./

The Bank developed an Operational Risk Management methodology in order to improve the existing ORM tools. ORM Tools are devices or systems designed to assist the Bank in identifying, assessing, controlling, and monitoring Operational Risk. ORM Tools have three modules, namely Risk Control Self Assessment (RCSA), Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and Incident Report. RCSA is used to assist risk owners in carrying out the operational risk management process which includes identifying and measuring operational risks independently which are predictive and anticipatory. Furthermore, KRI is a tool that provides early information on symptoms or risks that show an increasing trend. Meanwhile, Incident Report is a tool that functions as a database of risk events, which is used for Bank learning data.

The Bank also establishes a database of risk events, including data on losses due to operational risks, through the Incident Report module. This is part of the Bank's activities in recording Risk & Loss Event Data (RLED) which will be used in calculating Operational Risk Capital and Operational Risk RWA. The events recorded include Loss Events and/or Near Miss Events. The incidents can originate from transactional or non-transactional activities. Near Miss is a risk event that almost caused a financial loss or has caused a financial loss but the loss has been fully recovered, with the note that at the time of recording the Incident Report the risk event has been resolved either on the same day as the event or not, while Loss Event is a risk event that has a financial impact or loss of Bank funds.

Operational Risk Incidents/Events must be analyzed for chronology, causes, and impacts to obtain complete and comprehensive information. All risk events that have an impact on financial loss must be recorded in the Incident Report module regardless of the value of the loss. For the Risk Incidents that have been recorded, the related Work Unit monitors the losses from the Loss Event regarding updates on each loss recovery until the final and the final loss recording in the Bank's books. The EOMR Work Unit will reconcile the Losses recorded in the Incident Report Database with those recorded in the Bank's Loss GL.
