Berbagai upaya ini ditujukan untuk memitigasi risiko inheren dan terus meningkatkan sistem pengendalian khususnya terhadap Risiko Operasional. Bank juga terus-menerus meningkatkan kesadaran risiko seluruh pegawainya melalui berbagai media termasuk diantaranya email blast dan sosialisasi secara langsung.

Bank dalam menentukan tingkat Risiko yang diambil, Toleransi Risiko, dan Strategi Bank secara keseluruhan selalu memperhatikan kemampuan modal Bank untuk dapat menyerap eksposur risiko atau kerugian yang timbul berdasarkan pengalaman kerugian di masa lalu, kemampuan sumber daya manusia, serta kepatuhan terhadap ketentuan internal dan eksternal yang berlaku. Bank telah menetapkan Limit Risiko secara memadai sesuai sasaran strategis dan strategi bisnis Bank secara keseluruhan yang wajib dipatuhi oleh seluruh lini organisasi, oleh karenanya Bank menerbitkan Kebijakan Risk Limit. Limit Risiko yang ditetapkan oleh Bank secara berkala ditinjau ulang minimal satu tahun sekali untuk memastikan kesesuaiannya dengan arah dan strategi bisnis Bank.

Bank telah menerapkan Budaya Risiko (Risk Culture) antara lain dengan secara konsisten menerapkan proses identifikasi, pengukuran, pemantauan, pengendalian dan pelaporan atas potensi kerugian yang dapat dialami Bank (Potential Loss), mencegah kejadian risiko (Risk Event) dan meminimalkan kerugian Bank (Risk Loss). Kemudian melaksanakan proses identifikasi, pengukuran, pemantauan, pengendalian dan pelaporan setiap jenis dan kelompok risiko yang dilakukan secara berkesinambungan. Budaya Manajemen Risiko diinternalisasikan pada seluruh level Organisasi untuk mendorong konsistensi dan efektivitas Penerapan Manajemen Risiko Bank dan merupakan tanggung jawab bersama seluruh karyawan di setiap lini organisasi.

Terdapat Product & Activity Forum yang secara rutin dilakukan untuk mengidentifikasi dan memitigasi risiko yang melekat pada produk dan aktivitas baru. Untuk mempermudah proses mitigasi Risiko Produk oleh Product Owner dan unit-unit kerja yang terkait lainnya, Bank telah menyusun Kebijakan Pengelolaan Risiko Produk Bank. Semua uang tunai yang dikelola oleh Bank telah diasuransikan, jenis asuransi uang tunai pada Bank terdapat dalam Cash In Save (uang dalam khazanah utama) dan Cash In Transit (uang dalam perjalanan).

Sebagai bentuk pengawasan aktif Dewan Direksi atas implementasi Kualitas Penerapan Manajemen Risiko yang salah satunya terkait Risiko Operasional, Bank telah memiliki Komite Manajemen Risiko yang tujuan utamanya adalah untuk eskalasi dan pembahasan risiko-risiko utama di Bank.

The Bank continuously improves the implementation of Operational Risk Management by increasing employee awareness of risk and improving the Bank's operational policies and procedures. These efforts are aimed at mitigating inherent risk and continuously improving the control system, especially for Operational Risk. The Bank also continuously improves the risk awareness of all its employees through various media, including email blasts and direct socialization.

In determining the level of risk taken, risk tolerance, and overall bank strategy, the Bank always pays attention to the Bank's capital capacity to absorb risk exposure or losses arising from past loss experience, human resource capacity, and compliance with applicable internal and external provisions. The Bank has set adequate Risk Limits in accordance with the Bank's strategic targets and overall business strategy that must be adhered to by all lines of the organization, therefore the Bank issues a Risk Limit Policy. The Risk Limits set by the Bank are periodically reviewed at least once a year to ensure their compliance with the Bank's business direction and strategy.

The Bank has implemented a Risk Culture, among others by consistently implementing the process of identification, measurement, monitoring, control and reporting of potential losses that can be experienced by the Bank (Potential Loss), preventing risk events (Risk Event) and minimizing Bank losses (Risk Loss). Then implementing the process of identification, measurement, monitoring, control and reporting of each type and group of risks that are carried out continuously. Risk Management Culture is internalized at all levels of the Organization to encourage consistency and effectiveness of the Implementation of Bank Risk Management and is a shared responsibility of all employees at every level of the organization.

There is a Product & Activity Forum which is routinely held to identify and mitigate the risks inherent in new products and activities. To facilitate the process of Product Risk mitigation by Product Owners and other related work units, the Bank has prepared a Bank Product Risk Management Policy. All cash managed by the Bank has been insured, the type of cash insurance at the Bank is in Cash In Save (money in the main treasury) and Cash In Transit (money in transit).

As a form of active supervision by the Board of Directors over the implementation of the Quality of Risk Management Implementation, one of which is related to Operational Risk, the Bank has a Risk Management Committee whose main purpose is to escalate and discuss the main risks in the Bank.

# Prinsip Dasar Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

Basic Principles of Implementing Good Corporate Governance

Komitmen dan Konsistensi Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik (Good Corporate Governance) Secara Berkelanjutan

Allo Bank memandang bahwa kelangsungan usaha tidak hanya ditentukan oleh kinerja keuangan semata, melainkan juga kinerja operasional yang baik sehari-hari. Untuk memastikan kinerja bisnis dan operasional dapat berjalan secara optimal, maka Bank senantiasa menerapkan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik kepada Good Corporate Governance (GCG) guna menciptakan persaingan yang sehat dan iklim usaha yang kondusif. Mengingat pentingnya peran implementasi GCG bagi bisnis dan operasional, Bank berupaya untuk menempatkan praktik Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik sebagai pedoman dasar yang harus dilakukan secara komprehensif di seluruh tingkat organisasi Bank, dimulai dari jajaran Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan seluruh karyawan di lingkungan bank.

Pada praktiknya Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik berperan sebagai prinsip yang mendasari proses dan mekanisme pengelolaan perusahaan dengan tetap mengacu kepada peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik dan komprehensif juga menjadi indikator penting bagi investor untuk menilai sebuah perusahaan di masa depan. Terlebih, di industri perbankan, penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik juga menjadi landasan dan kebutuhan perusahaan dalam menciptakan nilai tambah yang berkelanjutan, mendukung perusahaan dalam menghadapi dinamika industri perbankan, serta membentuk fondasi iklim investasi yang sehat dan dapat mendorong terciptanya inklusi keuangan.

Commitment and Consistency of Sustainable GCG Implementation

Allo Bank believes that business continuity is determined not only by financial performance but also by strong daily operational performance. To ensure that both business and operational performance run optimally, the Bank consistently implements Good Corporate Governance (GCG) to foster healthy competition and a conducive business climate. Recognizing the crucial role of GCG in business and operations, the Bank strives to establish Good Corporate Governance practices as fundamental guidelines that must be comprehensively applied across all levels of the organization, from the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors to all employees.

In practice, the implementation of Good Corporate Governance serves as a foundational principle guiding company management processes and mechanisms while adhering to applicable laws and regulations. Effective and comprehensive GCG implementation is also a key indicator for investors in assessing a company's long-term prospects. Furthermore, in the banking industry, Good Corporate Governance acts as a fundamental pillar in creating sustainable added value, enabling the company to navigate the evolving banking landscape, fostering a sound investment climate, and promoting financial inclusion.

## Implementation of Corporate Governance Principles

In applying the principles of Good Corporate Governance, the Bank adheres to the four pillars outlined in the General Guidelines for Good Corporate Governance (PUGKI) 2021, issued by the National Committee for Governance Policy (KNKG). The principles are as follows:

|  Perilaku Beretika (Etika) Ethics | Dalam melaksanakan kegiatannya korporasi senantiasa mengedepankan kejujuran, memperlakukan semua pihak dengan hormat, memenuhi komitmen, membangun serta menjaga nilai-nilai moral dan kepercayaan secara konsisten. Korporasi memperhatikan kepentingan pemegang saham dan pemangku kepentingan lainnya berdasarkan asas kewajaran dan kesetaraan dan dikelola secara independen sehingga masing-masing organ perusahaan tidak saling mendominasi dan tidak dapat diintervensi oleh pihak lain. In conducting its activities, the company prioritizes honesty, treats all parties with respect, fulfills commitments, and consistently upholds moral values and trust. The company considers the interests of shareholders and other stakeholders based on the principles of fairness and equality and operates independently to ensure that no corporate entity dominates another or is subject to external intervention.  |
| --- | --- |
|  Transparansi Transparency | Untuk menjaga objektivitas dalam menjalankan bisnis, perusahaan menyediakan informasi yang material dan relevan dengan cara yang mudah untuk diakses dan dipahami oleh pemangku kepentingan. Korporasi mengambil inisiatif untuk mengungkapkan tidak hanya masalah yang disyaratkan oleh peraturan perundang-undangan, tetapi juga hal yang penting untuk pengambilan keputusan oleh pemegang saham, kreditur, dan pemangku kepentingan lainnya. To maintain objectivity in business operations, the company provides material and relevant information in a manner that is easily accessible and understandable for stakeholders. It proactively discloses not only information mandated by laws and regulations but also other significant matters that may influence decision-making by shareholders, creditors, and other stakeholders.  |
|  Akuntabilitas Accountability | Korporasi dapat mempertanggungjawabkan kinerjanya secara transparan dan wajar. Untuk itu Korporasi harus dikelola secara benar, terukur dan sesuai dengan kepentingan korporat dengan tetap memperhitungkan kepentingan pemegang saham dan pemangku kepentingan. Akuntabilitas merupakan prasyarat yang diperlukan untuk mencapai kinerja yang berkelanjutan. The corporation is responsible for ensuring that its performance is transparent and fair. To achieve this, it must be managed properly, with measurable processes, and in alignment with corporate interests, while also considering the rights of shareholders and stakeholders. Accountability is a crucial prerequisite for achieving sustainable performance.  |
|  Keberlanjutan Sustainability | Korporasi mematuhi peraturan perundang-undangan serta berkomitmen melaksanakan tanggung jawab terhadap masyarakat dan lingkungan agar berkontribusi pada pembangunan berkelanjutan melalui kerjasama dengan semua pemangku kepentingan terkait untuk meningkatkan kehidupan mereka dengan cara yang selaras dengan kepentingan bisnis dan agenda Pembangunan berkelanjutan. The Corporation complies with all applicable laws and regulations and remains committed to fulfilling its responsibilities toward society and the environment. It aims to contribute to sustainable development by collaborating with relevant stakeholders to enhance their quality of life in a manner that aligns with business interests and the Sustainable Development agenda.  |

## Perkembangan GCG Allo Bank di Tahun 2024

Dalam rangka meningkatkan kinerja Bank, melindungi kepentingan para pemangku kepentingan, serta meningkatkan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan, Allo Bank berkomitmen untuk terus memperkuat implementasi tata kelola yang baik dan berkelanjutan pada proses bisnis dan operasional dengan mendukung prinsip-prinsip Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG). Allo Bank juga terus memperkuat fondasi bisnis melalui penerapan GCG, sistem yang andal, memenuhi sumber daya manusia yang sesuai dengan arah rencana bisnis Bank, serta menyesuaikan seluruh usaha sesuai dengan perkembangan teknologi dan dinamika bisnis yang terjadi.

Di samping itu, Bank juga berkomitmen untuk menerapkan praktik tata kelola perusahaan yang baik dengan menyempurnakan implementasi GCG di lingkungan Bank. Peningkatan kualitas pelaksanaan tata kelola yang dilakukan Bank pada tahun 2024, antara lain:

1. Komposisi susunan pengurus Bank telah terpenuhi sesuai ketentuan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan seluruh Dewan Komisaris serta Direksi telah lulus Penilaian Kemampuan dan Kepatutan.

# Penerapan dan Kesesuaian atas Pedoman Tata Kelola Perusahaan Terbuka

Implementation and

Compatibility of Public

Company Governance

Guidelines

Komitmen Allo Bank terhadap Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik (Good Corporate Governance) tercermin dalam serangkaian kebijakan dan prosedur operasional yang secara konsisten diterapkan dalam seluruh kegiatan sehari-hari. Bank secara internal juga telah memiliki pedoman pelaksanaan GCG yang mana pedoman tersebut memuat terkait aspek, prinsip, dan rekomendasi Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik. Pedoman ini dirancang untuk memastikan bahwa setiap aspek dari praktik GCG dipenuhi dan berkelanjutan.

Allo Bank selaku perusahaan yang berstatus perusahaan publik senantiasa melaksanakan dan mematuhi seluruh peraturan perundangan- undangan yang berlaku. Bank juga berupaya untuk menciptakan nilai tambah bagi pemegang saham dan para pemangku kepentingan dengan menekankan seluruh kegiatan usahanya pada prinsip-prinsip transparansi, akuntabilitas, dan penyampaian informasi yang wajar sebagai pegangan bagi entitas usaha. Bank juga senantiasa memperhatikan hak pemegang saham tanpa terkecuali, khususnya pemegang saham minoritas yang harus menjadi perhatian dari perusahaan publik terkait.

Allo Bank's commitment to Good Corporate Governance (GCG) is reflected in a series of operational policies and procedures that are consistently applied in daily activities. The Bank also has internal GCG implementation guidelines that outline the key aspects, principles, and recommendations of Good Corporate Governance. These guidelines are designed to ensure that every element of GCG is met and sustained over time.

As a publicly listed company, Allo Bank consistently implements and complies with all applicable laws and regulations. The Bank is also committed to creating added value for shareholders and stakeholders by ensuring that all business activities adhere to the principles of transparency, accountability, and fair information disclosure as a guide for business entities. Additionally, the Bank remains attentive to the rights of all shareholders, particularly minority shareholders, who require special consideration in accordance with public company governance standards.

# Struktur Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

Good Corporate

Governance Structure

Sesuai dengan Undang-Undang No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas, Bank memiliki struktur tata kelola perusahaan yang terdiri dari 3 (tiga) organ utama, yaitu Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS), Dewan Komisaris, dan Direksi.

RUPS merupakan forum tertinggi di perusahaan, sedangkan keberadaan Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi merupakan pengejawantahan dari sistem kepengurusan perusahaan dua badan

In accordance with Law No. 40 of 2007 concerning Limited Liability Companies, the Bank's corporate governance structure consists of 3 (three) main organs, namely the General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS), the Board of Commissioners, and the Board of Directors.

The GMS is the highest forum in the company, while the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors represent the embodiment of the two-tier corporate management system.

(two-tier system), Dewan Komisaris juga bertindak sebagai pengawas dan pengarah, sementara Direksi bertindak sebagai pengurus perusahaan sehari-hari.

Dalam menjalankan tugasnya, Dewan Komisaris turut dibantu oleh Komite Dewan Komisaris yang dibentuk untuk membantu dan meningkatkan fungsi pengawasan yang dijalankan oleh Dewan Komisaris, yaitu Komite Audit, Komite Pemantau Risiko, dan Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi. Sementara, dalam melaksanakan tugasnya untuk mengelola dan mengendalikan operasional bisnis serta bertanggung jawab atas implementasi GCG di Bank, Direksi turut dibantu oleh sejumlah Komite di bawah Direksi, yaitu Komite Pengarah Teknologi Informasi, Komite Kebijakan Perkreditan, Komite Produk dan Proses Penerbitan Produk atau Aktivitas Baru, Komite Manajemen Risiko, Komite Kredit, Komite Aset dan Liabilitas (ALCO), dan Komite Sumber Daya Manusia. Selain itu, Direksi juga dibantu oleh organ pendukung lain yang bersifat struktural, yaitu Corporate Secretary & PMO dan Satuan Kerja Audit Internal (SKAI).

The Board of Commissioners also acts as a supervisor and advisor, while the Board of Directors is responsible for the company's daily management.

In carrying out its duties, the Board of Commissioners is assisted by the Board of Commissioners Committees, which are established to support and enhance the supervisory function performed by the Board of Commissioners. These committees include the Audit Committee, Risk Oversight Committee, and Remuneration and Nomination Committee. Meanwhile, in executing its responsibilities to manage and oversee business operations and ensure the implementation of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) within the Bank, the Board of Directors is supported by several committees under its authority. These include the Information Technology Steering Committee, Credit Policy Committee, Product and Process Committee for Issuing New Products or Activities, Risk Management Committee, Credit Committee, Asset and Liability Committee (ALCO), and Human Resources Committee. Additionally, the Board of Directors is supported by other structural units, such as the Corporate Secretary & PMO and the Internal Audit Work Unit (SKAI).

## General Meeting of Shareholders

### Struktur Pemegang Saham

Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS) merupakan organ tertinggi dalam struktur GCG Allo Bank yang berfungsi sebagai pengambil keputusan tertinggi dalam Bank, dan memiliki wewenang yang tidak dimiliki oleh Dewan Komisaris ataupun Direksi. RUPS juga merupakan sarana bagi para pemegang saham untuk mengambil keputusan penting dan strategis terkait keberlanjutan jangka panjang Bank, dengan memperhatikan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, termasuk menyetujui perubahan Anggaran Dasar, menyetujui laporan tahunan dan membagikan dividen. RUPS juga memiliki wewenang untuk menunjuk dan memberhentikan anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi, mendelegasikan wewenang kepada Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi serta mengambil keputusan terkait tindakan Bank yang membutuhkan persetujuan pemegang saham.

### Dasar Hukum Penyelenggaraan RUPS

Dalam menyelenggarakan RUPS, Bank senantiasa mengacu kepada sejumlah peraturan perundang-undangan, antara lain:

1. Undang-Undang No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas.
2. Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 15/POJK.04/2020 tentang Perencanaan dan Pelaksanaan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham Perusahaan Publik.
3. Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 16/POJK.04/2020 tentang Pelaksanaan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham Perusahaan Publik Secara Elektronik.

### Shareholders Structure

The General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS) is the highest organ within Allo Bank's GCG structure, serving as the Bank's ultimate decision-making authority. It holds powers beyond those of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors. The GMS also serves as a platform for shareholders to make important and strategic decisions regarding the long-term sustainability of the Bank, considering the provisions of the Articles of Association and applicable laws and regulations. These decisions include approving amendments to the Articles of Association, approving annual reports, and determining dividend distributions. Additionally, the GMS has the authority to appoint and dismiss members of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors, delegate authority to the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors, make decisions related to the Bank's actions that require shareholder consent.

### Legal Basis for Holding GMS

In holding the GMS, the Bank adheres to the following legal provisions:

1. Law No. 40 of 2007 concerning Limited Liability Companies.
2. Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 15/POJK.04/2020 concerning Planning and Implementation of General Meetings of Shareholders of Public Companies.
3. Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 16/POJK.04/2020 concerning the Electronic Implementation of General Meetings of Shareholders of Public Companies.

### Rights of the Shareholders at the GMS.

Shareholders have a number of rights in implementing the GMS in accordance with applicable regulations, including:

1. Shareholders have the right to attend the GMS either alone or represented based on a power of attorney. Shareholders who are

## Jenis-Jenis RUPS

Allo Bank memiliki 2 (dua) jenis RUPS, yakni RUPS Tahunan (RUPST) dan RUPS Luar Biasa (RUPSLB). RUPST dapat diadakan sebanyak 1 (satu) kali dalam setahun, sementara RUPSLB dapat diadakan kapan saja berdasarkan kebutuhan Bank. Seluruh hasil dan keputusan yang dicapai dalam RUPS selanjutnya akan diterapkan secara wajar dan transparan. Meski demikian, RUPS dan pemegang saham tidak berwenang untuk melakukan intervensi dalam pelaksanaan tugas, fungsi, dan otoritas Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi dalam menjalankan kewajibannya dan menggunakan haknya sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan yang berlaku.

Allo Bank has 2 (two) types of GMS, namely the Annual GMS (AGMS) and Extraordinary GMS (EGMS). # Dewan Komisaris
## Board of Commissioners

Dewan Komisaris merupakan organ yang bertanggung jawab untuk melaksanakan fungsi pengawasan secara umum dan/atau khusus sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar, memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi, serta memastikan bahwa Bank telah melaksanakan prinsip-prinsip GCG. Dewan Komisaris bertanggung jawab kepada Pemegang Saham dalam hal mengawasi kebijakan Direksi terhadap operasional Bank secara umum yang mengacu kepada rencana bisnis yang telah disetujui Dewan Komisaris dan Pemegang Saham, serta memastikan kepatuhan terhadap seluruh peraturan dan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

The Board of Commissioners is responsible for overseeing general and/or specific management functions, providing advisory support to the Board of Directors, and ensuring that the Bank adheres to GCG principles. The Board of Commissioners is accountable to shareholders for monitoring the Board of Directors' policies and overall Bank operations. These activities must align with the business plan approved by the Board of Commissioners and Shareholders while ensuring full compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

## Kriteria Dewan Komisaris

1. Setiap anggota Dewan Komisaris memenuhi persyaratan penilaian kemampuan dan kepatutan sesuai dengan Peraturan OJK mengenai Penilaian Kemampuan dan Kepatutan bagi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi, yaitu persyaratan integritas, kompetensi dan reputasi keuangan. Persyaratan tersebut harus dipenuhi Dewan Komisaris pada saat diangkat dan selama menjabat.
2. Dewan Komisaris wajib memenuhi persyaratan integritas, kompetensi dan reputasi keuangan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Persyaratan ini agar dimuat dalam surat pernyataan yang didokumentasikan oleh Bank dengan baik.
3. Persyaratan integritas yang dipenuhi, minimal sebagai berikut:
a. Memiliki akhlak dan moral yang baik, paling sedikit ditunjukan dengan sikap mematuhi ketentuan yang berlaku, termasuk tidak pernah dihukum karena terbukti melakukan tindak pidana dalam jangka waktu tertentu sebelum dicalonkan.
b. Cakap melakukan perbuatan hukum.
c. Memiliki komitmen untuk mematuhi peraturan perundang-undangan dan mendukung kebijakan regulator yang berlaku.
d. Memiliki komitmen terhadap pengembangan operasional Bank yang sehat.

## Criteria for the Board of Commissioners

1. Each member of the Board of Commissioners fulfills the fit and proper test requirements in accordance with the OJK Regulation regarding Fit and Proper Test for the Board of Commissioners and Directors, namely the requirements for integrity, competence, and financial reputation. These requirements must be fulfilled by the Board of Commissioners at the time of appointment and throughout their tenure.
2. The Board of Commissioners must meet the integrity, competency, and financial reputation requirements in accordance with applicable regulations. These requirements should be included in a well-documented statement letter by the Bank.
3. The integrity requirements that must be fulfilled are as follows:
a. Possess good morals and ethics, demonstrated at least by complying with applicable regulations, including not having been convicted of a crime within a certain period before being nominated.
b. Capable of carrying out legal actions.
c. Have a commitment to comply with laws and regulations and support the applicable regulatory policies.
d. Have a commitment to the development of a healthy Bank operation.

# Pengangkatan dan Pemberhentian Anggota Dewan Komisaris

## Ketentuan Pengangkatan

1. Anggota Dewan Komisaris diangkat berdasarkan keputusan RUPS dengan memperhatikan rekomendasi komite yang menjalankan fungsi nominasi.
2. Anggota Dewan Komisaris diangkat untuk masa jabatan tertentu dan dapat diangkat kembali saat masa jabatannya telah berakhir.
3. 1 (satu) periode masa jabatan anggota Dewan Komisaris paling lama 3 (tiga) tahun atau sampai dengan penutupan RUPS tahunan pada akhir 1 (satu) periode masa jabatan dimaksud.

e. Currently not in a legal process and/or a fit and proper test process at a Bank.
f. Does not work in a company that prohibits becoming a member of the Board of Commissioners.
g. Have a commitment not to engage in and/or repeat certain actions or behaviors, for candidates for the Board of Commissioners who previously failed the fit and proper test.

4. The minimum competency requirements that must be fulfilled are:
a. Have knowledge in banking and/or finance that is adequate and relevant to the position.
b. Have experience and expertise in banking and/or finance.
c. Have knowledge about the duties and responsibilities as well as understanding the main business activities and main risks of the Bank.
d. Have a Risk Management Certificate of at least Level 6 (six).

5. The financial reputation requirements that must be fulfilled, among others:
a. Does not have non-performing loans, and
b. Never been declared bankrupt or served as a member of the Board of Commissioners that was found guilty of causing a company to declare bankrupt within the last 5 (five) years before being nominated.

6. Never been a member of the Board of Commissioners who, during their tenure:
a. Failed to hold the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGM).
b. Their accountability as a member of the Board of Commissioners was not accepted by the GMS or they failed to provide accountability as a member of the Board of Commissioners to the GMS.
c. Caused a company that obtained a license, approval, or registration from the Financial Services Authority (OJK) to fail to fulfill its obligation to submit Annual Reports and/or Financial Statements to the OJK.

# The Appointment and Dismissal of Members of the Board of Commissioners

## Appointment Requirements

1. Members of the Board of Commissioners are appointed based on the decision of the GMS.
2. Members of the Board of Commissioners are appointed for a certain term of office and may be reappointed when their term of office has ended.
3. The maximum term of office for a member of the Board of Commissioners is 3 (three) years or until the closing of the annual GMS at the end of the said term of office.

# Ketentuan Pemberhentian

a. anggota Dewan Komisaris dinilai tidak mampu melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawab dalam pengelolaan dan pelaksanaan strategi Bank yang sehat;

c. pemberhentian atau penggantian anggota Dewan Komisaris telah melalui perencanaan dan mekanisme yang berlaku, yang paling sedikit memperhatikan penilaian dari komite yang menjalankan fungsi nominasi dan telah diagendakan dalam RUPS;
d. pemberhentian atau penggantian anggota Dewan Komisaris tidak mengakibatkan terjadinya permasalahan dalam pengorganisasian dan kegiatan usaha Bank;

4. With the addition of a new Commissioner to the previously existing number of members in the Board of Commissioners, the term of office of the new Commissioner ends at the same time as the other members of the Board of Commissioners who are still in office.
5. The appointment of a Commissioner who is a Foreign Worker must comply with the provisions on the Utilization of Foreign Workers issued by the OJK and other related agencies.
6. Every proposal for replacement and/or appointment of members of the Board of Commissioners to the GMS must take into account the recommendations of the Committee which carries out the Nomination function.

# Dismissal Requirements

1. Every dismissal and/or replacement of members of the Board of Commissioners at the GMS must take into account the recommendations of the committee which carries out the nomination function and prioritizes the main interests of the Bank.

b. dismissal or replacement of members of the Board of Commissioners is not based on the subjective assessment of shareholders, but is based on an objective assessment regarding the management of the Bank;
c. the dismissal or replacement of members of the Board of Commissioners has gone through applicable planning and mechanisms, which at least takes into account the assessment of the committee that carries out the nomination function and has been on the agenda at the GMS;
d. dismissal or replacement of members of the Board of Commissioners does not result in problems in the organization and business activities of the Bank;

# Duties, Responsibilities and Authorities of the Board of Commissioners

1. Duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners:

a. Direct, monitor, and evaluate the Bank's strategic policies to ensure alignment with the Bank's objectives while adhering to the rules and regulations applicable to the banking industry.
b. Ensure that the Board of Directors has implemented the principle of prudence in the Bank's business activities.
c. Ensure the implementation of Good Governance Principles in every Bank business activity at all organizational levels.

d. Ensure that the implementation of risk management is adequate in accordance with risk management policies and risk management strategies.
e. Ensure that the Board of Directors has followed up on audit findings and recommendations from SKAI, external auditors, OJK, Bank Indonesia audit results and/or supervision results from other authorities.
f. Evaluate the implementation of the Bank's compliance function at least 2 (two) times a year by providing suggestions in order to improve the quality of the implementation of the Bank's compliance function to the President Director with a copy to the Director in charge of the compliance function.
g. Fostering a culture of compliance and anti-fraud culture at all levels of the organization.

2. The Board of Commissioners is not permitted to be involved in making decisions on the Bank's operational activities, except for the provision of funds to related parties and matters regulated in the Bank's Articles of Association or applicable laws and regulations.

3. Authority of the Board of Commissioners:

b. Check and verify the condition of cash, securities and others.
c. Know all actions that have been carried out by the Board of Directors.
d. Enter buildings and grounds or other places used or controlled by the Bank.
e. Ask the Directors and/or other officials to provide explanations regarding all matters relating to Bank management.
f. Request the Directors and/or other officials under the Directors, with the knowledge of the Directors, to attend meetings of the Board of Commissioners.
g. Attend Board of Directors meetings and provide views on matters discussed at meetings.

## Program Orientasi bagi Anggota Dewan Komisaris Baru

Dalam hal terjadi perubahan susunan dan komposisi Dewan Komisaris, maka anggota Dewan Komisaris yang baru diangkat wajib mengikuti program pengenalan perusahaan sebagaimana diatur dalam BOC Charter. Program pengenalan tersebut dilakukan untuk memberikan pemahaman mengenai tugas dan tanggung jawab sebagai anggota Dewan Komisaris agar dijalankan sebaik-baiknya. Kegiatan ini juga bertujuan agar anggota Dewan Komisaris dapat memahami latar belakang dan kegiatan usaha Bank agar dapat mempermudah dan melancarkan pelaksanaan tugas Dewan Komisaris secara efektif.

Sehubungan dengan tidak adanya perubahan susunan dan komposisi Dewan Komisaris sepanjang tahun 2024, maka Bank tidak melaksanakan program pengenalan Dewan Komisaris baru.

## Independence of the Board of Commissioners

1. The majority of the Board of Commissioners members are prohibited from having family relationships up to the second degree with other members of the Board of Directors and/or with other members of the Board of Commissioners.
2. Former members of the Board of Directors or Executive Officers of the Bank, or parties who have relationships with the Bank that can influence their ability to act independently, must undergo a minimum cooling-off period of 1 (one) year before becoming an Independent Commissioner at the Bank.
3. The above provision does not apply to former members of the Board of Directors who are in charge of supervisory functions or Executive Officers who conduct supervisory functions at the Bank.
4. Members of the Board of Commissioners are required to sign a Declaration of Independence letter that applies according to the period or term of office as determined in the GMS.

## Orientation Program for New Members of Board of Commissioners

In the event of a change in the composition of the Board of Commissioners, newly appointed members are required to participate in the company's introduction program, as stipulated in the BOC Charter. This program is designed to provide an understanding of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners, ensuring that they can carry out their roles effectively. Additionally, it aims to familiarize members with the Bank's background and business activities, facilitating the effective execution of their supervisory duties.

Since there were no changes in the composition of the Board of Commissioners in 2024, the Bank did not implement an introduction program for new members.

## Independen
### Independent Commissioner

Komisaris Independen merupakan anggota Dewan Komisaris yang tidak memiliki hubungan keuangan, kepengurusan, kepemilikan saham dan/atau hubungan keluarga dengan anggota Dewan Komisaris, anggota Direksi dan/atau pemegang saham pengendali atau dengan Bank yang mungkin menghalangi atau menghambat posisinya untuk bertindak independen sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip GCG. Komisaris Independen diangkat oleh RUPS dan tidak memiliki hubungan afiliasi dengan pihak yang berkepentingan, terutama pemegang saham mayoritas, anggota Direksi, dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris.

Di tahun 2024, Bank memiliki 2 (dua) orang Komisaris Independen dari total 3 (tiga) orang anggota Dewan Komisaris. Komposisi ini telah sesuai dengan ketentuan Pasal 20 ayat (3) POJK 33/2014 yang mengatur syarat minimal Komisaris Independen yang berjumlah sekurang-kurangnya 30% dari anggota Dewan Komisaris perusahaan.

## Kriteria Penentuan Komisaris
### Independen

Komisaris Independen wajib memenuhi persyaratan umum Dewan Komisaris serta beberapa kriteria lainnya, yaitu:

1. Penunjukan Komisaris sebagai Komisaris Independen harus mendapatkan persetujuan OJK.
2. Bukan merupakan orang yang bekerja atau mempunyai wewenang dan tanggung jawab untuk merencanakan, memimpin, mengendalikan atau mengawasi kegiatan Bank dalam waktu 6 (enam) bulan terakhir, kecuali untuk pengangkatan kembali sebagai Komisaris Independen pada periode berikutnya.
3. Tidak mempunyai saham baik langsung maupun tidak langsung pada Bank.
4. Tidak mempunyai hubungan afiliasi dengan Bank, anggota Dewan Komisaris, anggota Direksi atau Pemegang Saham Utama Bank.

Independent Commissioner is a member of the Board of Commissioners who does not have any financial, managerial, share ownership, and/or family relationships with the members of the Board of Commissioners, members of the Board of Directors, and/or controlling shareholders or with the Bank that may impede or hinder their ability to act independently in accordance with the principles of GCG. Independent Commissioners are appointed by the GMS and have no affiliation with interested parties, especially majority shareholders, members of the Board of Directors, and/or members of the Board of Commissioners.

In 2024, the Bank had two (2) Independent Commissioners out of a total of three (3) members on the Board of Commissioners. This composition complies with Article 20, Paragraph (3) of POJK 33/2014, which requires that at least 30% of the Board of Commissioners consist of Independent Commissioners.

## Criteria for Determining Independent Commissioners

Independent Commissioners are required to fulfill the general requirements of the Board of Commissioners as well as several other criteria, namely:

1. The appointment of a Commissioner as an Independent Commissioner must obtain approval from the OJK.
2. They are not a person who works or has the responsibility to plan, lead, control or supervise the Bank's activities within the last 6 (six) months, except for reappointment as an Independent Commissioner in the following period.
3. They do not own shares, either directly or indirectly, in the Bank.
4. They do not have affiliation with the Bank, members of the Board of Commissioners, members of the Board of Directors or the Bank's Controlling Shareholders.

# Direksi Board of Directors

Direksi adalah organ utama yang secara kolektif berwenang dan bertanggung jawab penuh atas pengurusan perusahaan sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan untuk kepentingan Bank. Direksi juga bertanggung jawab mewakili Bank, baik di dalam maupun di luar pengadilan sesuai dengan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar dan ketentuan peraturan perundangan-undangan. Direksi juga memiliki wewenang untuk mengatur jalannya Bank, mengambil tindakan dan kebijakan yang dianggap perlu untuk memastikan kelancaran operasional Bank dengan memperhatikan aspek efisiensi dan efektivitas.

Setiap anggota Direksi juga wajib menjalakan fungsi pengurusan perusahaan dengan mengedepankan prinsip-prinsip profesionalisme, efisiensi, transparansi, kemandirian, akuntabilitas, pertanggungjawaban serta kewajaran sesuai dengan prinsip tata kelola yang diadopsi oleh Bank. Setiap anggota Direksi Bank juga wajib melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya dengan itikad baik, penuh tanggung jawab, dan kehati-hatian, sesuai dengan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

## Persyaratan Anggota Direksi

1. Setiap anggota Direksi harus memenuhi persyaratan penilaian kemampuan dan kepatutan sesuai Peraturan OJK mengenai Penilaian Kemampuan dan Kepatutan bagi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi, yaitu persyaratan integritas, kompetensi dan reputasi keuangan. Persyaratan tersebut harus dipenuhi anggota Direksi pada saat diangkat dan selama menjabat.
2. Persyaratan integritas yang harus dipenuhi, antara lain:
a. Memiliki akhlak dan moral yang baik, paling sedikit ditunjukan dengan sikap mematuhi ketentuan yang berlaku, termasuk tidak pernah dihukum karena terbukti melakukan tindak pidana dalam jangka waktu tertentu sebelum dicalonkan.

The Board of Directors is the main organ that collectively holds full authority and responsibility for managing the company in accordance with its objectives and in the best interest of the Bank. The Board of Directors is also responsible for representing the Bank both in and outside the court, in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association and applicable laws and regulations. Additionally, the Board of Directors has the authority to regulate the Bank's operations, implement policies, and take necessary actions to ensure the smooth functioning of the Bank while considering aspects of efficiency and effectiveness.

Each member of the Board of Directors is required to manage the company while upholding the principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independence, accountability, responsibility, and fairness, in accordance with the governance principles adopted by the Bank. Furthermore, each member of the Board of Directors must perform their duties and responsibilities with good faith, full accountability, and prudence, in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

## Requirements for Members of the Board of Directors

1. Each member of the Board of Directors must meet the requirements for assessing their ability and suitability according to the OJK Regulation regarding the Assessment of Capability and Suitability for the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors, including requirements for integrity, competence, and financial reputation. These requirements must be met by the member of the Board of Directors at the time of appointment and throughout their tenure.
2. The integrity requirements that must be met include:
a. Have good ethics and morals, demonstrated at least by adhering to applicable regulations, including not having been convicted of a criminal offense within a certain period before being nominated.

3. The competence requirements that must be met include:
a. Have adequate knowledge in the field of banking and/or finance that is relevant to their position.
b. Have experience and expertise in the field of banking and/ or finance.
c. Have the ability to conduct strategic management in order to develop a healthy Bank.
d. The majority of the members of the Board of Directors must have at least 5 (five) years of experience in the operational aspects of a bank and at least as an Executive Officer of a bank.
e. Have Risk Management Certification up to level 5, or equivalent to level 7

4. The financial reputation requirements that must be met include:
a. Don't have non-performing loans, and
b. Have not been declared bankrupt or become a Director who has been found guilty of causing a company to be declared bankrupt, within the last 5 (five) years prior to the nomination.

5. Have never been a member of the Board of Commissioners and/or Board of Directors who, during their tenure:
a. Have been convicted of a criminal offense that has harmed the state's finances and/or is related to the financial sector.
b. Have failed to hold an annual GMS.
c. Have had their accountability as a member of the Board of Directors rejected by the GMS or have failed to provide accountability as a member of the Board of Directors to the GMS, and
d. Have caused a company that has obtained a permit, approval, or registration from the OJK to fail to fulfill its obligations to submit Annual Reports and/or Financial Statements to the OJK.

# Persyaratan Direktur Kepatuhan

Selain memenuhi kriteria umum bagi anggota Direksi, Direktur yang membawahi fungsi kepatuhan juga wajib memenuhi sejumlah persyaratan sebagai berikut:

1. Memenuhi persyaratan independensi.
2. Direktur utama dan/atau wakil direktur utama dilarang merangkap jabatan sebagai direktur yang membawahkan Fungsi Kepatuhan.
3. Dilarang membawahi fungsi: Bisnis, Operasional, Manajemen Risiko yang melakukan pengambilan keputusan pada kegiatan usaha Bank, treasury, keuangan dan akuntansi, logistik dan pengadaan barang/jasa, teknologi informasi dan/atau audit internal.

# Pengangkatan Anggota Direksi

1. Anggota Direksi diangkat berdasarkan keputusan RUPS.
2. Anggota Direksi diangkat untuk masa jabatan tertentu dan dapat diangkat kembali.
3. Satu periode masa jabatan anggota Direksi paling lama 5 (lima) tahun atau sampai dengan penutupan RUPS tahunan pada akhir 1 (satu) periode masa jabatan dimaksud.
4. Usulan penggantian dan/atau pengangkatan anggota Direksi oleh Dewan Komisaris dalam RUPS, harus memperhatikan rekomendasi dari Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi.
5. Persyaratan pengangkatan Direksi yang merupakan tenaga kerja asing harus tunduk kepada ketentuan tentang Pemanfaatan Tenaga Kerja Asing dan Program Alih Pengetahuan sebagaimana diatur dalam Peraturan OJK serta ketentuan instansi terkait lainnya.
6. Honorarium dan/atau tunjangan Direksi ditentukan dalam RUPS.

# Pengunduran Diri Anggota Direksi & Pergantian Anggota Direksi

1. Anggota Direksi dapat mengundurkan diri dari jabatannya sebelum masa jabatannya berakhir.
2. Masa jabatan Direksi berakhir dengan sendirinya apabila Direksi tersebut:
a. Mengundurkan diri dengan pemberitahuan secara tertulis;
b. Tidak lagi memenuhi persyaratan perundang-undangan yang berlaku;
c. Meninggal dunia;
d. Diberhentikan berdasarkan keputusan RUPS;
e. Dinyatakan pailit atau ditaruh dibawah pengampuan berdasarkan suatu penetapan Pengadilan;
f. Terbukti terlibat dalam kejahatan keuangan.
3. Direksi berhak mengundurkan diri dari jabatannya dengan memberitahukan secara tertulis kepada Bank selambat lambatnya 90 (sembilan puluh) hari sebelum tanggal pengunduran dirinya.

# Requirements of Compliance Director

Apart from meeting the general criteria for members of the Board of Directors, the Director in charge of the compliance function is also required to fulfill a number of requirements as follows:

1. Fulfill independence requirements.
2. The President Director is prohibited from holding concurrent positions as Director in charge of the compliance function.
3. Prohibited from being in charge of functions: Business, Operations, Risk Management which makes decisions on Bank business activities, treasury, finance and accounting, logistics and procurement of goods/services, information technology and internal audit.

# Appointment of Members of the Board of Directors

1. Board of Directors members are appointed based on the decision of the GMS.
2. Board of Directors members are appointed for a specific term and may be reappointed.
3. The maximum term for a Board of Directors member is 5 (five) years or until the end of 1 (one) term period, which ends with the annual GMS meeting.
4. Proposals for the replacement and/or appointment of Board of Directors members by the Board of Commissioners in GMS, must consider the recommendations of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee.
5. The appointment requirements for foreign workers who serve as Board of Directors members must comply with the provisions on the Utilization of Foreign Workers and Knowledge Transfer Program as stipulated by the OJK regulation and other relevant agencies.
6. The honorarium and/or benefits for Board of Directors members are determined at GMS.

# Resignation and Replacement of Directors

1. Members of the Board of Directors may resign from their positions before their term of office ends.
2. The term of office of a Director ends automatically if the Director:
a. Resign with written notification;
b. No longer meets applicable statutory requirements;
c. Passes away;
d. Dismissed based on GMS decision;
e. Declared bankrupt or placed under guardianship based on a court decision;
f. Proven to be involved in financial crimes.
3. Directors have the right to resign from their positions by notifying the Bank in writing no later than 90 (ninety) days before the date of their resignation.

# Pemberhentian Sementara Anggota Direksi

1. Anggota Direksi dapat diberhentikan untuk sementara oleh Dewan Komisaris dengan menyebutkan alasannya.

4. The Bank is obliged to hold a GMS to decide on the request for resignation of the member of the Board of Directors no later than 90 (ninety) days after receipt of the letter of resignation.

6. The GMS may appoint another person to fill the position of a Director who is dismissed from his position or to fill a vacancy. 7. For the President Director and/or Compliance Director, dismissal, replacement and/or resignation before the end of the term of office must obtain prior approval from the OJK before being decided at the GMS:

Submission of the application to the OJK as intended is submitted by the Bank no later than 1 (one) month before the planned implementation of the GMS which contains the agenda for dismissal or replacement of the President Director and/or director in charge of the compliance function, by including: (i) reasons/considerations for dismissal, replacement and/or resignation; (ii) The profile of the replacement candidate who is deemed to meet the requirements for a fit and proper test
b. If OJK assesses that the plan is not feasible then: (i) The plan is not approved by OJK; (ii) Banks are prohibited from including this agenda in the GMS.
8. The Bank is required to submit information to the OJK and disclose information no later than 2 (two) working days after:
a. Acceptance of resignation requests from members of the Board of Directors.
b. A GMS was held.

4. The General Meeting of Shareholders must be held no later than 90 (ninety) days after the date of the temporary suspension.

# Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

## Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris

Peraturan OJK No. 17 Tahun 2023 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola Bagi Bank Umum dan Surat Edaran Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 13/SEOJK.03/2017 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum mewajibkan Bank Umum untuk melakukan penilaian terhadap penerapan tata kelola. Untuk itu, Bank senantiasa melakukan evaluasi secara rutin terhadap kinerja Dewan Komisaris yang dilakukan oleh Pemegang Saham dalam forum RUPS.

Evaluasi tersebut dilakukan dengan memperhatikan kompetensi dan keahlian/pengalaman, kinerja Komite-Komite Dewan Komisaris, efektivitas pelaksanaan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris, dan penilaian mandiri maupun penilaian rekan sejawat terhadap pelaksanaan fungsi pengawasan oleh masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris. Hasil penilaian atas aspek-aspek tersebut selanjutnya akan disimpulkan ke dalam laporan dan diajukan kepada pemegang saham melalui mekanisme RUPS.

## Penilaian Kinerja Direksi

Undang-Undang No. 40 tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas mengatur bahwa dalam hal Direksi terdiri dari 2 (dua) anggota Direksi atau lebih maka tanggung jawab Direksi berlaku secara tanggung renteng. Adapun prosedur penilaian kriteria kinerja Direksi Bank terdiri dari 2 (dua) jenis, yaitu:

1. Penilaian Kinerja oleh RUPS
Masing-masing Anggota Direksi akan dievaluasi setiap tahunnya oleh Dewan Komisaris untuk disampaikan kepada Pemegang Saham dalam RUPS, berdasarkan hasil kinerja keseluruhan dari tugas dan kewajiban Direksi secara kolegial maupun individual. Hal ini menjadi salah satu bahan pertimbangan bagi pemegang saham untuk memberhentikan dan/atau menunjuk kembali anggota Direksi.

2. Prosedur Pelaksanaan Assessment Kinerja Direksi
Self-assessment atau penilaian sendiri dilakukan oleh masing-masing anggota Direksi untuk menilai pelaksanaan kinerja Direksi secara kolegial, dan bukan menilai kinerja individual masing-masing anggota Direksi. Dengan adanya self-assessment ini diharapkan masing-masing anggota Direksi dapat berkontribusi untuk memperbaiki kinerja Direksi secara berkesinambungan.

Prosedur penilaian kinerja Direksi melalui pelaksanaan self-assessment GCG dilakukan pada bulan Juni dan Desember setiap tahunnya yang berdasarkan pengelolaan Bank, pencapaian target, upaya penanggulangan kendala dan manajemen risiko, serta penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang dilakukan. Dewan komisaris akan mengevaluasi melalui rapat dengan Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi kemudian hasilnya akan dilaporkan kepada pemegang saham dalam RUPS Tahunan.

# Performance Assessment of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors

## Assessment of the Board of Commissioners' Performance

OJK Regulation No. 17 of 2023 concerning the Implementation of Governance for Conventional Bank and Financial Services Authority Circular Letter No. 13/SEOJK.03/2017 require Conventional Bank to conduct assessments of their governance implementation. In compliance with these regulations, the Bank routinely conducts evaluations of the Board of Commissioners' performance, which are carried out by shareholders during the GMS forum.

The evaluation is carried out by considering the competence, expertise/experience of the Board of Commissioners, the performance of the Board of Commissioners' Committees, the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners' responsibilities, as well as independent assessments and peer assessments of the supervisory function performed by each Board of Commissioners member. The results of this assessment will then be summarized in a report and submitted to shareholders through the GMS mechanism.

## Assessment of the Board of Directors' Performance

Based on Law No. 40 of 2007 regarding Limited Liability Companies, if the Board of Directors consists of two or more members, their responsibility applies jointly and respectively. There are two types of procedures for assessing the Board of Directors' performance as follows:

1. Performance Assessment by GMS
Each member of the Board of Directors will be evaluated annually by the Board of Commissioners to be presented to Shareholders at the GMS, based on the results of the overall performance of the duties and obligations of the Board of Directors both collegial and individual. This is a consideration for shareholders when dismissing and/or reappointing members of the Board of Directors.

2. Procedures for Implementing Directors' Performance Assessments
Self-assessment is carried out by each member of the Board of Directors to assess the implementation of the performance of the Board of Directors in a collegial manner, and not to assess the individual performance of each member of the Board of Directors. With this self-assessment, it is expected that each member of the Board of Directors can contribute to improving the performance of the Board of Directors on an ongoing basis.

The procedure for assessing the performance of the Board of Directors through the implementation of a GCG self-assessment is carried out in June and December each year based on the Bank's management, target achievement, efforts to overcome obstacles and risk management, as well as the implementation of corporate governance. The Board of Commissioners will evaluate it through meetings with the Remuneration and Nomination Committee and then the results will be reported to shareholders at the Annual GMS.

## Rapat Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

### Rapat Dewan Komisaris

Berdasarkan BOC Charter, Dewan Komisaris dapat melaksanakan rapat secara berkala sekurang-kurangnya sebanyak 1 (satu) kali dalam 2 (dua) bulan atau lebih jika dianggap perlu oleh Dewan Komisaris. Ketentuan tersebut mengatur bahwa Rapat Dewan Komisaris wajib dihadiri oleh seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris secara fisik paling kurang 2 (dua) kali dalam setahun. Selain itu, Dewan Komisaris wajib mengadakan rapat bersama Direksi secara berkala minimal 1 (satu) kali dalam 4 (empat) bulan. Seluruh rapat Dewan Komisaris, baik internal maupun rapat gabungan dengan Direksi, diadakan di tempat kedudukan Bank atau tempat kegiatan usaha utama Bank.

Rapat dapat dinyatakan sah dan berhak untuk mengambil keputusan yang mengikat apabila dihadiri dan/atau diwakili lebih dari ½ (satu per dua) dari jumlah anggota Dewan Komisaris yang sedang menjabat (kuorum). Keputusan rapat harus diambil berdasarkan musyawarah untuk mufakat. Dalam hal keputusan berdasarkan musyawarah untuk mufakat tidak tercapai, maka keputusan dilakukan berdasarkan suara terbanyak. Dewan Komisaris dapat juga mengambil keputusan yang sah tanpa mengadakan rapat, dengan ketentuan semua anggota Dewan Komisaris telah diberitahu secara tertulis mengenai usul keputusan yang dimaksud dan semua anggota Dewan Komisaris memberikan persetujuan mengenai usul yang diajukan secara tertulis dengan menandatangani sirkuler tersebut.

Hasil rapat wajib dituangkan dalam risalah rapat, kemudian ditandatangani oleh seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris yang hadir dan disampaikan kepada seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris. Untuk rapat Dewan Komisaris bersama dengan Direksi, risalah rapat ditandatangani oleh Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris yang hadir dan disampaikan kepada seluruh Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris.

## Meetings of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors

### Board of Commissioners Meeting

BOC Charter stipulates that the Board of Commissioners can hold regular meetings, at least 1 (one) time in 2 (two) months or more if deemed necessary by the Board of Commissioners. All members of the Board of Commissioners must physically attend meetings of the Board of Commissioners at least 2 (two) times a year. In addition, the Board of Commissioners is required to hold regular meetings with the Board of Directors at least 1 (one) time in 4 (four) months. Internal meetings of the Board of Commissioners and joint meetings with the Board of Directors are held at the Bank's domicile or the Bank's main business activities.

A meeting is valid and has the right to make binding decisions if attended and/or represented by more than ½ (one half) of the number of members of the Board of Commissioners who are currently serving (quorum). Meeting decisions must be taken based on deliberation to reach consensus. In the event that a decision based on deliberation to reach consensus is not reached, the decision is made based on the majority vote. The Board of Commissioners can also make valid decisions without holding a meeting, provided that all members of the Board of Commissioners have been notified in writing regarding the proposed decision in question and all members of the Board of Commissioners have given their approval to the proposal submitted in writing by signing the circular.

The results of the meeting must be stated in the minutes of the meeting, then signed by all members of the Board of Commissioners present and submitted to all members of the Board of Commissioners. For joint meetings between the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors, the minutes of the meeting are signed by the Directors and Board of Commissioners

# Rapat Direksi

Sebagaimana diatur dalam BOD Charter, Direksi dapat menyelenggarakan rapat internal secara berkala minimal 1 (satu) kali dalam 1 (satu) bulan kepada lebih jika dianggap perlu oleh Direktur Utama kepada angota Direksi lainnya. Di samping itu, Direksi wajib mengadakan rapat Direksi bersama dengan Dewan Komisaris secara berkala sekurang-kurangnya sebanyak 1 (satu) kali dalam 4 (empat) bulan.

Keputusan rapat Direksi diambil berdasarkan musyawarah untuk mufakat. Dalam hal keputusan berdasarkan musyawarah untuk mufakat tidak tercapai, maka keputusan diambil dengan pemungutan suara berdasarkan suara setuju lebih dari  $\frac{1}{3}$  (satu per dua) dari jumlah suara yang dikeluarkan yang sah dalam rapat.

# Board of Directors Meeting

BOD Charter regulates that the Board of Directors can hold regular internal meetings 1 (one) time in 1 (one) month or more if deemed necessary by the President Director or other members of the Board of Directors. In addition, the Board of Directors is required to hold joint Board of Directors meetings with the Board of Commissioners periodically at least 1 (one) time in 4 (four) months.

Decisions at the Board of Directors meetings are taken based on deliberation to reach consensus. In the event that a decision based on deliberation to reach consensus is not reached, the decision is taken by voting based on affirmative votes of more than  $\frac{1}{3}$  (onehalf) of the number of valid votes cast at the meeting.

# Nominasi dan Remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

# Nomination and Remuneration of Board of Commissioners and Directors

Sebagai organ tertinggi dalam organisasi Bank, Pemegang Saham memiliki kewenangan untuk mengangkat dan memberhentikan anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi melalui mekanisme RUPS. Pemegang saham juga berwenang untuk mendelegasikan penetapan besaran remunerasi bagi anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi kepada Dewan Komisaris dengan mempertimbangkan rekomendasi dari Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi.

## Prosedur Nominasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Allo Bank telah menetapkan sejumlah kriteria bagi anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Calon anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi dapat berasal dari pemegang saham pengendali atau dari sumber-sumber lainnya. Setiap calon yang dinominasikan akan dikaji oleh Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi untuk disampaikan kepada Dewan Komisaris lalu diusulkan kepada Pemegang Saham. Penetapan calon yang dinominasikan dilakukan melalui mekanisme RUPS untuk kemudian mengikuti tahapan selanjutnya, yaitu uji kepatutan dan kelayakan yang dilakukan oleh OJK.

## Kebijakan Remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Bank menetapkan besaran remunerasi bagi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi berdasarkan Keputusan RUPS setiap tahunnya. Besaran remunerasi serta fasilitas lain yang diberikan bagi Dewan Komisaris akan ditetapkan di dalam RUPS Tahunan oleh Pemegang Saham dengan memperhatikan rekomendasi dari Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi. Prosedur penetapan remunerasi bagi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi terdiri dari:

1. Pemegang Saham melakukan pembahasan pada RUPS.

As the highest organ in the Bank's organization, Shareholders have the authority to appoint and dismiss members of the Board of Commissioners and Directors through the GMS mechanism. Shareholders are also authorized to delegate the determination of the amount of remuneration for members of the Board of Commissioners and Directors to the Board of Commissioners by considering recommendations from the Remuneration and Nomination Committee.

## Nomination Procedure for Board of Commissioners and Directors

Allo Bank has set a number of criteria for members of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors in accordance with applicable provisions. The Board of Commissioners and Directors candidates may come from controlling shareholders or from other sources. The Bank has established a number of criteria for members of the Board of Commissioners and Directors in accordance with applicable regulations. Each nominated candidate will be reviewed by the Remuneration and Nomination Committee to be submitted to the Board of Commissioners and then proposed to Shareholders. The determination of the nominated candidates is carried out through the GMS mechanism and then follows the next stage, namely the fit and proper test carried out by the OJK.

## Remuneration Policy for Board of Commissioners and Directors

The Bank determines the remuneration for the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors based on the Annual GMS Decision. The remuneration amount and other benefits provided to the Board of Commissioners are determined in the Annual GMS by shareholders, taking into account the recommendations of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee. The procedure for determining remuneration for the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors consists of:

1. The Shareholders conduct discussions at the GMS.

7. Surat Dewan Komisaris kepada Direksi tentang Penetapan Remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi.

## Struktur Remunerasi Anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Kebijakan Remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi Bank senantiasa mengacu pada ketentuan Peraturan OJK No. 45/POJK.03/2015 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola dalam Pemberian Remunerasi bagi Bank Umum serta Surat Edaran OJK No. 40/SEOJK.03/2016 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola dalam Pemberian Remunerasi Bank Umum. Berdasarkan kebijakan tersebut, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi menerima paket remunerasi yang terdiri dari:

1. Remunerasi yang bersifat tetap, yaitu remunerasi yang tidak dikaitkan dengan kinerja dan risiko, antara lain honorarium dan tunjangan hari raya.
2. Remunerasi yang bersifat variabel, yaitu Remunerasi yang dikaitkan dengan kinerja dan risiko, antara lain jasa produksi atau bentuk lainnya yang dipersamakan dengan itu.

The implementation of the remuneration policy for the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors refers to the provisions of OJK Regulation No. 45/POJK.03/2015 regarding the Implementation of Governance in Providing Remuneration for Conventional Bank and OJK Circular Letter No. 40/SEOJK.03/2016 regarding the Implementation of Governance in Providing Remuneration for Conventional Bank. 1. Fixed remuneration, which is not related to performance and risk, including honorarium and holiday allowances.
2. Variable remuneration, which is linked to performance and risk, including production fees or equivalent forms.

# Organ Pendukung Dewan Komisaris

## Board of Commissioners Supporting Organ

Dewan Komisaris senantiasa dibantu oleh 3 (tiga) Komite di bawah Dewan Komisaris, yaitu Komite Audit, Komite Pemantau Risiko, serta Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi. Pembentukan komite tersebut ditujukan untuk membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam melaksanakan tugas pengawasan.

## Komite Audit

Komite Audit merupakan organ pendukung yang bertugas untuk mendukung pelaksanaan tugas Dewan Komisaris dalam memantau dan mengevaluasi perencanaan maupun pelaksanaan audit dan kecukupan proses laporan pelaporan keuangan termasuk memberikan rekomendasi penunjukan akuntan publik serta melakukan pengawasan terhadap efektivitasnya.

## Dasar Hukum

Pembentukan Komite Audit mengacu pada peraturan perundang-undangan dan best practice yang diterapkan di lembaga perbankan di Indonesia, di antaranya:

1. Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan ("POJK") POJK No. 33/POJK.04/2014 tanggal 8 Desember 2014 tentang Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris Emiten atau Perusahaan Publik.
2. POJK No. 17/POJK.03/2023 tanggal 14 September 2023 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum.
3. POJK No. 13/POJK.03/2017 tanggal 27 Maret 2017 tentang Penggunaan Jasa Akuntan Publik dan Kantor Akuntan Publik dalam Kegiatan Jasa Keuangan.
4. POJK No. 1/POJK.03/2019 tanggal 28 Januari 2019 tentang Penerapan Fungsi Audit Intern pada Bank Umum.
5. SEOJK No. 36/SEOJK.03/2017 tentang Tata Cara Penggunaan Jasa Akuntan Publik dan Kantor Akuntan Publik dalam Kegiatan Jasa Keuangan.
6. Anggaran Dasar Bank.

The Board of Commissioners is always assisted by 3 (three) Committees, namely the Audit Committee, the Risk Oversight Committee, and the Remuneration and Nomination Committee. The establishment of these committees is intended to assist the Board of Commissioners in performing its supervisory duties effectively.

## Audit Committee

The Audit Committee is a supporting organ of the Board of Commissioners whose task is to support the implementation of the Board of Commissioners' duties in monitoring and evaluating the planning and implementation of audits and the adequacy of the financial reporting process, including providing recommendations for the appointment of public accountants and supervising their effectiveness.

## Legal Basis

The formation of the Audit Committee is guided by and based on applicable laws and regulations as well as best practices implemented in banking institutions in Indonesia, including:

1. Financial Services Authority Regulation ("POJK") POJK No. 33/POJK.04/2014 dated December 8, 2014 concerning the Directors and Board of Commissioners of Issuers or Public Companies.
2. POJK No. 17/POJK.03/2023 dated September 14, 2023 concerning Implementation of Governance for Conventional Bank.
3. POJK No. 13/POJK.03/2017 dated March 27, 2017 concerning the Use of Public Accounting Services and Public Accounting Firms in Financial Services Activities.
4. POJK No. 1/POJK.03/2019 dated January 28, 2019 concerning Implementation of the Internal Audit Function in Conventional Bank.
5. SEOJK No. 36/SEOJK.03/2017 concerning Procedures for Using the Services of Public Accountants and Public Accounting Firms in Financial Services Activities.
6. Bank Articles of Association.

# Tujuan Pembentukan Komite Audit

Bank membentuk Komite Audit dengan tujuan untuk:

1. Membantu/mendukung efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas Dewan Komisaris dalam melakukan pengawasan atas pengelolaan perusahaan oleh Direksi.
2. Melakukan pengawasan dan evaluasi atas penerapan fungsi audit internal dan eksternal, serta kecukupan pengendalian internal pada proses pelaporan keuangan.
3. Memberikan rekomendasi penunjukan Kantor Akuntan Publik kepada Dewan Komisaris.

# Pedoman Kerja: Piagam Komite Audit

Komite Audit melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya dalam melakukan pengawasan terhadap pengendalian internal dengan mengacu kepada Piagam Komite Audit. Piagam Komite Audit dan Kode Etik Komite Audit Allo Bank telah disesuaikan dengan Peraturan OJK No. 55/POJK.04/2015 tentang Pembentukan dan Pedoman Pelaksanaan Kerja Komite Audit.

# Masa Tugas dan Kompensasi

1. Masa tugas anggota Komite Audit tidak boleh lebih lama dari masa jabatan Dewan Komisaris sebagaimana diatur dalam Anggaran Dasar dan dapat dipilih kembali untuk 1 (satu) periode berikutnya.
2. Apabila anggota Dewan Komisaris yang menjadi Ketua Komite Audit berhenti sebelum masa tugasnya sebagai Komisaris Bank, maka Ketua Komite Audit digantikan oleh Komisaris Independen lainnya.
3. Apabila masa tugas sebagai Dewan Komisaris berakhir, maka berakhir pula masa tugasnya sebagai Anggota Komite Audit.
4. Anggota Komite Audit yang berasal dari Pihak Independen Non Komisaris diberi honorarium bulanan yang jumlahnya ditetapkan oleh Dewan Komisaris dengan tetap mengacu pada ketentuan perundangan yang berlaku.

# Persyaratan Keanggotaan

1. Persyaratan umum:
a. Memiliki integritas, akhlak dan moral yang baik.
b. Tidak memiliki kepentingan/keterkaitan pribadi yang dapat menimbulkan conflict of interest terhadap Bank.

2. Persyaratan Kompetensi:
a. Memiliki keahlian, kemampuan, pengetahuan dan pengalaman yang memadai yang berhubungan dengan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya.
b. Memiliki pengetahuan yang cukup untuk memahami bisnis dan industri perbankan, proses audit, manajemen risiko dan kemampuan membaca laporan keuangan dan laporan-laporan terkait pelaksanaan pengendalian internal industri perbankan.
c. Mampu bekerja sama dan memiliki kemampuan berkomunikasi dengan baik dan efektif serta bersedia menyediakan waktu yang cukup untuk melaksanakan tugasnya.

# Purpose of Establishing the Audit Committee

The Bank established an Audit Committee to:

1. Assist/support the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners' supervisory duties over the management of the company by the Board of Directors.
2. Supervise and evaluate the implementation of internal and external audit functions, the adequacy of internal controls on financial reporting processes.
3. Provide recommendations for the appointment of Public Accountant Firm to the Board of Commissioners.

# Work Guidelines: Audit Committee Charter

The Audit Committee performs its duties and responsibilities in supervising internal control by adhering to the Audit Committee Charter. The Audit Committee Charter and the Allo Bank Audit Committee Code of Ethics have been adjusted to OJK Regulation No. 55/POJK.04/2015 on the Establishment and Guidelines for Implementing the Work of the Audit Committee.

# Term of Service and Compensation

1. The term of office of members of the Audit Committee may not be longer than the term of office of the Board of Commissioners as regulated in the Articles of Association and may be re-elected for 1 (one) subsequent period.
2. If the member of the Board of Commissioners who is the Head of the Audit Committee resigns before his/her term of office as Bank Commissioner, the Head of the Audit Committee will be replaced by another Independent Commissioner.
3. If the term of service as a Board of Commissioners ends, the term of duty as a Member of the Audit Committee also ends.
4. Audit Committee members who come from Independent Non-Commissioner Parties are given a monthly honorarium, the amount of which is determined by the Board of Commissioners while still referring to the applicable statutory provisions.

# Membership Requirements

1. General requirements:
a. Have integrity, good morals and morals.
b. Have no personal interests/relationships that could give rise to a conflict of interest towards the Bank.

2. Competency Requirements:
a. Have adequate skills, abilities, knowledge and experience related to their duties and responsibilities.
b. Have sufficient knowledge to understand the business and banking industry, audit processes, risk management and the ability to read financial reports and reports related to the implementation of internal control in the banking industry.
c. Able to work together and have the ability to communicate well and effectively and willing to provide sufficient time to carry out their duties.

# Wewenang Komite Audit

Dalam melaksanakan tugasnya, Komite memiliki wewenang sebagai berikut:

1. Melakukan komunikasi dengan Kepala Unit Kerja, pihak-pihak lain di Bank dan auditor eksternal untuk memperoleh informasi, klarifikasi serta meminta dokumen dan laporan yang diperlukan.
2. Mengakses catatan atau informasi tentang pegawai, dana, aset serta sumber daya perusahaan lainnya yang berkaitan dengan pelaksanaan tugasnya.
3. Memperoleh Laporan Keuangan, Laporan Audit dan laporan lainnya terkait penerapan pengendalian internal Bank.
4. Mendapatkan masukan dan atau saran dari pihak luar Bank yang berkaitan dengan tugasnya.
5. Melakukan kewenangan lain yang diberikan oleh Dewan Komisaris.

# Independensi Komite Audit

Seluruh anggota Komite Audit wajib memberikan pernyataan independensi yang diperbarui secara berkala setiap tahunnya. Pernyataan independensi Komite Audit disusun sesuai POJK No. 55/POJK.04/2015 tentang Pembentukan dan Pedoman Pelaksanaan Kerja Komite Audit Pasal 7, terkait persyaratan Keanggotaan dan Masa tugas Komite Audit.

# Authority of the Audit Committee

In carrying out its duties, the Committee has the following authorities:

Komite Pemantau Risiko merupakan komite yang bertugas untuk membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam menjalankan fungsi pengawasan, khususnya evaluasi terhadap kepatuhan antara kebijakan dan parameter manajemen risiko dengan implementasinya.

Pembentukan Komite Pemantau Risiko berpedoman dan berlandaskan kepada peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku serta best practices yang diterapkan di lembaga perbankan di Indonesia, termasuk:

1. Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan ("POJK") No.33/POJK.04/2014 tanggal 8 Desember 2014 tentang Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris Emiten atau Perusahaan Publik.
2. POJK No. 17/POJK.03/2023 tanggal 14 September 2023 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum.
3. SEOJK No. 13/SEOJK.03/2017 tanggal 17 Maret 2017 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum.
4. POJK No. 18/POJK.03/2016 tanggal 16 Maret 2016 tentang Penerapan Manajemen Risiko bagi Bank Umum.
5. POJK No. 38/POJK.03/2016 tanggal 14 Desember 2016 tentang Penerapan Manajemen Risiko dalam Penggunaan Teknologi Informasi oleh Bank Umum.
6. Anggaran Dasar Bank.

# Tujuan Pembentukan Komite Pemantau Risiko

Komite Pemantau Risiko dibentuk sesuai dengan ketentuan OJK dengan tujuan untuk membantu fungsi pengawasan Dewan Komisaris terkait:

# Risk Oversight Committee

The Risk Oversight Committee is a committee tasked with assisting the Board of Commissioners in carrying out its supervisory function, particularly evaluating compliance between risk management policies and parameters and their implementation.

# Legal Basis

The formation of the Risk Oversight Committee is guided by and based on applicable laws and regulations as well as best practices implemented in banking institutions in Indonesia, including:

1. Financial Services Authority Regulation ("POJK") No.33/POJK.04/2014 dated December 8, 2014 concerning the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners of Issuers or Public Companies.
2. POJK No. 17/POJK.03/2023 dated September 14, 2023 concerning Implementation of Governance for Conventional Bank.
3. SEOJK No. 13/SEOJK.03/2017 dated March 17, 2017 concerning Implementation of Governance for Conventional Bank.
4. POJK No. 18/POJK.03/2016 dated March 16, 2016 concerning the Implementation of Risk Management for Conventional Bank.
5. POJK No. 38/POJK.03/2016 dated December 14, 2016 concerning the Implementation of Risk Management in the Use of Information Technology by Conventional Bank.
6. Bank Articles of Association.

# Purpose of Establishing a Risk Oversight Committee

The Risk Oversight Committee was established in accordance with the provisions of the Financial Services Authority. The committee aims to assist the supervisory function of the Board of Commissioners regarding:

1. evaluate compliance between risk management policies and parameters and their implementation.
2. provide recommendations to maintain the quality of risk management implementation
3. improve the overall control environment

# Pedoman Kerja: Piagam Komite Pemantau Risiko

Komite Pemantau Risiko telah memiliki pedoman kerja yang ditetapkan dalam Piagam Komite Pemantau Risiko. Piagam tersebut mengatur mengenai tugas dan tanggung jawab Komite, wewenang, struktur keanggotaan, persyaratan keanggotaan, mekanisme kerja, etika, waktu kerja, dan mekanisme rapat.

# Masa Tugas dan Kompensasi

1. Masa tugas anggota Komite Pemantau Risiko tidak boleh lebih lama dari masa jabatan Dewan Komisaris sebagaimana diatur dalam Anggaran Dasar dan dapat dipilih kembali untuk 1 (satu) periode berikutnya.
2. Masa tugas anggota Komite Pemantau Risiko yang berasal dari Pihak Independen Non Komisaris paling lama 3 (tiga) tahun dan dapat diperpanjang 1 (satu) kali selama 2 (dua) tahun masa tugas dengan tidak mengurangi hak Dewan Komisaris untuk memberhentikan sewaktu-waktu.
3. Apabila anggota Dewan Komisaris yang menjadi Ketua Komite Pemantau Risiko berhenti sebelum masa tugasnya sebagai Komisaris Bank, maka Ketua Komite Pemantau Risiko digantikan oleh Komisaris Independen lainnya.
4. Apabila masa tugas sebagai Dewan Komisaris berakhir, maka berakhir pula masa tugasnya sebagai Anggota Komite Pemantau Risiko.
5. Anggota Komite Pemantau Risiko yang berasal dari Pihak Independen Non Komisaris diberi honorarium bulanan yang jumlahnya ditetapkan oleh Dewan Komisaris dengan tetap mengacu pada ketentuan perundangan.

# Keanggotaan Komite Pemantau Risiko

Ketentuan keanggotaan Komite Pemantau Risiko Bank ditetapkan sebagai berikut:

1. Komite Pemantau Risiko sekurang-kurangnya terdiri dari 3 (tiga) orang yang berasal dari Komisaris Independen Independen.
2. Komposisi keanggotaan Komite Pemantau Risiko paling kurang 1 (satu) orang Komisaris Independen sebagai Ketua merangkap anggota, 1 (satu) orang Pihak Independen Non Komisaris yang memiliki keahlian di bidang keuangan, dan 1 (satu) orang Pihak Independen Non Komisaris yang memiliki keahlian di bidang manajemen risiko.
