# Charter of the Risk Oversight Committee

The Risk Oversight Committee has work guidelines set out in the Risk Oversight Committee Charter. The charter regulates the duties and responsibilities of the Committee, authority, membership structure, membership requirements, work mechanisms, ethics, working hours and meeting mechanisms.

# Term of Service and Compensation

1. The term of office of members of the Risk Oversight Committee may not be longer than the term of office of the Board of Commissioners as regulated in the Articles of Association and may be re-elected for 1 (one) subsequent period.
2. The term of office of members of the Risk Oversight Committee who come from Independent Non-Commissioner Parties is a maximum of 3 (three) years and can be extended 1 (one) time for a period of 2 (two) years without reducing the right of the Board of Commissioners to dismiss at any time.
3. If the member of the Board of Commissioners who is the Chair of the Risk Oversight Committee resigns before his term of office as Bank Commissioner, then the Chair of the Risk Oversight Committee will be replaced by another Independent Commissioner.
4. If the term of service as a member of the Board of Commissioners ends, the term of duty as a Member of the Risk Oversight Committee also ends.
5. Members of the Risk Oversight Committee who come from Independent Non-Commissioner Parties are given a monthly honorarium whose amount is determined by the Board of Commissioners while still referring to the applicable statutory provisions.

# Membership of Risk Oversight Committee

1. The Risk Oversight Committee consists of at least 3 (three) people from Independent Commissioners and Independent Parties.

# Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Komite Pemantau Risiko

Dalam menjalankan fungsinya, Komite harus bertindak secara independen dalam melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawab antara lain sebagai berikut:

1. Melakukan pemantauan dan evaluasi atas:

a. Kesesuaian antara kebijakan manajemen risiko dan kebijakan manajemen risiko terintegrasi Bank dengan pelaksanaan kebijakan tersebut.
b. Pelaksanaan rencana kerja dan tugas Komite Manajemen Risiko, Komite Manajemen Risiko Terintegrasi, Satuan Kerja Manajemen Risiko, serta Satuan Kerja Manajemen Risiko Terintegrasi Bank.
c. Kecukupan proses identifikasi, pengukuran, pemantauan, pengendalian dan sistem informasi manajemen risiko.
d. Kepatuhan Bank terhadap Anggaran Dasar, peraturan Otoritas Pengawas Bank dan Pasar Modal, serta peraturan perundangan lainnya yang terkait dengan manajemen risiko.

2. Melakukan pemantauan dan penelaahan atas:

a. Laporan Tingkat Kesehatan Bank berbasis risiko.
b. Laporan lainnya terkait dengan pengelolaan 10 (sepuluh) jenis risiko yaitu Risiko Kredit, Risiko Pasar, Risiko Operasional, Risiko Likuiditas, Risiko Hukum, Risiko Kepatuhan, Risiko Reputasi, Risiko Strategik, Risiko Transaksi Intra Group, dan Risiko Asuransi.
c. Kebijakan umum perkreditan serta kewajiban lainnya yang diwajibkan Regulator untuk disampaikan kepada Dewan Komisaris oleh Direksi.

# Duties and Responsibilities of Risk Oversight Committee

In carrying out its functions, the Committee must act independently in carrying out its duties and responsibilities, including the following:

1. Monitor and evaluate:

a. Conformity between risk management policies and the Bank's integrated risk management policies with the implementation of these policies.
b. Implementation of work plans and duties of the Risk Management Committee, Integrated Risk Management Committee, Risk Management Work Unit, and the Bank's Integrated Risk Management Work Unit.
c. Adequacy of identification, measurement, monitoring, control processes and risk management information systems.
d. Bank compliance with the Articles of Association, regulations of the Bank and Capital Market Supervisory Authority, as well as other laws and regulations related to risk management.

2. Monitor and review:

a. Risk-based Bank Soundness Level Report.
b. Other reports related to the management of 10 (ten) types of risk, namely Credit Risk, Market Risk, Operational Risk, Liquidity Risk, Legal Risk, Compliance Risk, Reputation Risk, Strategic Risk, Intra Group Transaction Risk, and Insurance Risk.

In carrying out its duties, the Committee has the following authorities:

5. Carry out other authorities granted by the Board of Commissioners.

## Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi

Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi adalah komite pendukung Dewan Komisaris yang bertugas untuk melakukan pengawasan dan memberikan pendapat yang independen kepada Dewan Komisaris terkait kebijakan remunerasi dan nominasi.

## Dasar Hukum

Pembentukan Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi berpedoman dan berlandaskan kepada peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku serta best practices yang diterapkan di lembaga perbankan di Indonesia, termasuk:

1. Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan ("POJK") No. 33/POJK.04/2014 tanggal 8 Desember 2014 tentang Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris Emiten atau Perusahaan Publik.
2. POJK No. 17/POJK.03/2023 tanggal 14 September 2023 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum.
3. SEOJK No. 13/SEOJK.03/2017 tanggal 17 Maret 2017 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum.
4. POJK No. 34/POJK.04/2014 tanggal 8 Desember 2014 tentang Komite Nominasi Dan Remunerasi Emiten Atau Perusahaan Publik.
5. Anggaran Dasar Bank.

## Persyaratan Keanggotaan Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi

1. Persyaratan umum:
a. Memiliki integritas, akhlak dan moral yang baik.
b. Tidak memiliki kepentingan/keterkaitan pribadi yang dapat menimbulkan conflict of interest terhadap Bank.

2. Monitor and evaluate Risk Management policies and other policies related to Bank risks and evaluate the suitability between risk management policies and their implementation.
3. Monitor Risk Appetite, including risk appetite statements, tolerance limits and risk limits in accordance with the risk matrix that has been set for eight types of risk and capital resilience, including the Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process and the implementation of stress tests.
4. Monitor the Bank's capital by linking the level of risk with capital adequacy to anticipate potential losses that may arise from the Bank's business activities.
5. Evaluate and provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding the implementation of the duties of the Risk Management Committee and the Risk Management Work Unit; and provide recommendations related to reports to OJK such as Risk Profile Reports, Bank Health Reports and other reports in order to ensure the appropriateness of information delivery to OJK on the risk conditions faced by the Bank.
6. Monitor Bank Soundness Level based on independent assessment.

## Remuneration and Nomination Committee

Remuneration and Nomination Committee is tasked with assisting the Board of Commissioners in carrying out supervision and providing independent advices to the Board, especially on remuneration and nomination committee.

## Legal Basis

The establishment of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee is guided by and based on applicable laws and regulations and best practices implemented in banking institutions in Indonesia, including:

1. Financial Services Authority Regulation ("POJK") No. 33/POJK.04/2014 dated December 8, 2014 concerning the Directors and Board of Commissioners of Issuers or Public Companies.
2. POJK No. 17/POJK.03/2023 dated September 14, 2023 concerning the Implementation of Governance for Conventional Bank.
3. SEOJK No. 13/SEOJK.03/2017 dated March 17, 2017 concerning the Implementation of Governance for Conventional Bank.
4. POJK No. 34/POJK.04/2014 dated December 8, 2014 concerning the Nomination and Remuneration Committees for Issuers or Public Companies.
5. Bank Articles of Association.

## Membership Requirement for Remuneration and Nomination Committee

1. General requirements:
a. Have integrity, good morals and morals.
b. Have no personal interests/relationships that could give rise to a conflict of interest towards the Bank.

Pedoman Kerja: Piagam Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi

Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi telah memiliki pedoman kerja yang ditetapkan dalam Piagam Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi. Piagam tersebut mengatur mengenai tugas dan tanggung jawab Komite, wewenang, struktur keanggotaan, persyaratan keanggotaan, mekanisme kerja, etika, waktu kerja, dan mekanisme rapat.

Masa Tugas Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi

1. Masa tugas anggota Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi tidak boleh lebih lama dari masa jabatan Dewan Komisaris sebagaimana diatur dalam Anggaran Dasar.
2. Penggantian anggota Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi yang bukan berasal dari Dewan Komisaris dilakukan paling lambat 60 (enam puluh) hari sejak anggota Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi dimaksud tidak dapat lagi melaksanakan fungsinya.
3. Apabila anggota Dewan Komisaris yang menjadi Ketua Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi berhenti sebelum masa tugasnya sebagai Komisaris Bank, maka Ketua Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi digantikan oleh Komisaris Independen lainnya.
4. Apabila masa tugas sebagai Dewan Komisaris berakhir, maka berakhir pula masa tugasnya sebagai Anggota Komite Remunerasi dan Nominasi.

2. Competency Requirements:
a. Have adequate skills, abilities, knowledge and experience related to their duties and responsibilities.
b. Have adequate knowledge of the Bank's Articles of Association, laws and regulations in the banking sector, Capital Markets and laws and regulations related to human resources.
c. Be willing to continuously improve competence through education and training.

3. Confidentiality:
a. Members of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee are obliged to maintain the confidentiality of all Bank documents and/or information as well as everything related to the Bank and the implementation of the Committee's duties. The classification of confidentiality of Bank documents and/or information refers to internal provisions and applicable laws and regulations.
b. The obligation to keep various matters confidential also applies if the term of office as a member of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee or the term of office as a member of the Board of Commissioners at the Bank ends.

Work Guidelines: Remuneration and Nomination Committee Charter

The Remuneration and Nomination Committee has work guidelines stipulated in the Remuneration and Nomination Committee Charter. The charter regulates the duties and responsibilities of the Committee, authority, membership structure, membership requirements, work mechanisms, ethics, working hours and meeting mechanisms.

Term of Service of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee

1. The term of office of members of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee may not be longer than the term of office of the Board of Commissioners as regulated in the Articles of Association.
2. Replacement of members of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee who are not members of the Board of Commissioners shall be carried out no later than 60 (sixty) days after the members of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee are no longer able to carry out their functions.
3. If the member of the Board of Commissioners who is the Chair of the Remuneration & Nomination Committee resigns before his term of office as Bank Commissioner, then the Head of the Remuneration & Nomination Committee will be replaced by another Independent Commissioner.
4. If the term of service as a member of the Board of Commissioners ends, the term of duty as a member of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee also ends.

# Organ Pendukung Direksi
Supporting Organ of Board of Directors

Dalam membantu menjalankan tugas pengelolaan Bank, Direksi dapat membentuk organ pendukung sebagaimana diatur dalam ketentuan perundang-undangan. Direksi telah memiliki organ pendukung struktural, yakni Sekretaris Perusahaan & PMO dan Satuan Kerja Audit Internal (SKAI) serta organ pendukung non-struktural yang terdiri dari Komite Kredit, Komite Kebijakan Perkreditan, Komite Aktiva dan Pasiva, Komite Manajemen Risiko, Komite Pengarah Teknologi Informasi, dan Komite Produk serta Komite Sumber Daya Manusia.

## Komite Manajemen Risiko

Bank membentuk Komite Manajemen Risiko untuk membantu dan memberikan arahan bagi anggota Direksi dalam melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawab terhadap proses implementasi manajemen risiko di Bank dan Untuk mewujudkan penerapan manajemen risiko yang efektif dan pelaksanaan fungsi manajemen risiko dalam mengelola keseluruhan eksposur risiko Bank.

In assisting in carrying out the Bank's management duties, the Board of Directors may form supporting organs as stipulated in the provisions of the law. The Board of Directors has structural supporting organs, namely the Corporate Secretary & PMO and Internal Audit Work Unit (SKAI) as well as non-structural supporting organs consisting of the Credit Committee, Credit Policy Committee, Asset and Liability Committee, Risk Management Committee, Information Technology Steering Committee, and Product Committee and Human Resources Committee.

The Bank has formed a Risk Management Committee to assist and provide direction to members of the Board of Directors in carrying out their duties and responsibilities regarding the risk management implementation process at the Bank and to realize effective risk management implementation and implementation of risk management functions in managing the Bank's overall risk exposure.

1. Penyusunan kebijakan Manajemen Risiko serta perubahannya, termasuk strategi Manajemen Risiko, Tingkat Risiko yang diambil dan Toleransi Risiko, kerangka Manajemen Risiko serta rencana kontinjensi untuk mengantisipasi terjadinya kondisi tidak normal.
2. Penyusunan kebijakan Manajemen Risiko serta perubahannya, termasuk strategi Manajemen Risiko, Tingkat Risiko yang diambil dan Toleransi Risiko, kerangka Manajemen Risiko serta rencana kontinjensi untuk mengantisipasi terjadinya kondisi tidak normal.
3. Penetapan kebijakan dan/atau keputusan bisnis yang menyimpang dari prosedur normal, seperti pelampauan ekspansi usaha yang signifikan dibandingkan dengan Rencana Bisnis Bank yang telah ditetapkan sebelumnya, atau pengambilan posisi/eksposur Risiko yang melampaui limit yang telah ditetapkan.
4. Menetapkan Risk Limit (Risk Appetite dan Risk Tolerance) dari setiap bidang Risiko (Risk Taking Limit).
5. Memantau dan mengevaluasi penerapan Risk Limit disesuaikan dengan ketentuan Risk Limit yang berlaku.
6. Menetapkan kebijakan yang harus diambil berdasarkan hasil evaluasi.
7. Mengevaluasi Laporan Profil Risiko Triwulanan dan Semesteran serta Laporan Penilaian Tingkat Kesehatan Bank (PTKB) sebelum disampaikan ke OJK sebagai laporan rutin.
8. Mengevaluasi agar strategi bisnis Bank sejalan dengan strategi Risiko.
9. Memantau isu-isu yang cukup signifikan melalui laporan yang disampaikan oleh sekretariat Komite.

# Duties and Authorities of Risk Management Committee

The Risk Management Committee is tasked with and responsible for conducting evaluations and providing recommendations to the President Director, not to mention:

1. Preparation of Risk Management policies and changes thereto, including Risk Management strategies, Level of Risk taken and Risk Tolerance, Risk Management framework and contingency plans to anticipate the occurrence of abnormal conditions.
2. Preparation of Risk Management policies and changes thereto, including Risk Management strategies, Level of Risk taken and Risk Tolerance, Risk Management framework and contingency plans to anticipate the occurrence of abnormal conditions.
3. Determination of policies and/or business decisions that deviate from normal procedures, such as exceeding significant business expansion compared to the Bank's previously determined Business Plan, or taking Risk positions/exposures that exceed predetermined limits.
4. Determine the Risk Limit (Risk Appetite and Risk Tolerance) for each Risk area (Risk Taking Limit).
5. Monitor and evaluate the implementation of Risk Limits in accordance with applicable Risk Limit provisions.
6. Determine the policies that must be taken based on the evaluation results.
7. Evaluate the Quarterly and Semester Risk Profile Reports as well as the Bank Health Level Assessment Report (PTKB) before submitting it to the OJK as a routine report.
8. Conduct evaluation to align the Bank's business strategy with the Risk strategy.
9. Monitor significant issues through reports submitted by the Committee secretariat.

# Report on Implementation of Risk Management Committee Activities

In 2024, the Risk Management Committee carried out its duties, including:

1. Update the Risk Management Policy.
2. Ratify the renewal of the Risk Management Committee charter.
3. Provide recommendations on risk appetite statements and risk profiles prepared by management and determining the Bank's Health Level.
4. Evaluate the results of assessing eight types of Bank Risk Profiles, including Credit, Market, Liquidity, Operational, Reputation, Legal, Strategic and Compliance Risk.
5. Monitor the Bank's Risk Appetite Statement, including risk limits in accordance with the risk matrix that has been determined for eight types of risk and capital resilience.
6. Evaluate the Bank's capital management by linking the level of risk to capital adequacy in accordance with regulations.

# Tugas dan Wewenang Komite ALCO

1. Menetapkan target keuangan Bank (jangka pendek dan menengah) gunai mempertahankan dan meningkatkan nilai Bank melalui optimalisasi spread antara pendapatan dan biaya pada tingkat risiko yang dapat ditoleransi.
2. Memastikan bahwa target keuangan yang ditetapkan Bank mendapatkan persetujuan dari Dewan Komisaris. Pelaksanaan disiplin Asset and Liabilities Management (ALMA) oleh ALCO secara praktis mengarah kepada pencapaian target-target keuangan tersebut.
3. Menetapkan strategi ALMA untuk mencapai target-target tersebut melalui: (i) Penetapan Rencana Bisnis; (ii) Komposisi neraca dan off balance sheet aktiva/pasiva; (iii) Produk dan jasa yang ditawarkan; (iv) Penentuan tingkat suku bunga dan/atau pricing untuk semua produk dan jasa Bank.

# Duties and Authorities of ALCO Committee

1. Establish the Bank's financial targets (short and medium term) to maintain and increase the Bank's value by optimizing the spread between income and costs at a tolerable risk level.
2. Ensure that the Bank's financial targets are approved by the Board of Commissioners. The implementation of the Asset and Liabilities Management (ALMA) discipline by ALCO practically leads to the achievement of these financial targets.
3. Establish the ALMA strategy to achieve these targets, through: (i) Determination of the Business Plan; (ii) Composition of the balance sheet and off balance sheet assets/liabilities; (iii) Products and services offered; (iv) Determination of interest rates and/or pricing for all Bank products and services.

# Fungsi Kepatuhan
# Compliance Function

Fungsi kepatuhan Allo Bank dibentuk sebagai bagian dari serangkaian tindakan atau langkah preventif untuk memastikan bahwa kebijakan, ketentuan, sistem, dan prosedur, serta kegiatan usaha yang dilakukan oleh Bank telah sesuai dengan ketentuan dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Serta memastikan kepatuhan Bank terhadap komitmen yang dibuat Bank kepada Regulator dan/atau otoritas pengawas lain yang berwenang.

Kondisi bisnis perbankan yang terus berkembang membuat Bank turut dihadapkan oleh penambahan eksposur risiko. Perkembangan kondisi ini mengharuskan Bank untuk melakukan upaya preventif (exante) maupun kuratif (ex-post) untuk memitigasi risiko tersebut. Untuk itu, Bank membentuk Satuan Kerja Kepatuhan yang bertugas untuk menjalankan fungsi kepatuhan guna memastikan eksposur risiko dalam kegiatan usaha Bank dapat ditekan melalui tindakan yang bersifat preventif (ex-ante).

Dalam menerapkan fungsi kepatuhan, Allo Bank mengacu pada Peraturan OJK No. 46/POJK.03/2017 tentang Pelaksanaan Fungsi Kepatuhan Bank Umum. Saat ini Allo Bank telah memiliki kebijakan dari standar prosedur kepatuhan yang menjabarkan tugas dan tanggung jawab Satuan Kerja Kepatuhan dalam menjalankan fungsi kepatuhan.

# Struktur Organisasi Fungsi Kepatuhan

Pembentukan Satuan Kerja Kepatuhan selaku pelaksana fungsi kepatuhan Bank telah ditetapkan melalui SK Direksi No. 101/DIRAB/24 tanggal 19 Desember 2024 tentang Perubahan Struktur Organisasi (Januari 2025) PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk. Satuan Kerja Kepatuhan bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Direktur yang membawahkan fungsi kepatuhan. Penunjukan dan pengangkatan Direktur yang membawahkan fungsi kepatuhan telah memenuhi persyaratan yang berlaku dan dilaksanakan melalui proses sebagaimana ditentukan oleh OJK.

Allo Bank's compliance function was formed as part of a series of preventive actions or steps to ensure that policies, provisions, systems, and procedures, as well as business activities carried out by the Bank are in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. As well as ensuring the Bank's compliance with the commitments made by the Bank to the Regulator and/or other authorized supervisory authorities.

The ever-evolving banking business conditions have also put the Bank in a position against the increasing risk exposure. These conditions require the Bank to make preventive (ex-ante) and curative (ex-post) efforts to mitigate these risks. To that end, the Bank has formed a Compliance Work Unit tasked with carrying out the compliance function to ensure that risk exposure in the Bank's business activities can be reduced through preventive (ex-ante) actions.

In implementing the compliance function, Allo Bank refers to OJK Regulation No. 46/POJK.03/2017 concerning the Implementation of the Compliance Function of Conventional Bank. Currently, Allo Bank has a policy of standard compliance procedures that outlines the duties and responsibilities of the Compliance Work Unit in carrying out the compliance function.

# Compliance Function Structure

The establishment of the Compliance Work Unit as the executor of the Bank's compliance function has been determined through the Decree of the Board of Directors No. 101/DIRAB/24 dated December 19, 2024 concerning Changes to the Organizational Structure (January 2025) of PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk. The Compliance Work Unit is directly responsible to the Director in charge of the compliance function. The appointment and promotion of the Director in charge of the compliance function has met the applicable requirements and is carried out through a process as determined by the OJK.

# Risk Management

Sebagai wujud komitmen dalam menjalankan praktik tata kelola perusahaan yang baik, Allo Bank menerapkan pengelolaan risiko terkini secara proaktif demi mencapai pertumbuhan keuangan maupun operational yang optimal. Untuk itu, Bank menjadikan pengelolaan risiko sebagai tanggung jawab manajemen dalam memastikan tercapainya saran organisasi dengan melakukan internalisasi proses manajemen risiko di Bank sehingga akan melekat pada setiap aktivitas. Di samping itu, Bank juga menerapkan manajemen risiko terpadu dan komprehensif sehingga mampu mendukung pencapaian target kinerja dan menjaga kelangsungan usaha.

As a token of our commitment to implementing good corporate governance practices, Allo Bank adopts the latest risk management principles proactively to achieve optimal financial and operational growth. To that end, the Bank delegates management to be responsible for the risk management in ensuring the achievement of organizational targets by internalizing the risk management process in the Bank, allowing us to attach it in a daily basis. In addition, the Bank also implements integrated and comprehensive risk management, so it can support the achievement of performance targets and maintain business continuity.

Dengan menerapkan strategi manajemen risiko yang proaktif, Bank percaya bahwa hal tersebut dapat meningkatkan efektivitas penggunaan modal dan tingkat pengembalian modal sehingga dapat memberikan nilai tambah bagi pemegang saham. Bank juga memperhatikan cakupan penilaian penerapan manajemen risiko melalui profil risiko Bank, baik penilaian inherent risk maupun penilaian kualitas penerapan manajemen risiko serta menyesuaikan setiap indicator penilaian sesuai dengan peraturan yang baru dengan menggunakan konsep Risk Based Bank Rating (RBBR).

By implementing a proactive risk management strategy, the Bank believes that it can enhance the effectiveness of capital use and the level of return on capital, presenting added value for shareholders. The Bank also pays attention to the scope of risk management implementation assessment through the Bank's risk profile, both inherent risk assessment and risk management implementation quality assessment and adjusts each assessment indicator in accordance with new regulations using the Risk Based Bank Rating (RBBR) concept.

Mekanisme pengelolaan risiko secara day to day dengan berdasarkan prinsip kehati-hatian telah dituangkan dalam beberapa kebijakan dan prosedur, yang merupakan aturan acuan dalam implementasi manajemen risiko pada seluruh kegiatan bisnis Bank yang meliputi kebijakan, strategi, organisasi, sistem informasi manajemen risiko, pengawasan risiko, pengelolaan produk, aktivitas baru dan Business Continuity Plan (BCP). Untuk menjamin tercapainya praktik manajemen risiko yang baik pada Bank, Komite Pemantau Risiko dan Komite Audit berkontribusi dalam mendukung pelaksanaan tugas Dewan Komisaris. Komite Pemantau Risiko memiliki tanggung jawab dalam pemantauan dan evaluasi pelaksanaan manajemen risiko di Bank, sedangkan Komite Audit bertanggung jawab dalam pemantauan dan evaluasi pelaksanaan audit, pengendalian proses internal dan pelaporan keuangan.

The day-to-day risk management mechanism based on the principle of prudence has been outlined in several policies and procedures, which are reference rules in implementing risk management in all Bank business activities including policies, strategies, organizations, risk management information systems, risk supervision, product management, new activities and Business Continuity Plan (BCP). To ensure the achievement of good risk management practices in the Bank, the Risk Oversight Committee and the Audit Committee contribute to supporting the implementation of the Board of Commissioners' duties. The Risk Oversight Committee is responsible for monitoring and evaluating the implementation of risk management in the Bank, while the Audit Committee is responsible for monitoring and evaluating the implementation of audits, internal process control and financial reporting.

# Gambaran Umum Manajemen Risiko

Sejalan dengan Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 18/ POJK.03/2016 tanggal 16 Maret 2016 tentang Penerapan Manajemen Risiko bagi Bank Umum, Allo Bank memandang perlunya untuk membangun kesadaran dan budaya manajemen risiko terpadu (integrated risk culture) guna mencapai tujuan Bank jangka panjang. Fokus penerapan manajemen risiko Bank sendiri lebih diutamakan pada efektivitas penerapan tata kelola dan kerangka kerja manajemen risiko.

Kerangka Manajemen Risiko

Kerangka kerja manajemen risiko Bank menetapkan pendekatan pengelolaan risiko dan kerangka pengendalian di mana risiko dikelola untuk mendapatkan keseimbangan antara risiko (risk) dan pendapatan (return). Penerapan kerangka kerja manajemen risiko dilakukan melalui perumusan tingkat risiko yang akan diambil (risk appetite), dan toleransi risiko (risk tolerance) bagi setiap jenis risiko, pengembangan kebijakan dan prosedur manajemen risiko yang berkesesuaian serta pengembangan struktur pengendalian internal secara terpadu. Selain itu, Bank juga membangun budaya risiko yang menitikberatkan kesadaran seluruh pegawai akan risiko dan efektivitas proses manajemen risiko. Penerapan manajemen risiko di Allo Bank mengacu pada empat pilar manajemen risiko, yaitu:

1. Pengawasan aktif Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi.
2. Kecukupan kebijakan, prosedur, dan penetapan limit manajemen risiko.
3. Kecukupan proses identifikasi, pengukuran, pemantauan, dan pengendalian Risiko serta sistem informasi manajemen risiko.
4. Sistem pengendalian internal yang menyeluruh.

Penerapan manajemen risiko Allo Bank juga berpedoman pada dokumen-dokumen dari Basel Committee on Banking Supervision.

Struktur Organisasi dan Tata Kelola

Dalam menjalankan memastikan pengelolaan risiko, Bank telah membentuk Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Komite Aset dan Liabilitas (ALCO) pada tingkat Direksi serta Komite Pemantau Risiko pada tingkat Dewan Komisaris. Komite Pemantau Risiko bertanggung jawab untuk mengevaluasi keakuratan kebijakan manajemen risiko dan implementasinya, memantau serta mengevaluasi kinerja dari Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Satuan Kerja Manajemen Risiko. Komite Manajemen Risiko menetapkan strategi, kebijakan, dan prosedur manajemen risiko, serta memantau implementasinya, mengembangkan budaya pengelolaan risiko, dan memastikan sumber daya yang memadai telah dikembangkan untuk memastikan pengelolaan risiko di Allo Bank. Sementara, ALCO bertanggung jawab untuk mengelola modal dan menetapkan kebijakan terkait dengan pengelolaan neraca dan kepatuhan terhadapnya, termasuk di dalamnya manajemen risiko likuiditas, kecukupan modal, dan risiko suku bunga.

General Overview of Risk Management

In line with Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 18/POJK.03/2016 dated March 16, 2016 concerning the Implementation of Risk Management for Conventional Bank, Allo Bank acknowledges the urgency of raising awareness and establishing a culture of integrated risk management in order to achieve the Bank's long-term goals. In implementing the risk management, the Bank has put more emphasis on the effectiveness of implementing governance and risk management frameworks.

Risk Management Framework

The Bank's risk management framework establishes a risk management approach and control framework in which risk is managed to achieve a balance between risk and return. The risk management framework is formed through the formulation of the level of risk to be taken (risk appetite), and risk tolerance for each type of risk, the development of appropriate risk management policies and procedures, and the development of an integrated internal control structure. In addition, the Bank also builds a risk culture that emphasizes the awareness of all employees of risk and the effectiveness of the risk management process. The implementation of risk management at Allo Bank refers to four pillars of risk management, namely:

Active supervision of the Board of Commissioners and Directors.
Adequacy of risk management policies, procedures, and determination of limits.
Adequacy of the process of identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of Risk and the risk management information system.
Comprehensive internal control system.

The implementation of Allo Bank's risk management is also guided by documents from the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision.

Organizational Structure and Governance

In ensuring risk management, the Bank has established a Risk Management Committee and an Asset and Liability Committee (ALCO) at the Board of Directors level and a Risk Oversight Committee at the Board of Commissioners level. The Risk Oversight Committee is responsible for evaluating the accuracy of risk management policies and their implementation, monitoring and evaluating the performance of the Risk Management Committee and the Risk Management Work Unit. The Risk Management Committee establishes risk management strategies, policies, and procedures, and monitors their implementation, develops a risk management culture, and ensures that adequate resources have been developed to ensure risk management at Allo Bank. Meanwhile, ALCO is responsible for managing capital and establishing policies related to balance sheet management and compliance with it, including liquidity risk management, capital adequacy, and interest rate risk.

# Jenis Risiko

Sesuai aturan POJK No. 18/POJK.03/2016 dan SEOJK No. 34/SEOJK.03/2016 tentang Penerapan Manajemen Risiko bagi Bank Umum, Allo Bank mengelola risiko berdasarkan aktivitas fungsional Bank yang terdiri dari:

## Risiko Kredit

Risiko Kredit adalah risiko yang timbul sebagai akibat kegagalan counterparty memenuhi liabilitasnya. Bank melakukan pengelolaan risiko kredit dengan menyusun strategi dan kerangka kerja serta menjalankan upaya mitigasi risiko atas aspek bisnis perkreditan mikro, retail, komersial, maupun konsumsi, penempatan antar-bank serta pembelian surat berharga. Bank memiliki aktivitas perkreditan melalui model bisnis kredit digital, seperti Paylater dan Instant Cash. Bank menerapkan proses risk management mulai dari identifikasi, pengukuran, pemantauan hingga pengendalian risiko kredit untuk dapat dikelola dengan tepat dan efektif.

Bank menyadari bahwa dengan mengubah model bisnis menjadi digital, risiko yang melekat pada aktivitas perkreditan yang berbasis platform digital akan timbul, mulai dari akses calon debitur yang lebih luas karena dapat diakses oleh calon debitur kapanpun dan dimanapun. Selain itu platform digital membutuhkan verifikasi calon debitur dan dokumen persyaratan yang lebih akurat akibat tidak adanya tatap muka langsung dengan calon debitur dan tanpa penyerahan dokumentasi fisik.

Untuk menjaga agar kualitas kredit Bank tetap terjaga dengan baik, maka pemantauan terhadap kualitas kredit terus dilakukan secara rutin, baik per kategori kredit maupun portofolio kredit secara keseluruhan. Sistem pengukuran profil risiko debitur, prosedur, sistem manajemen risiko, sistem database dan organisasi perkreditan terus disempurnakan dengan penekanan kepada penerapan prinsip "empat mata" (four eyes principle) dimana keputusan kredit diambil berdasarkan pertimbangan dari dua sisi, yaitu sisi pengembangan bisnis dan sisi analisis risiko kredit.

## Risiko Pasar

Risiko pasar (market risk) merupakan risiko yang timbul dari portofolio yang dimiliki oleh Bank karena adanya pergerakan variabel pasar (adverse movement) yang berpotensi merugikan Bank. Risiko pasar sendiri dibagi menjadi 2 (dua), yakni risiko suku bunga dan risiko nilai tukar. Secara umum, langkah-langkah dan rencana yang dilakukan untuk mengantisipasi risiko pasar atas transaksi yang terkait dengan risiko nilai tukar dan suku bunga adalah dengan melakukan penetapan dan kontrol limit risiko pasar seperti Limit VaR, Limit Nominal dan Limit Stop Loss serta melakukan stress test dalam mengukur risiko. Pengelolaan risiko pasar sebagai Bank umum berbasis digital juga akan tetap berpedoman dalam pengelolaan risiko pasar yang sehat.

# Types of Risk

In accordance with POJK No. 18/POJK.03/2016 and SEOJK No. 34/SEOJK.03/2016 concerning the Implementation of Risk Management for Conventional Bank, Allo Bank manages risks based on the Bank's functional activities consisting of:

## Credit Risk

Credit Risk is the risk that arises as a result of the counterparty's failure to fulfill its obligations. The Bank manages credit risk by developing strategies and frameworks and implementing risk mitigation efforts for aspects of micro, retail, commercial, and consumer credit businesses, inter-bank placements and purchases of securities. The Bank has credit activities through digital credit business models, such as Paylater and Instant Cash. The Bank implements a risk management process, starting from identification, measurement, monitoring to control of credit risk that is managed appropriately and effectively.

The Bank realizes that by changing the business model to digital, the risks inherent in credit activities based on digital platforms will arise, starting from wider access for prospective debtors because they can be accessed by prospective debtors anytime and anywhere. In addition, digital platforms require more accurate verification of prospective debtors and required documents due to the absence of direct face-to-face meetings with prospective debtors and without submission of physical documentation.

To ensure that the Bank's credit quality is maintained properly, monitoring of credit quality continues to be carried out routinely, both per credit category and the overall credit portfolio. The debtor risk profile measurement system, procedures, risk management system, database system and credit organization are continuously being improved with an emphasis on the application of the "four eyes" principle where credit decisions are taken based on considerations from two sides, namely the business development side and the credit risk analysis side.

## Market Risk

Market risk is a risk arising from the portfolio owned by the Bank due to the movement of market variables (adverse movement) that has the potential to harm the Bank. Market risk is divided into 2 (two), namely interest rate risk and exchange rate risk. In general, the steps and plans to anticipate market risk on transactions related to exchange rate and interest rate risks are taken by determining and controlling market risk limits such as VaR Limit, Nominal Limit and Stop Loss Limit and conducting stress tests in measuring risk. As a digital-based conventional bank, the Bank consistently upholds sound market risk management.

Risiko strategis adalah risiko antara lain disebabkan adanya penetapan dan pelaksanaan strategi Bank yang tidak tepat, pengambilan keputusan rencana bisnis yang tidak tetap kepada kurang responsifnya Bank terhadap perubahan eksternal. Pengelolaan risiko strategis melalui proses pertimbangan dan pengambilan keputusan setiap kebijakan secara kolektif dan komprehensif oleh Direksi dan Komite-komite yang telah dibentuk serta memantau realisasi rencana strategis dengan membandingkan target yang akan dicapai dan memastikan bahwa risiko yang akan diambil masih dalam batas toleransi.

Bank juga memastikan adanya perlindungan nasabah dengan melakukan identifikasi, menyiapkan dan memastikan kesiapan komunikasi kepada para nasabah agar tidak menimbulkan dampak negatif bagi nasabah yang berpotensi

Strategic risk is a risk caused by, among other things, the determination and implementation of inappropriate Bank strategies, inconsistent business plan decision-making or the Bank's lack of responsiveness to external changes. In line with the Bank's strategy using a digital business model, the Bank manages the suitability of the strategy in accordance with the existing business environment. The Bank also measures the level of competition and the Bank's business position in the formulation of business strategies, as well as the achievement of business plans against the realization of performance achieved.

Reputation risk is a risk caused by, among other things, negative publications related to the Bank's business activities or negative perceptions of the Bank. # 1. Purpose of the Action Plan

The Bank has prepared and submitted a Recovery Action Plan to OJK, aiming to achieve and maintain financial system stability in alignment with the mission of the Government of the Republic of Indonesia to prevent and manage financial system crises in order to support the national economy.

The Recovery Action Plan reflects the Bank's commitment to:

a. Ensuring a stable and resilient financial system capable of withstanding potential financial crises caused by pressure on various financial conditions.
b. Preventing and addressing existing problems by outlining preemptive measures and response strategies to mitigate financial stress that could threaten the Bank's business continuity.

The Recovery Action Plan has been tailored to the Bank's specific conditions and is aligned with Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 5 of 2024 concerning the Determination of Supervision Status and Handling of General Bank Issues, where Article 14 of this regulation requires the Bank to develop and submit a Recovery Action Plan to the Financial Services Authority, covering the following aspects:

a. Executive Summary
b. General Overview of the Bank, including its financial condition, business lines, office network, material subsidiaries, business group structure, and business relationships, along with scenario analyses of potential changes in the Bank's condition.
c. Recovery Options, detailing recovery plan indicators, trigger levels, and recovery strategies related to capital, liquidity, profitability, and asset quality.
d. Disclosure of the Recovery Plan including submission to internal and external parties.

b. Opsi Pemulihan

Rencana Pemulihan pada dasarnya merupakan strategi yang diterapkan oleh Bank untuk mempersiapkan pengeluaran keuangan tak terduga atau darurat. Tujuan utama dari Rencana Pemulihan adalah untuk memastikan bahwa Bank memiliki akses terhadap dana likuid atau sumber dana yang cukup untuk menangani peristiwa keuangan yang tidak terduga yang dapat mempengaruhi operasi atau stabilitas keuangan Bank.

Beberapa komponen utama yang termasuk dalam Rencana Pemulihan adalah:

- Identifikasi potensi risiko;
- Mengidentifikasi potensi risiko atau peristiwa yang dapat menyebabkan kondisi krisis keuangan;
- Penilaian dampak risiko;
- Mengevaluasi potensi dampak risiko keuangan dari peristiwa/risiko krisis yang terjadi;
- Penetapan ambang batas atau pemicu (threshold/ triggers);
- Menetapkan ambang batas atau pemicu (threshold/ triggers) yang mengindikasikan kapan Rencana Pemulihan harus diaktifkan;
- Strategi pendanaan tambahan;
- Mengembangkan strategi untuk memperoleh pendanaan atau likuiditas tambahan selama krisis;
- Prosedur komunikasi dan pelaporan;
- Menyusun prosedur komunikasi dan pelaporan yang jelas untuk memastikan bahwa semua pemangku kepentingan mendapatkan informasi yang diperlukan dan siap menghadapi kondisi krisis keuangan yang terjadi, sebagaimana diatur dalam ketentuan internal lainnya yang berlaku mengenai Crisis Management Plan.

c. Pengungkapan Rencana Pemulihan

Bank akan melakukan pengungkapan Rencana Aksi Pemulihan baik untuk stakeholders internal maupun stakeholders eksternal atau publik secara umum, sebagai bagian dari komitmen terhadap keterbukaan informasi sebagai bentuk komitmen Bank dalam rangka membantu mewujudkan stabilitas sistem keuangan yang kokoh dalam menghadapi ancaman krisis keuangan yang disebabkan oleh tekanan terhadap berbagai kondisi keuangan.

From a risk management perspective, the Bank recognizes that the purpose of the Recovery Plan is to establish a framework that enables the Bank to effectively and efficiently manage the financial impact of severe stress events, thereby preventing failure or forced resolution. The components of the Recovery Plan are derived from and aligned with other risk management processes, including capital and liquidity management, stress testing, business continuity planning, and resolution planning.

b. Recovery Options

The Recovery Plan serves as a strategic approach implemented by the Bank to prepare for unexpected financial distress or emergency situations. Its primary objective is to ensure that the Bank has access to sufficient liquid assets or funding sources to address unforeseen financial events that could impact its operations or overall financial stability.

Some of the key components of the Recovery Plan include:

- Identification of potential risks.
- Identification of potential risks or events that may cause a financial crisis.
- Risk impact assessment.
- Evaluation of the potential financial risk impact of a crisis event or risk.
- Determination of thresholds or triggers.
- Determination of thresholds or triggers that indicate when the Recovery Plan should be activated.
- Additional funding strategies.
- Development of strategies to obtain additional funding or liquidity during a crisis.
- Communication and reporting procedures.
- Establishment of clear communication and reporting procedures to ensure that all stakeholders receive the necessary information and are prepared to respond to any financial crisis conditions, as regulated in other applicable internal provisions regarding the Crisis Management Plan.

c. Disclosure of the Recovery Plan

3. Tata Kelola Rencana Aksi Pemulihan

Rencana Aksi Pemulihan yang efektif membantu manajemen mengidentifikasi kapan Bank menghadapi atau mungkin menghadapi peristiwa stres yang parah yang mengancam atau mungkin mengancam kekuatan keuangan dan kelayakannya. Dalam hal ini, manajemen Bank akan mengambil tindakan yang tepat untuk memulihkan kekuatan keuangan dan kelayakan bank. Rencana Pemulihan sangat penting bagi ketahanan Bank, dan terintegrasi ke dalam kerangka kerja tata kelola risiko Bank, serta memainkan peran penting dalam manajemen krisis. Rencana Pemulihan juga mengakui transisi Bank dari operasi bisnis biasa ke peringatan dini tentang stres parah hingga stres parah itu sendiri, dan terhubung dengan rencana penyelesaian jika penurunan keuangan tidak diperbaiki.

Proses perencanaan pemulihan harus bersifat berkelanjutan. Proses ini melengkapi fungsi tata kelola risiko dan mendukung operasinya yang aman dan sehat. Dalam proses pengembangan dan pemeliharaan Rencana Pemulihan, manajemen dan Direksi terus berkomitmen untuk meningkatkan tata kelola risiko dengan tujuan untuk mengurangi dampak keuangan dari peristiwa tak terduga di masa depan.

Di bawah arahan regulator khususnya OJK, Bank terus mengembangkan pemicu atau metrik sepanjang kontinuum business as usual, peringatan dini, pemulihan, dan penyelesaian agar dapat merespons dengan cepat dan pulih dari dampak keuangan peristiwa stres yang parah.

Bank juga akan mengkoordinasikan Rencana Pemulihan dengan upaya perencanaan pemulihan dan penyelesaian oleh perusahaan induknya, sehingga rencana tersebut konsisten dan tidak saling bertentangan.

4. Penyampaian Rencana Aksi

Bank telah menyampaikan Rencana Aksi kepada Otoritas Jasa Keuangan untuk pertama kalinya pada tahun 2024 dengan mengacu pada Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 5 Tahun 2024 tentang Penetapan Status Pengawasan dan Penanganan Permasalahan Bank Umum dimana pada pasal 14 tercantum bahwa Bank wajib menyusun dan menyampaikan Rencana Aksi Pemulihan kepada Otoritas Jasa Keuangan.

Additionally, the Bank has developed a crisis communication plan as a standardized guideline for managing financial issues within its corporate communications framework. This plan establishes structured governance, communication protocols, and resource allocation to ensure timely and accurate responses to stakeholders. It also assigns clear accountability to the designated crisis management team, aiming to minimize the impact of financial challenges on the Bank's reputation. The disclosure of the Recovery Action Plan follows a structured approach to enhance stakeholder confidence and regulatory compliance.

3. Recovery Action Plan Governance

An effective Recovery Action Plan enables management to identify situations where the Bank is experiencing or may experience a severe stress event that could threaten its financial strength and viability. In such cases, the Bank's management will take appropriate measures to restore financial stability. The Recovery Plan is essential to the Bank's resilience, as it is integrated into the Bank's risk governance framework and plays a key role in crisis management. It also outlines the Bank's transition from normal business operations to early warning of financial distress and, if necessary, to a severe stress scenario. Additionally, it is linked to the resolution plan should the financial deterioration remain unaddressed.

The recovery planning process is continuous, complementing the Bank's risk governance function and supporting its safe and sound operations. In developing and maintaining the Recovery Plan, management and the Board of Directors remain committed to enhancing risk governance to minimize the financial impact of unforeseen future events.

Under regulatory guidance, particularly from OJK, the Bank continues to refine its triggers and metrics across various stages—ranging from business as usual, early warning, recovery, and resolution—ensuring a swift response to financial stress events and facilitating effective recovery.

Furthermore, the Bank coordinates its Recovery Plan with the recovery and resolution planning efforts of its parent company to ensure consistency and alignment, preventing any potential conflicts between the plans.

4. Submission of the Action Plan

The Bank submitted its Action Plan to the Financial Services Authority for the first time in 2024, in accordance with Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 5 of 2024 on the Determination of Supervision Status and Handling of Commercial Bank Issues, where Article 14 of this regulation mandates that banks must prepare and submit a Recovery Action Plan to the Financial Services Authority.

# Sistem Pengendalian Internal

Internal Control System

Sistem Pengendalian Internal (SPI) merupakan suatu mekanisme pengendalian yang ditetapkan oleh Direksi dengan persetujuan Dewan Komisaris secara berkesinambungan (ongoing basis) yang kualitas desain dan pelaksanaannya dipengaruhi oleh Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, serta seluruh pejabat dan pegawai Bank. Penerapan SPI di lingkungan Bank bertujuan untuk:

1. Menjaga dan mengamankan harta kekayaan Bank.
2. Menjamin tersedianya laporan yang akurat.
3. Meningkatkan kepatuhan terhadap ketentuan yang berlaku.
4. Mengurangi dampak kerugian keuangan, penyimpangan termasuk kecurangan (fraud) dan pelanggaran aspek kehati-hatian.
5. Meningkatkan efektivitas organisasi dan meningkatkan efisiensi biaya.

## Pedoman Sistem Pengendalian Internal

Sistem pengendalian internal merupakan komponen penting dalam manajemen bank dan menjadi dasar bagi kegiatan operasional bank yang sehat dan aman. Pedoman sistem pengendalian internal Allo Bank telah mengacu pada Surat Edaran Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 35/SEOJK.03/2017 tentang pedoman Standar Sistem Pengendalian Intern bagi Bank Umum mencakup 5 (lima) elemen pokok yang saling berkaitan, yaitu:

1. Pengawasan oleh manajemen dan kultur pengendalian.
2. Identifikasi dan penilaian risiko.
3. Kegiatan pengendalian dan pemisahan fungsi.
4. Sistem akuntansi, informasi, dan komunikasi.
5. Kegiatan pemantauan dan tindakan koreksi penyimpangan.

Internal Control System is a control mechanism established by the Board of Directors with the approval of the Board of Commissioners on an ongoing basis, the quality of design and implementation of which is influenced by the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, and all officers and employees of the Bank. The implementation of SPI in the Bank's environment aims to:

1. Maintain and secure the Bank's assets.
2. Ensure the availability of accurate reports.
3. Increase compliance with applicable regulations.
4. Reduce the impact of financial losses, irregularities including fraud and violations of prudential aspects.
5. Increase organizational effectiveness and increase cost efficiency.

## Internal Control System Guidelines

The internal control system is an important component in bank management and is the basis for sound and safe bank operational activities. Allo Bank's internal control system guidelines refer to Financial Services Authority Circular Letter No. 35/SEOJK.03/2017 concerning guidelines for Internal Control System Standards for Conventional Bank covering 5 (five) main interrelated elements, namely:

1. Management supervision and control culture.
2. Risk identification and assessment.
3. Control activities and segregation of functions.
4. Accounting, information and communication systems.
5. Monitoring activities and corrective actions for deviations.

# Code of Conduct and Corporate Culture

Bank telah memiliki Kode Etik dan Budaya Perusahaan sebagai prinsip dasar dan pedoman yang harus diikuti dan diimplementasikan oleh Insan Bank dalam menjalankan kegiatan usaha maupun operasi secara beretika dan berintegritas. Bank senantiasa memperbaharui Kode Etik dan Budaya yang dimiliki agar tetap relevan dengan perkembangan regulasi, norma, dan dinamika bisnis Bank.

# Isi Kode Etik dan Pernyataan Kode Etik Berlaku bagi Seluruh Insan Allo Bank

Kode Etik (Code of Conduct) Bank disahkan berdasarkan Surat Keputusan Direksi No. 025/DIRAB/24 tentang Kebijakan Kode Etik (Code of Conduct). Kode Etik Perilaku ini berlaku bagi Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan karyawan Allo Bank. Seluruh karyawan telah menandatangani pernyataan bahwa yang bersangkutan telah memahami dan akan menaati serta menjalankan Kode Etik Bank Allo Bank tersebut.

Secara garis besar, Kode Etik Perilaku Allo Bank mengatur tentang:

1. Mematuhi peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, baik internal maupun eksternal.
2. Menolak penyuapan, korupsi dan aktivitas ilegal lainnya.
3. Dilarang menerima atau meminta hadiah/hiburan dari nasabah dalam bentuk apapun.
4. Menjaga agar tidak terjadi benturan kepentingan, baik dengan nasabah, karyawan Bank, pemegang saham, anggota Dewan Komisaris, anggota Direksi, dan/atau pihak terkait dengan Bank.
5. Mencegah pencucian uang, membocorkan rahasia perusahaan, dan menjaga kerahasiaan informasi nasabah.
6. Tidak menyalahgunakan jabatan dan wewenangnya untuk kepentingan pribadi maupun keluarga.
7. Tidak melakukan perbuatan tercela yang dapat merugikan nasabah maupun Bank.
8. Senantiasa berusaha untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan, khususnya pada industri perbankan.

The Bank has a Code of Conduct and Corporate Culture as a basic principle and guideline that must be adhered and implemented by Bank Personnel in carrying out business activities and operations ethically and with integrity. The Bank continuously updates the Code of Conduct and Culture, is it remains relevant to the development of regulations, norms, and dynamics of the Bank's business.

# Contents of Code of Conduct and Statement of Code of Conduct Applies to All Allo Bank Personnel

The Bank's Code of Conduct was ratified based on the Decree of the Board of Directors No. 025/DIRAB/24 concerning the Code of Conduct Policy. This Code of Conduct applies to the Board of Commissioners, Directors, and employees of Allo Bank. All employees have signed a statement that they have understood and will obey and implement the Allo Bank Code of Conduct.

In general, the Allo Bank Code of Conduct regulates:

1. Compliance with applicable laws and regulations, both internal and external.
2. Rejecting bribery, corruption and other illegal activities.
3. It is prohibited to accept or ask for gifts/ entertainment from customers in any form.
4. Ensuring that there are no conflicts of interest, whether with customers, Bank employees, shareholders, members of the Board of Commissioners, members of the Board of Directors, and/or parties related to the Bank.
5. Preventing money laundering, leak company confidential matter and maintain the confidentiality of customer information.
6. Not abusing individual's position and authority for personal or family interests.
7. Not commit disgraceful acts that could harm customers or the Bank.
8. Striving to enhance knowledge, especially in the banking industry.

# Penyediaan Dana kepada Pihak Terkait dan Penyediaan Dana Besar

Provision of Funds to Related Parties and Provision of Large Funds

Sebagaimana diatur oleh POJK No. 17 Tahun 2023 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola Bank Umum, Bank wajib menerapkan prinsip kehati-hatian dalam penyediaan dana paling sedikit dengan menerapkan penyebaran atau diversifikasi portofolio penyediaan dana yang diberikan. Pengungkapan penyediaan dana kepada pihak terkait (individu atau kelompok, termasuk Direksi, Dewan Komisaris, Pejabat Eksekutif Bank, serta pihak terkait lainnya) dan penyediaan dana besar (large exposure) mengacu pada SEOJK No. 13/SEOJK.03/2017 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum bagian Transparansi Penerapan Tata Kelola. Dalam penyediaan dana kepada pihak terkait dan penyediaan dana besar, Allo Bank selalu menerapkan prinsip kehati-hatian dan dilakukan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.

## Kebijakan Penyediaan Dana kepada Pihak Terkait dan Penyediaan Dana Besar

Penyediaan dana kepada pihak terkait dan kepada debitur dalam jumlah besar senantiasa dilakukan dengan memperhatikan prinsip kehati-hatian, melalui proses review dan mekanisme yang sesuai dengan kebijakan Bank serta telah memenuhi ketentuan OJK maupun peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, antara lain menyangkut aspek Batas Maksimum Pemberian Kredit (BMPK).

As regulated by POJK No. 17 of 2023 concerning the Implementation of Conventional Bank Governance, Banks are required to apply the principle of prudence in providing funds at least by implementing the distribution or diversification of the portfolio of funds provided. Disclosure of the provision of funds to related parties (individuals or groups, including the Board of Directors, Board of Commissioners, Bank Executive Officers, and other related parties) and the provision of large exposure refers to SEOJK No. 13/SEOJK.03/2017 concerning the Implementation of Governance for Conventional Bank, section on Transparency of Governance Implementation. In providing funds to related parties and providing large funds, Allo Bank always applies the principle of prudence and is carried out in accordance with applicable provisions.

## Policy on Providing Funds to Related Parties and Providing Large Funds

Provision of funds to related parties and to debtors in large amounts is always carried out by paying attention to the principle of prudence, through a review process and mechanisms in accordance with Bank policies and has complied with OJK provisions and applicable laws and regulations, including aspects of the Maximum Credit Limit (BMPK).

# Internal Fraud
Internal Fraud

Allo Bank melakukan berbagai upaya pencegahan terhadap kemungkinan terjadinya internal fraud, diantaranya dengan cara:

1. Menyelenggarakan sosialisasi dan training secara online atau offline kepada seluruh karyawan.
2. Melakukan diskusi secara reguler dengan dengan manajemen untuk meningkatkan kemampuan deteksi fraud.
3. Melakukan investigasi kasus fraud dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan yang tepat agar kasus fraud tidak terulang kembali.
4. Penandatangan Kode Etik oleh seluruh karyawan sebagai komitmen menjalankan budaya anti fraud
5. Memberikan sanksi tegas kepada karyawan yang terlibat kasus fraud secara langsung ataupun tidak langsung sebagai pembelajaran dan efek jera bagi karyawan lain.
6. Melakukan fungsi Know Your Employee, salah satunya dengan melakukan pemeriksaan slik untuk setiap calon karyawan dan karyawan existing setiap tahunnya.
7. Menerbitkan fraud alert atau fraud awareness berupa tulisan dan disebarkan melalui e-mail dan desktop wallpaper yang menginformasikan kepada seluruh karyawan tentang risiko fraud.

Allo Bank makes various efforts to prevent the possibility of internal fraud, including by:

1. Organizing online or offline dissemination and training for all employees.
2. Holding regular discussions with management to improve fraud detection capabilities.
3. Investigating fraud cases and providing recommendations for appropriate improvements so that fraud cases do not recur.
4. Signing of the Code of Conduct by all employees as a commitment to implementing an anti-fraud culture.
5. Giving strict sanctions to employees involved in fraud cases directly or indirectly as a learning experience and deterrent for other employees.
6. Carrying out the Know Your Employee function, one of which is by conducting a 'slik' check for each prospective employee and existing employee every year.
7. Publishing fraud alerts or fraud awareness in writing and distributed via e-mail and desktop wallpaper that informs all employees about the risk of fraud.

# Kebijakan Anti Korupsi Anti-Corruption Policy

Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, serta seluruh Insan Bank senantiasa menjunjung tinggi persaingan yang fair, nilai sportifitas dan professionalisme, serta prinsip-prinsip GCG. Perusahaan juga berkomitmen untuk menciptakan iklim usaha yang sehat, menghindari tindakan, perilaku ataupun perbuatan-perbuatan yang dapat menimbulkan konflik kepentingan, Korupsi, Kolusi, dan Nepotisme (KKN) serta selalu mengutamakan kepentingan Bank di atas kepentingan pribadi, keluarga, kelompok maupun golongan. Bank juga senantiasa memperhatikan kebijakan tentang anti korupsi seperti yang tertulis dalam Undang Undang No. 20 Tahun 2001 tentang Perubahan atas Undang-Undang No. 31 Tahun 1999 tentang Pemberantasan Tindak Pidana Korupsi.

Prinsip-prinsip dari kebijakan anti suap dan korupsi telah disusun dalam Kode Etika Perilaku (Code of Conduct) yang menjabarkan nilai-nilai yang dianut oleh Bank serta menetapkan standar perilaku seluruh jajaran Allo Bank dan sebagai salah satu bentuk pernyataan prinsip dan komitmen Bank dalam mendukung praktik anti suap dan korupsi yang dikategorikan juga sebagai tindakan kecurangan. Penerapan Kode Etik ini juga bertujuan untuk melindungi Bank dan seluruh karyawan dari dampak negatif seperti risiko hukum, kerugian finansial, reputasi negatif dan untuk menjaga kepercayaan seluruh pemegang saham, pemangku kepentingan, dan masyarakat luas.

The Board of Commissioners, Board of Directors, and all Bank Personnel always uphold fair competition, sportsmanship and professionalism values, and GCG principles. The Company is also committed to creating a favorable business climate, avoiding actions, behaviors or deeds that can cause conflicts of interest, Corruption, Collusion, and Nepotism (KKN) and always putting forward the interests of the Bank above personal, family, group or class interests. The Bank also always pays attention to anti-corruption policies as stated in Law No. 20 of 2001 concerning Amendments to Law No. 31 of 1999 concerning the Eradication of Criminal Acts of Corruption.

The principles of the anti-bribery and corruption policy have been formulated in the Code of Conduct which outlines the values adopted by the Bank and sets the standards of behavior for all levels of Allo Bank and as a form of statement of principles and commitment of the Bank in supporting anti-bribery and corruption practices which are also categorized as fraudulent acts. The implementation of the Code of Conduct also aims to protect the Bank and all employees from negative impacts such as legal risks, financial losses, negative reputation and to maintain the trust of all shareholders, stakeholders and the wider community.

# Sistem Pelaporan Whistleblowing

Allo Bank berkomitmen untuk mewujudkan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik secara komprehensif. Untuk itu, Bank telah memiliki mekanisme untuk mengelola dan menindaklanjuti segala jenis tindakan yang melanggar aturan dan nilai-nilai perusahaan dengan prinsip kerahasiaan pelapor dalam Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran (Whistleblowing System).

Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran Bank dikelola oleh Fraud Management yang mengacu pada sejumlah ketentuan, yaitu:

1. Peraturan OJK No. 55/POJK.03/2016 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum.
2. Peraturan OJK No. 12 tahun 2024 tentang Penerapan Strategi Anti-Fraud bagi Lembaga Jasa Keuangan.

Bank senantiasa memastikan perlindungan bagi Pelapor dengan memastikan setiap laporan dijaga dan dijamin kerahasiaannya. Bagi pihak-pihak yang melihat atau mengetahui adanya indikasi pelanggaran atau fraud di lingkungan Bank dapat mengirimkan laporannya melalui kanal WBS yang disediakan oleh Bank, antara lain:

E-mail: whistleblow@allobank.com
WhatsApp: 082208242401

Allo Bank is committed to realizing comprehensive Good Corporate Governance. To that end, the Bank has a mechanism to manage and follow up on all types of actions that violate the company's rules and values with the principle of confidentiality of the reporter in the Whistleblowing System.

The Bank's Whistleblowing System is managed by Fraud Management which refers to a number of provisions, namely:

1. OJK Regulation No. 55/POJK.03/2016 concerning the Implementation of Governance for Conventional Bank.
2. OJK Regulation No. 12 of 2024 concerning the Implementation of Anti-Fraud Strategies for Financial Services Institutions.

The Bank always ensures protection for the Whistleblower by ensuring that every report is maintained and guaranteed confidentiality. For parties who see or know of any indications of violations or fraud in the Bank's environment, they can send their reports through the WBS channel provided by the Bank, including:

# Conformity of Allo Bank GCG Implementation with Governance Guidelines for Public Companies

# Dukungan Allo Bank terhadap Keuangan Berkelanjutan

Indonesia berkomitmen untuk melaksanakan pembangunan berkelanjutan sesuai dengan amanat perundang-undangan. Berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 32 Tahun 2009 tentang Perlindungan dan Pengelolaan Lingkungan Hidup, pembangunan berkelanjutan didefinisikan sebagai upaya yang terencana dan sadar untuk mengintegrasikan aspek lingkungan, sosial, dan ekonomi ke dalam strategi pembangunan. Tujuannya adalah untuk memastikan keberlanjutan lingkungan serta kesejahteraan dan kualitas hidup generasi sekarang dan mendatang.

Allo Bank's success is even more meaningful considering it made all of its aforementioned accomplishments during a time when Indonesia's economic growth was experiencing a period of slowed-down activity. The Central Statistics Agency (BPS) has noted that Indonesia's economic growth in 2024 was recorded at 5.03 percent, which was down compared to the previous year's 5.05 percent. In addition to Indonesia, a slowing of economic growth was also experienced by Indonesia's main trading partners, specifically, China and the United States. Meanwhile, global economic growth, according to projections by the International Monetary Fund (IMF), was recorded at  $3.2\%$ , which slowed down compared to 3.3 percent in 2023.

Specifically, when looking at Central Statistics Agency data, the Financial Services and Insurance business sector in Indonesia, which includes the banking industry, grew by 4.74 percent in 2024. This growth was slightly lower than the same sector's 4.77 percent growth in 2023. The slowdown in growth in this business sector was influenced by various factors that included global economic uncertainty, external pressures (such as exchange rate fluctuations) and slowdown in foreign investment, which resulted in a suppression of liquidity and investment interest in Indonesia. Tighter monetary policies and tightened regulations in the financial sector have also made financial services institutions more careful in managing risks and loans in such a way that affected the rate of expansion of all the financial products and services they managed. The next factor was a shift in consumer behavior towards becoming more selective and conservative in making financial decisions. This change added to the financial services industry's burden in maintaining its previously more dynamic growth.

In the midst of these dynamic conditions within the field of financial services as a business, Allo Bank was able to succeed in taking advantage of existing opportunities and optimizing all of its resources so as to achieve its best in performance. We would like to use this sustainability report to convey our achievements when it comes to economic performance. In addition to this economic aspect, we will also use this report to convey our achievements in social and environmental performance. We are doing this in accordance with Financial Services Authority (OJK) Regulation No. 51/POJK.03/2017 concerning the Implementation of Sustainable Finance for Financial Services Institutions, Issuers and Public Companies (hereinafter referred to as "POJK on Sustainable Finance").

It uses this definition in accordance with Law No. 32 of 2009 concerning Environmental Protection and Management. The nation's goal is to ensure environmental sustainability as well as welfare and quality of life for both its present and its future generations.

# Kebijakan Allo Bank untuk Merespons Tantangan dalam Pemenuhan Strategi Keberlanjutan

Bank-bank berbasis digital di Indonesia semakin agresif dalam menjalankan ekspansi bisnis di sepanjang tahun 2024. Sebab itu, persaingan di antara bank berbasis digital pun semakin ketat. Untuk merespons tantangan tersebut, Allo Bank menerapkan berbagai kebijakan dalam pemenuhan strategi keberlanjutan. Selaras dengan visi menjadi bank umum berbasis digital terbaik, Bank terus melakukan pengembangan dan penyempurnaan teknologi informasi sebagai jantung operasi layanan. Untuk itu, pada 17 Mei 2024, Bank meresmikan penggunaan Data Center Allo Bank yang dirancang dengan arsitektur yang memenuhi standar internasional tertinggi. Selain arsitektur, keamanan juga menjadi prioritas Bank, dengan pemisahan antara lingkungan core system dengan surrounding system dan development system untuk meningkatkan keamanan dan keandalan layanan.

Selaras dengan itu, Bank melakukan assessment atas Control Objectives for Information and Related Technology ("COBIT") 2019 dengan hasil Tingkat Maturitas TI di level 4,21. Keberhasilan tersebut menjadi pemenuhan salah satu komitmen dan dedikasi Bank dalam menerapkan standar terbaik dalam tata kelola teknologi informas. Assessment ini juga merupakan langkah penting dalam memperkuat kapabilitas TI dan meningkatkan efisiensi serta keamanan layanan

In order to support its sustainable development implementation, the government has issued various regulations and policies, one of which was the POJK on Sustainable Finance that it published in 2017. In accordance with this regulation, Allo Bank (as a public company) is required to implement sustainable finance principles. It began implementing these principles on January 1, 2021. Sustainable finance requires comprehensive support from the financial services sector to encourage sustainable economic growth that can balance economic, social, and environmental interests.

Allo Bank's support for sustainable finance is realized through its preparation of a Sustainable Finance Action Plan (RAKB), which serves as an integral part of the Bank's Business Plan. It is through this RAKB that the Bank has formulated various strategic plans, programs, and policies to implement sustainable finance principles. In addition, in accordance with the provisions of the POJK on Sustainable Finance, the Bank is also obligated to allocate funds to finance various Social and Environmental Responsibility (TJSL) programs.

In addition, Allo Bank has also lent its support for sustainable finance through its efforts in terms of environmentally friendly office management. As a digital-based conventional bank, the Bank's operations are designed to have minimal environmental impact compared to conventional banks. As a result, its energy usage and its emissions produced are both lower, as are its water usage and its waste production.

# Allo Bank's Policy to Respond to Challenges in Fulfilling Sustainability Strategy

Digital banks in Indonesia have become increasingly aggressive in its efforts to carry out business expansions throughout 2024. This has resulted in tightened competition among digital banks. To respond to these challenges, Allo Bank has implemented various policies to fulfill its own sustainability strategies. In line with its vision of becoming the best digital-based conventional bank, the Bank has continued to develop and improve on its information technology serving as the heart of its service operations. For this reason, the Bank inaugurated its Allo Bank Data Center on May 17, 2024. This data center was designed with architecture that met the highest possible international standards. In addition to its world-class architecture, the data center's security was also a priority for the Bank. Towards this end, the Bank ensured a separation between the data center's core system environment and its surrounding system and development system to improve on the security and reliability of its services.

In line with this, the Bank conducted an assessment on Control Objectives for Information and Related Technology ("COBIT") 2019 with a resulting IT Maturity Level of 4.21. The Bank's success in this assessment served as a way of fulfilling one of the Bank's commitments and dedications in implementing the best-possible standards in information technology governance. # Penerapan Keuangan Berkelanjutan Tahun 2023

Di sepanjang tahun 2024, Allo Bank telah berupaya semaksimal mungkin untuk melaksanakan keuangan berkelanjutan dengan menyelaraskan pencapaian aspek ekonomi, lingkungan hidup, dan sosial. Upaya tersebut meraih hasil sebagai berikut:

1. Kinerja Aspek Ekonomi

Setiap tahun, Allo Bank menyusun Rencana Bisnis Bank (RBB) secara matang dan realistis berdasarkan prinsip kehati-hatian dan penerapan manajemen risiko. Rencana bisnis antara lain berisi tentang rencana Bank untuk meningkatkan kinerja usaha serta strategi untuk merealisasikan rencana tersebut sesuai target dan waktu yang ditetapkan. Penyusunan rencana bisnis senantiasa memperhatikan faktor eksternal dan internal yang dapat mempengaruhi kelangsungan usaha Bank, prinsip kehati-hatian, penerapan manajemen risiko, dan asas perbankan yang sehat.

Segenap manajemen dan karyawan Allo Bank terus mengukuhkan sinergi untuk merealisasikan target-target dalam RBB tahun 2024 dan membuahkan hasil yang membanggakan. Pendapatan Operasional tercatat sebesar Rp1,447 trilion, naik 25% dibandingkan pencapaian tahun 2023, didorong oleh pertumbuhan pendapatan bunga bersih dan pendapatan berbasis biaya. Pendapatan bunga bersih tumbuh 8% menjadi Rp.1,118 trilion ditopang oleh pertumbuhan kredit di tengah kondisi ekonomi makro yang penuh tantangan. Laba Bersih sebesar Rp467 miliar atau naik 5% dibanding tahun sebelumnya.

Pencapaian tersebut sejalan dengan peningkatan jumlah akuisisi/onboarding nasabah hingga akhir tahun 2024 yang mencapai lebih dari 11 juta nasabah. Selain itu, juga selaras dengan keberhasilan Bank meningkatkan engagement sehingga nasabah puas dan sering bertransaksi di Allo Bank. Dalam hal ini, Bank mencatatkan peningkatan signifikan dalam jumlah transaksi khususnya transaksi menggunakan QRIS, transfer melalui BI-Fast maupun pembayaran Bill Payment.

2. Kinerja Aspek Lingkungan

Operasional Bank sebagai lembaga jasa keuangan tidak berdampak langsung bagi lingkungan. Walau demikian, Bank senantiasa merujuk berbagai regulasi yang mengatur hubungan antara industri perbankan dengan lingkungan. Dengan memperhatikan prinsip kehati-hatian, Allo Bank merilis produk dan layanan berupa giro, tabungan, deposito dan pinjaman konsumsi (instant cash dan pay later) yang semuanya tidak berkontribusi negatif terhadap lingkungan.

# Sustainable Finance Implementation in 2023

Throughout 2024, Allo Bank has made every possible effort to implement sustainable finance by aligning its achievements when it came to its economic, environmental, and social aspects. These efforts have bore the following results:

1. Economic Aspect Performance

Every year, Allo Bank prepares a mature and realistic Bank Business Plan (RBB) that it designs based on the principle of prudence and risk management implementation. This business plan includes the Bank's plans to improve business performance, as well as accompanying strategies to realize these plans within an established time frame and with clear goals. The process of preparing this business plan always takes into account any external and internal factors that can potentially affect the Bank's business continuity. The plan also takes into account the principle of prudence and the implementation of risk management, all while being guided by healthy banking as a concept.

All management and employees of Allo Bank continue to strengthen synergy to realize the targets in the 2024 RBB and produce good results. Operating Revenue was recorded at IDR1,447 trillion, up 25% compared to the achievement in 2023, driven by growth in net interest income and fee-based income. Net interest income grew 8% to IDR1,118 trillion supported by credit growth amidst challenging macroeconomic conditions. Net Profit reached IDR467 billion or up 5% compared to the previous year.

These achievements were in line with an increase in Allo Bank's number of customer acquisitions/onboarding until the end of 2024 that reached more than 11 million customers. In addition, these achievements were also in line with the Bank's success in boosting engagement so that customers are satisfied and carried out transactions frequently through Allo Bank. As a result, the Bank was also able to record a significant increase in the number of transactions, particularly those using QRIS, as well as the number of transfers via BI-Fast and Bill Payment payments.

2. Environmental Aspect Performance

The Bank's operations as a financial services institution do not have any direct impact on the environment. At the same time, the Bank still paid heed to various regulations that governed the relationship between the banking industry and the environment. The Bank paid attention to the principle of prudence and released products and services in the form of current accounts, savings, deposits and consumer loans (instant cash and pay later), none of which had any sort of negative environmental contributions.
